jobs.title: Design Operations Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Who We Are:**


Vesta Home (dba Showroom Group) is changing the way homes are marketed and how furniture is sold. We're obsessed with the client experience for our full\-service offerings: interior design, luxury staging, elevated furniture rentals, and custom furniture production—fueled by our proprietary technology and logistics expertise.


Founded in 2017, our team of 50\+ designers creates stunning interiors for residential, commercial, and hospitality projects. We proudly partner with top realtors, developers, and personalities on some of the most prestigious properties in the market. You’ve likely seen our work in top design magazines, Bravo’s Million Dollar Listing, and Netflix’s Selling Sunset.


As the \#1 home staging brand in the U.S., Vesta’s deep design expertise and market knowledge in Los Angeles, New York, San Francisco, and South Florida helps sell multimillion\-dollar properties faster and above asking. Our interior design and custom furniture services are available globally.

**Core Values:**

* **“Get it done!”:** We have a bias toward action, and balance grit with smart work to accomplish our goals. We see business challenges as opportunities, always bring forward solutions, and believe there is no challenge too great that we cannot solve collectively.
* **“Design excellence”**: Exceptional design is a function of continuous improvement. We apply this ruthlessly and pursue design excellence in everything we do \- from projects to processes to people.
* **“Execute in partnership and with pride”**: We rise by lifting others and are most successful when our peers and colleagues are successful as well. We obsess over quality, take pride in our work, and break down barriers to create seamless success.
* **“Invest not spend”**: We value impact and the efficient achievement of results. We invest money \- we don't spend it. We expect and monitor the returns on all of our investments, from time to money.
* **“Embrace a growth mindset”:** We believe profitable growth creates opportunities and are intensely focused on progress. We develop the most talented people and empower them to offer world\-class expertise to our clients.

**Position Overview:**


We are seeking a highly organized and proactive professional to drive the daily logistics and inventory operations that support our design team. In this critical role, you will serve as the essential bridge between our designers and warehouse operations, ensuring that all furniture requirements, pick lists, and install preparations are executed flawlessly and meet strict deadlines. You will be responsible for real\-time problem solving, coordinating item replacements, monitoring inventory utilization through reporting platforms, and prioritizing furniture repairs. * Designer Assignments: Assist the Creative Director with assigning designers to upcoming projects.

* + All designers receive their required furniture on time and that their furniture pick lists are completed by the established deadlines. Provide direct assistance to designers with any urgent furniture needs.
	+ Designers are contacted regarding any delays, inquiries, or their overall ability to meet deadlines.
	+ If a designer misses a pick list deadline, immediately notify warehouse operations in the project's Slack channel, including an estimated completion time.
	+ All furniture requirements are fulfilled by 1:00 PM or earlier for projects that install the following day.
	+ Furniture requirements for ongoing, multi\-day projects are completed by 2:00 PM.
	+ Ensure that all one day installs are ready to pick 48 hours prior to installation date.
	+ All finalized TRIP IDs are reported to the operations team via the respective project Slack channels.
	+ All projects receive the necessary marketing materials.
	+ All projects being picked at night are receiving efficient and consistent assistance with replacements, or any other designer needs.
	+ All projects are being checked for overallocations alongside picking confirmation.

**Post\-Job Completion**

* Upon a job's completion, review items in COLI and unassigned inventory. Ensure COLIS is fully cleared.
* Identify and flag any instances of hoarding or excessive reservation of inventory by designers to your Creative Director.
* Assist the warehouse with finding and assigning replacement pieces during the evening shift.
* Document and report to the Design Operations Manager any instances where designers added items to lists after the project deadline.

**Procurement \& Inventory**

* Inventory Utilization: Utilize the necessary reports (Retool, Domo, etc) to manage inventory levels and report needs to the warehouse. Manage liquidation needs.
* Inventory Monitoring: Assess warehouse inventory levels using Retool \+ Domo reports and report needs to the Design Operations Manager.
* Budget Allocation \& Oversight: Oversee project\-level spending to ensure general inventory purchases remain aligned with allocated budgets.

* Prioritize Repairs: Prioritize what needs to be repaired based on current and upcoming inventory needs.
* Create Repair Instructions: Review damage locations, download the associated reports, and convert them into clear instruction sheets for the repair team.

jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Who You Are**



You are a highly organized, detail\-oriented project professional who enjoys bringing structure, clarity, and follow\-through to complex work. You are comfortable coordinating multiple priorities, maintaining accurate project information, communicating with a variety of stakeholders, and identifying issues before they become larger problems. You take ownership of your commitments, learn quickly, and bring a collaborative, client\-focused mindset to every interaction.


**About The Role**



As a Project Coordinator within the Project Management Office (PMO), you will support Project Managers and Program Managers in the planning, coordination, tracking, and successful delivery of client\-facing technology projects. You will help maintain accurate project schedules, documentation, action items, risks, dependencies, financial information, and status reporting so project teams and stakeholders have timely visibility into progress and emerging concerns. This role is well suited for someone who can balance detail\-oriented administrative execution with proactive communication, sound judgment, and a desire to grow within project management.


**Must be based in the United States of America.** The role may support multiple projects, clients, and internal teams simultaneously and may occasionally coordinate with stakeholders across different time zones.


**Other responsibilities include:**


* Support Project Managers and Program Managers with project planning, coordination, tracking, and follow\-through from initiation through closeout.
* Maintain accurate project schedules, milestones, deliverables, action items, decision logs, risk registers, dependency trackers, and other project controls.
* Coordinate project meetings, prepare agendas and materials, capture notes and decisions, distribute follow\-up actions, and monitor completion.
* Prepare recurring project status updates, dashboards, and health reports using current and validated project information.
* Track project progress against scope, schedule, budget, resource plans, and key client commitments; escalate variances and emerging risks promptly.
* Coordinate information and handoffs among Project Management, Program Management, Solutions Architecture, Engineering, Logistics, Finance, vendors, subcontractors, and client stakeholders.
* Support project financial administration, including purchase\-order and invoice status, time and expense tracking, budget updates, cost documentation, and forecast inputs as assigned.
* Maintain organized, complete, and audit\-ready project records in Smartsheet, NetSuite, Microsoft 365, and other approved systems; ensure Smartsheet project data, schedules, dashboards, and reports remain current and accurate.
* Assist with resource coordination, onboarding activities, site or field\-readiness documentation, logistics tracking, and project communications as needed.
* Proactively identify missing information, schedule conflicts, unresolved decisions, and delivery risks; research issues and coordinate resolution with the appropriate owners.
* Support project closeout by confirming deliverables, documentation, financial information, lessons learned, and handoff requirements are complete.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of PMO templates, reporting standards, workflows, and project coordination practices.


**Desired skills and experience:**


* Two to four years of experience in project coordination, project administration, operations support, or a related field; equivalent professional experience will be considered.
* Experience supporting multiple projects, workstreams, customers, or stakeholders while managing competing priorities and deadlines.
* Working knowledge of project management fundamentals, including schedules, milestones, deliverables, dependencies, risks, issues, and status reporting.
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills with exceptional attention to detail and consistent follow\-through.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate professionally with clients, vendors, subcontractors, and internal teams.
* Ability to collect, validate, organize, and summarize project information for project teams and leadership.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and Microsoft 365 tools; comfort working with spreadsheets, trackers, shared documents, and presentation materials.
* Experience using Smartsheet is strongly preferred, including maintaining project sheets, updating dashboards and reports, and working with automated workflows or cross\-sheet data. Smartsheet experience is not required, but practical experience will be considered a significant advantage.
* Ability to identify gaps, ask effective questions, investigate unresolved items, and escalate concerns with appropriate context and urgency.
* Demonstrated ability to build trust, collaborate across functions, and maintain a client\-focused, service\-oriented approach.
* Self\-motivated and dependable, with the ability to work independently in a fully remote environment while staying connected to the broader team.
* A proactive, preventive mindset and eagerness to learn, grow, and take on increasing responsibility within project management.


**A Little About Us**



Our mission is to challenge and enable our employees to achieve great things.


**We live and breathe our core values:**


* **We Before Me:** We demonstrate empathy through our actions and solicit diverse voices and opinions. We put ourselves in each other's shoes, readily admit our mistakes, and generously share our time and knowledge.
* **Dare To Be Great:** We are big\-picture thinkers who focus on solutions to problems. We solicit and offer actionable feedback to others without hesitation. We embrace opportunities to improve ourselves, our teams, and our work. We aim to be the best of the best.

**Job ID** 19967 **Location** Los Angeles, California, United States **Job Category** Academic / Research **Date posted** 08/26/2026

**Job Description**
-------------------


**Join Cedars\-Sinai and become part of a team that is at the forefront of medical advancements!**


**About the Team**


The MAST program at Cedars\-Sinai Medical Center is dedicated to the development of novel drugs and devices to diagnose and treat patients. This innovative program is working to develop new diagnostics and therapeutics to treat patients with illnesses related to imbalances or alterations in the Microbiome. To learn more, please visit: https://www.cedars\-sinai.org/research/areas/science\-tech.html.


**About the Role**


The Clinical Research Coordinator II works independently providing study coordination including screening of potential patients for protocol eligibility, presenting non\-medical trial concepts and details, and participating in the informed consent process. Responsible for accurate and timely source documents, data collection, documentation, entry, and reporting including timely response to sponsor queries. Responsible for compiling and reporting on each study including information related to protocol activity, accrual data, workload, and other research information. Presents information at regular research staff meetings. May plan and coordinate strategies for increasing patient enrollment, improving efficiency, training of personnel, or identifying new research opportunities. Ensures compliance with all federal and local agencies including the Food and Drug Administration (FDA) and local Institutional Review Board (IRB).


**Primary Duties and Responsibilities:**


* Schedules patients for research visits and procedures.
* In collaboration with the physician and other medical personnel, documents thoroughly on Case Report Forms (CRFs) the following; changes in patient condition, adverse events, concomitant medication use, protocol compliance, response to study drug.
* Maintains accurate source documents related to all research procedures.
* Schedules and participates in monitoring and auditing activities.
* Notifies direct supervisor about concerns regarding data quality and study conduct.
* Works closely with a regulatory coordinator or directly with the Institutional Review Board (IRB) to submit Adverse Events, Serious Adverse Events, protocol deviations, and Safety Letters in accordance with local and federal guidelines.
* May perform other regulatory / Institutional Review Board duties, budgeting duties, and assisting with patient research billing and reconciliation.
* Maintains research practices using Good Clinical Practice (GCP) guidelines.
* Maintains strict patient confidentiality according to HIPAA regulations and applicable law.
* May coordinate training and education of other personnel.

* May plan and coordinate strategies for improving clinical research efficiency.

* May identify new research opportunities and present to investigators
* Participates in required training and education programs.

* ACRP/SOCRA certification is preferred.

* Two years of clinical research experience is required.

Today, Cedars\- Sinai is known for its national leadership in transforming healthcare for the benefit of patients. Cedars\-Sinai impacts the future of healthcare by developing new approaches to treatment and educating tomorrow's health professionals. Additionally, Cedars\-Sinai demonstrates a commitment to the community through programs that improve the health of its most vulnerable residents.

Cedars\-Sinai is one of the largest nonprofit academic medical centers in the U.S., with 915 licensed beds, 2,993 physicians, 4,700\+ nurses and thousands of other healthcare professionals and staff. Choose this if you want to work in a fast\-paced environment that offers the highest level of care to people in the Los Angeles that need our care the most.

jobs.title: Talent Development Program Specialist
jobs.description:
**Human Interest is on a mission to ensure that people in all lines of work have access to retirement benefits.**



More than half of all working Americans are not saving enough for their future. Too often, it's because they are employed by a company that doesn't offer a retirement plan. Human Interest is changing that by making it affordable and accessible for small and medium\-sized businesses to offer employees a path to financial independence through retirement savings.



We're a high\-growth fintech company changing the retirement industry. We are backed by a number of investors. This includes funding from Marshall Wace and Baillie Gifford, as well as top investors such as BlackRock, TPG (The Rise Fund), SoftBank, Glynn Capital, NewView Capital, USVP, Wing, Uncork, and more.


**About the role**



As a Talent Development Program Specialist, you will play a key role in designing, building, and executing modern learning programs at Human Interest. You will act as both an instructional designer and an engaging facilitator, mixing strategy with storytelling to create resources, processes, and experiences that shape careers and drive our high\-performance culture.



We are looking for someone who is tech\-forward—who actively leverages modern AI tools to streamline content creation, elevate slide presentations, and scale enablement across the entire employee lifecycle.


**What you get to do every day**


**Tech\-Forward Instructional Design and Content Creation**


* Design and build contemporary, self\-led e\-learning modules, on\-demand micro\-learning assets, training guides, facilitator materials, and slide decks.
* Actively leverage AI tools to write scripts, generate visual assets, draft assessments, and accelerate instructional design.
* Document processes and update People Team resources in our intranet (Confluence).
* Build structured project proposals and training deployment plans that clearly articulate learning objectives, target outcomes, and agile rollout strategies.
* Uphold Human Interest's brand consistently through communications and experiences.
* Assess feedback and internal data to enhance, expand, change and/or adapt our offerings and ways of doing things.
* Establish post\-training feedback channels to gather participant insights, actively translating learner input into actionable updates to refine and elevate learning programs.


**Facilitation and Learning Delivery**


* Facilitate energetic, interactive virtual and in\-person training sessions and workshops across employee levels and different departments.
* Conduct thorough learning needs assessments and gap analyses to align L\&D initiatives with company objectives, directly translating identified gaps into actionable learning solutions.
* Manage and execute talent programs, including ongoing employee growth and leadership development.


**Stakeholder and People Team Support**


* Work cross\-functionally to support the success of talent development programs.
* Build effective relationships with other internal organizations to support employee development.
* Collaborate with stakeholders on employee development efforts that will aid in retaining top talent.
* Provide administrative support for our Learning Management System (Docebo).
* Manage and assist with People Team projects from inception to completion.


**What you bring to the role**


* 3\- 5 years of experience in Learning \& Development, Talent Development, Instructional Design or related fields.
* Experience creating eLearning content using tools such as Articulate Rise.
* Strong facilitation and presentation skills in both in\-person and virtual environments.
* Working knowledge of LMS administration (experience with Docebo and Confluence is a major plus) and multimedia editing software (e.g., Canva).
* Proven ability to leverage AI tools to optimize daily workflows, draft content, and build visual assets.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and prioritize tasks to meet deadlines.
* Meticulous organization and attention to detail.
* Excellent interpersonal and cross\-functional skills.
* Able to function independently, as well as collaboratively with other team members.
* Ability to leverage existing tools and materials creatively to build high\-impact, scalable solutions within lean environments.


**Why you will love working at Human Interest**



Human Interest is tackling one of our country's biggest challenges \- closing the retirement gap. You'll be instrumental in architecting and scaling solutions that bring financial security to employees at small and medium\-sized businesses nationwide. We've made significant progress, but there is still growth ahead, offering you a unique opportunity to solve complex problems, drive innovation, and advance your career alongside a dedicated, mission\-driven team. We value hard work and recognize that our team's contributions are key to our continued success.



Join Human Interest and make a lasting impact by shaping the future of retirement.



Our operating principles define how we work together as a team. They reflect Human Interest's unique view on what's important and what's right. This position offers a great opportunity to develop a strong foundation in media, marketing, and client relations.

* Maintain performance tracking reports and media databases to support strategic decision\-making.
* Conduct in\-depth research to support media campaign recommendations and market insights.
* Document and distribute client meeting summaries to ensure clear communication and action items.
* Assist in the creation of compelling presentations and reports for client meetings.
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with internal teams, clients, and external partners.

As the Strategic Account Manager, you will be the visionary leader responsible for the overall performance, growth, and unparalleled customer satisfaction of this prestigious global account. This high\-profile role serves as the primary conduit between the client’s executive stakeholders, PeopleSpace, and a sophisticated multidisciplinary onsite team, translating global priorities into world\-class execution.
  
  

The onsite team currently includes six Workplace Technicians, one Technical Lead, two Workplace Coordinator/Designers—including one based in Northern California—and one hybrid Workplace Coordinator/Technical Supervisor.
  
  

This position represents a pinnacle career milestone, combining high\-stakes strategic account leadership, people management, and business development. The successful candidate will possess the gravitas to advise senior global stakeholders while maintaining the operational excellence required to lead a diverse team. You will be empowered to drive innovation and hold the team to the highest standards of quality, responsiveness, and professional brilliance.
  
  

During the initial phase, your primary mission will be the stewardship of this flagship account. Once the account and high\-performing team are operating at peak efficiency, you will have the mandate to expand your portfolio to additional strategic projects, unlocking significant opportunities for bonus and commission earnings in alignment with PeopleSpace’s elite compensation program.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

Strategic Client Leadership
  
  

Serve as the primary point of contact for all PeopleSpace activities, services, orders, projects, and onsite personnel supporting the account.
  
  

Build trusted relationships with client stakeholders and develop a thorough understanding of the client’s business, workplace strategy, service expectations, and priorities.

Onsite Team Leadership and Workforce Management
  
  

Provide day\-to\-day leadership and accountability for a large (10\-15 person) multidisciplinary team across workplace operations, furniture services, technical services, coordination, and design.
  
  

Establish clear roles, workflows, service standards, escalation paths, and communication expectations.
  
  

Strategically deploy team members according to their skills, workload, location, and client priorities.
  
  

Manage staffing, scheduling, coverage, workload distribution, and labor utilization to meet service expectations while proactively limiting unnecessary overtime.
  
  

Monitor the quality, accuracy, timeliness, and professionalism of the team’s work.
  
  

Conduct regular team meetings, one\-on\-ones, coaching, and performance conversations.
  
  

Partner with PeopleSpace leadership and Human Resources on hiring, onboarding, training, performance management, and employee development.
  
  

Build a collaborative, accountable team culture and promote cross\-training to strengthen coverage and consistency.
  
  

Ensure employees understand that PeopleSpace is their employer while maintaining a highly integrated and responsive onsite client experience.
  
  

Project and Work\-Order Management
  
  

Oversee the full lifecycle of client projects, daily work orders, furniture requests, moves, adds, changes, repairs, and service needs.
  
  

Confirm that requests are properly scoped, assigned, scheduled, documented, and completed according to client expectations.
  
  

Direct internal team members and PeopleSpace departments responsible for design, specifications, quoting, order management, project management, delivery, and installation.
  
  

Develop product specifications and project solutions independently or in collaboration with designers, project managers, and other dealership personnel.
  
  

Prepare or oversee accurate, professional proposals and quotes and present them to the client in a timely manner.
  
  

Maintain visibility into active work and provide frequent, reliable status updates to the client.
  
  

Coordinate with client representatives and third parties, including A\&D firms, contractors, facilities teams, IT, electrical and communications consultants, manufacturers, and installation partners.
  
  

Financial and Sales Management
  
  

Establish appropriate costs and sell amounts for account products and services based on contract pricing, margin requirements, and established service rates.
  
  

Manage account profitability, cost of sale, labor utilization, project budgets, and overtime performance.
  
  

Support forecasting and maintain visibility into the account’s current and anticipated pipeline.

jobs.title: Import Logistics Coordinator
jobs.description:
### **Description**

  

**THE PURPOSE:** The Import Logistics Coordinator owns end\-to\-end visibility of inbound international shipments destined for North America, with a primary focus on DDP shipments from overseas factories to U.S. distribution centers. Under the DDP model, factories manage their own freight forwarders, customs brokers, and transportation providers \- making this role the central point of accountability across that entire network. The coordinator ensures factories and their logistics partners meet agreed\-upon timelines, maintain accurate documentation, and deliver product reliably, so that internal teams have the visibility they need to protect business commitments across wholesale, retail, and e\-commerce channels.### **THE ROLE (what you are accountable for):**

  

* Own end\-to\-end shipment visibility for all DDP inbound shipments from factory cargo\-ready date through final delivery to U.S. distribution centers, tracking milestones including cargo ready, pickup, departure, arrival, customs clearance, and DC receipt
* Coordinate directly with overseas factories to obtain accurate shipment information, ETAs, documentation, and status updates throughout each shipment lifecycle
* Work with factories and their appointed freight forwarders and customs brokers to ensure shipments progress according to plan \- escalating proactively when timelines are at risk
* Track shipments against critical business deadlines including product launches, retail delivery windows, wholesale commitments, and e\-commerce go\-lives, and communicate risks to internal stakeholders before they become delivery failures
* Maintain accurate and current DDP shipment milestones in the Looker ITR, providing cross\-functional teams with reliable visibility into inbound inventory status
* Review shipment documentation from factories and logistics partners for completeness and accuracy, monitoring customs clearance status and following up on any holds or delays
* Create and maintain factory, freight forwarder, and customs broker scorecards covering on\-time performance, communication, transit times, documentation accuracy, and issue resolution
* Develop and maintain reporting on inbound shipments, transit times, delivery performance, and vendor performance, using data to identify trends and drive accountability
* Identify recurring logistics issues by factory or logistics provider and work with appropriate parties to implement corrective actions
* Maintain and improve freight\-related SOPs and DDP shipping guidelines for factories and vendors, supporting broader process improvement initiatives across the inbound logistics function

**YOU ARE:** A highly organized logistics professional who thrives in a high\-volume, multi\-vendor environment. You track shipment milestones, documentation accuracy, and vendor accountability without losing the thread across dozens of concurrent shipments \- and you communicate proactively when something is at risk. You follow through without needing to be managed, build effective relationships with overseas partners despite not having direct authority over them, and bring both data discipline and clear\-headed problem\-solving to a function where delays have real business consequences.### **REQUIRED MINIMUM EXPERIENCE**

  

* 2\+ years of experience in international logistics, import operations, supply chain, or freight forwarding \- preferably in an apparel, fashion, retail, or consumer products environment
* Strong working knowledge of DDP and related Incoterms, including DDU/DAP, FOB, and CIF
* Understanding of the roles of factories, freight forwarders, customs brokers, carriers, and importers within an international shipment lifecycle
* Experience working directly with overseas factories and/or third\-party logistics providers
* Intermediate to advanced Excel skills, including VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, pivot tables, conditional formatting, and data analysis
* Strong reporting and analytical skills with the ability to identify trends, exceptions, and operational risks
* Exceptional organizational skills with the ability to manage high volumes of shipments and competing deadlines simultaneously
* Strong communication and relationship management skills with overseas factory and external logistics partners
* Ability to work independently, follow up proactively, and drive issues to resolution without direct authority over external vendors
* Bachelor’s degree in supply chain, international business, or a related field

**PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:*** Experience with an ERP or supply chain management system; Full Circle experience a plus
* Familiarity with Looker or comparable business intelligence and reporting tools
* Background supporting multiple distribution channels, including wholesale, e\-commerce, and retail
* Exposure to customs compliance and import regulatory requirements

  

### **ADDITIONAL ROLE INFORMATION**

  

* **Compensation:** The anticipated base salary range for this role is $28/hour. This is a full\-time, non\-exempt position. This range represents the low and high ends of the expected base salary range for this role based on the applicable location. True Religion reasonably expects to pay within this range in compliance with all applicable federal, state, and local laws. Actual compensation will be determined based on factors including relevant experience, skills, knowledge, and internal equity.
* **Perks**: We offer a mix of benefits and perks to support our employees at work and beyond, including health benefits, a 401(k) with employer match, merchandise discounts, commuter benefits, wellness \& employee assistance programs, and more.
* **Work Model:** This role is based in El Segundo, CA or Fontana, CA and follows a hybrid work model, with an expectation of in\-office presence on designated days to support collaboration and business needs. A flexible schedule is needed due to work with international vendors.

jobs.description:
**Company Description**  

The Wonderful Company is a privately held $6 billion company committed to providing high\-quality, healthy brands and helping improve the lives of the people who live and work in the places where we operate. Ranked No. 1 on the 2025 PEOPLE® Companies That Care list and one of Fortune® magazine’s “100 Best Companies to Work For” in the U.S., The Wonderful Company is continually recognized for its dedication to the well\-being of its workforce, their communities, and the planet.


The Wonderful Company’s in\-house advertising agency is seeking a detail\-oriented Digital Marketing Coordinator to support the day\-to\-day execution and management of paid media campaigns across social platforms, YouTube, and other digital channels. The coordinator will assist with campaign setup, quality assurance, pacing, reporting, and cross\-functional coordination to help ensure campaigns launch accurately and on time.


This role is highly execution\-focused and requires strong attention to detail, organization, and hands\-on comfort working within advertising platforms. The ideal candidate is a collaborative and resourceful team player who can manage multiple deliverables, follow established processes and best practices, communicate status and issues clearly, and help the team continuously improve campaign execution.

**This is a temporary position running from September 2026 through February 2027, with the potential for extension.**

**This position will be based at our West Los Angeles, CA office.** We work a hybrid schedule with an in\-office requirement Monday\-Wednesday and the option to work remotely on Thursday and Friday.

 **Job Description**  

* Track campaign timelines and coordinate with internal teams to ensure assets and approvals are received on time
* Build, launch, and monitor digital campaigns across paid social platforms and YouTube based on approved media plans
* Follow platform and team best practices for campaign builds, QA, testing, and reporting, flag discrepancies or issues promptly
* Monitor campaign pacing and performance, make approved optimizations, and surface observations and learnings to the team
* Export data from various platforms and sources, create results tables, and support the team in identifying key insights
* Track campaign spend, maintain budget trackers, and support validation of media partner invoices
* Participate in team brainstorms and planning discussions, providing executional input as needed
* Troubleshoot platform issues with media vendors and escalate when needed
* Stay current on relevant platform updates and share changes that may affect campaign setup, delivery, or paid amplification

  

**Qualifications**  

* 1–3 years of experience in digital or social marketing, with hands\-on exposure to building, trafficking, monitoring, or reporting on paid digital campaigns
* Hands\-on experience with Meta Ads Manager and/or Google Ads (video)
* Exposure to campaign builds on platforms such as TikTok, Pinterest, Snap, or LinkedIn is a plus
* Experience with campaign QA and reporting
* Strong Excel skills and comfort working with campaign data, budgets, and trackers
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to provide concise status updates, ask questions, and flag issues
* Basic understanding of organic social platforms and how they relate to paid amplification
* Experience with A/B testing or measurement studies is a bonus
* Dependability, flexibility, organization, and resourcefulness
* Ability to take ownership of assigned tasks and follow through on deadlines
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy
* Familiarity with Google Analytics (GA), Google Tag Manager (GTM), campaign tagging, and tracking concepts is a plus


Pay Range: $27\.00 \- $30\.00 an hour. Final compensation will be dependent upon skills \& experience.

Wonderful Agency is the full\-service in\-house advertising and marketing agency at The Wonderful Company. Ensure established service levels, quality standards, response times, and performance expectations are consistently met.


Implement effective quality\-control procedures for project documentation, specifications, quotes, orders, installations, and completed service work.

jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE:  

Headquartered in Southern California, Skechers—the Comfort Technology Company®—has spent over 30 years helping men, women, and kids everywhere look and feel good. Comfort innovation is at the core of everything we do, driving the development of stylish, high\-quality products at a great value. From our diverse footwear collections to our expanding range of apparel and accessories, Skechers is a complete lifestyle brand.  

  

ABOUT THE ROLE:  

The key account manager handles Skechers most important clients. The Key Account Manager must build and maintain strong client relationships, serve as the lead point of contact for all key client matters, anticipate client needs, and work across the company to meet client deadlines and help the client succeed. The Key Account Manager will also bring in new business through market research and build and develop relationships with existing clients. Travel is required throughout the territory, and the role is responsible for the following states: North Carolina and South Carolina.
WHAT YOU'LL DO:

* Provide the highest level of service and technical expertise each season, from sell\-in to sell\-thru.
* Achieve sales goals by quarter and by category as defined by their manager.
* Develop and maintain a strong relationship with all levels of external account leadership, internal business partners, and relevant departments.
* Coordinate and prepare seasonal product presentations.
* Drive analysis of account base – business planning, inventory management, sell\-through analytics.
* Proactive order book management.
* Continuous sales analysis to manage product life cycles, inventory models, capitalize on successes, and address issues as needed.
* Monitor competitors' activities and performance and implement strategies and tactics to compete.
* Knowledge and discipline to adhere to distribution guidelines.
* Work as a liaison with the National Sales Manager, customer service, sales analyst, and in\-store marketing team.
* Deliver all required reports, for example, weekly sell\-through analysis, on time.
* Market research through store and account visits 2\-3 times a month.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

* 6\+ Years' experience in Footwear (kids preferred), national account sales, or relevant experience.
* Ability to present product and communicate brand strategy to accounts accurately and effectively.
* Working knowledge of the retail footwear industry.
* Ability to effectively manage your time and work against business deadlines.
* Analytically strong, understanding of retail math, fluent in Excel and PowerPoint, and overall business orientation.
* Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, make recommendations, and provide solutions.
* Strong communication and listening skills.
* Domestic travel required up to 40%.
* Ability to conduct meetings through MS Teams and Zoom


The pay range for this position is $120,000\-$140,000/yr USD.

Skechers, a global Fortune 500® company, develops and markets a diverse range of lifestyle and performance footwear, apparel, and accessories. Serving over 180 countries and territories, Skechers connects customers to products through department and specialty stores, e\-commerce and digital stores, and through our more than 5,300 Skechers retail locations.

jobs.title: SMB Account Manager - Services
jobs.description:
Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn't work together.  

  

So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we've embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.  

  

Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise\-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We're building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.


#### **The Role**



Small businesses are the backbone of any community\- and you'll be the partner that helps them thrive with Square. From the local salon to the personal trainer down the street, we're looking for someone with a genuine passion for SMBs in the Services space, excited by the opportunity to work alongside business owners and champion their growth.



In this role, you'll build meaningful partnerships with clients, understanding their unique needs, crafting tailored solutions, and advocating for them within Square. You'll become a creative problem\-solver, finding ways to apply our products to complex business scenarios. As a trusted advisor, you'll support clients day\-to\-day while uncovering new growth opportunities and expanding partnerships that fuel their success.



Your day\-to\-day blends high\-energy outreach, consultative conversations, and business coaching, with a focus on helping sellers get the most from Square. You'll have autonomy to lead your playbook and influence how Square scales in the Services industry, delivering tangible results for your merchants.

  

**You will:**


* Own, retain, and grow a portfolio of SMB Services merchants, helping them thrive through tailored adoption of Square tools.
* Drive expansion through product adoption, upselling, and value\-based recommendations.
* Act as the voice of your merchants within Square, advocating for their needs with empathy and surfacing insights that shape our products.
* Balance proactive outreach, retention activities, and growth opportunities through strong organization and time management.
* Work with our Sales, Support and Product teams to ensure customers have the best possible experience across all aspects of Square


**You have:**


* 3\+ years experience in Sales, Account Management or related field
* Experience discovering and closing sales opportunities and building client relationships.
* Experience successfully managing a pipeline to achieve revenue targets
* Excellent organizational, analytical, written, and verbal communication skills
* Passion and knowledge about how new technologies can help better serve small and medium size businesses
* A track record of delivering measurable outcomes, driving adoption, and being perceived as a trusted advisor by clients.
* Experience within the Services or Beauty industry is preferred

jobs.title: Account Manager, Integrated Marketing
jobs.description:
**Job Overview**

Great work rarely falls apart because nobody cared. It falls apart in the spaces between people, disciplines, decisions, and deadlines. The Account Manager, Integrated Marketing is the person who closes those spaces and keeps complex client work organized, connected, and moving.

At Rocket Launch, one client initiative may bring together strategy, advertising, creative, digital marketing, public relations, media, web, social media, production, and a small constellation of outside partners. You will turn approved direction into clear plans, useful assignments, realistic timelines, and unmistakable next steps, so everyone knows what is happening, why it matters, and what they own.

You will work alongside Account Directors and discipline experts, applying the judgment of an experienced agency account manager to spot missing information, conflicting deadlines, unclear ownership, and handoffs that are quietly preparing to become tomorrow's emergency.

We are looking for someone proactive, practical, exceptionally organized, and enjoyable to work with. Someone who understands how integrated agency work comes together, brings calm to motion and clarity to complexity, and occasionally finds a smarter worksheet, cleaner Monday board, or better way to keep everyone aligned.

**What Will You Make Happen?**

* Manage the day\-to\-day coordination of multiple integrated marketing accounts and projects from kickoff through delivery, maintaining clear plans, timelines, milestones, dependencies, approvals, and next steps.
* Partner closely with Client Leaders to translate approved strategy, scopes, briefs, and priorities into organized workback schedules, clear assignments, and coordinated next steps for the right teams.
* Connect the work across marketing, advertising, creative, digital, public relations, media, web, social media, production, and outside partners, making sure handoffs happen and connected deliverables stay aligned.
* Coordinate and facilitate project kickoffs, status meetings, and client working sessions that earn their place on the calendar. Prepare the agenda, gather the facts, identify needed decisions, document actions and owners, and follow through.
* Maintain reliable account and project information and concise status updates so Client Leaders and project teams can quickly understand progress, priorities, decisions, risks, and next steps.
* Make sure assignments are truly ready before work begins, including the objective, deliverables, specifications, source materials, budget parameters, due dates, reviewers, and approval path.
* Manage the routing, review, feedback, approval, and delivery of briefs, copy, creative, web content, media materials, proofs, and final assets without allowing feedback to disappear into the mist.
* Coordinate approved work with printers, photographers, videographers, translators, media vendors, fabricators, installers, freelancers, and other production partners, including quotes, specifications, schedules, proofs, and delivery details.
* Track project scope, estimates, approved budgets, outside costs, and changing requirements. Understand the effect on timing and resources, then raise potential variances promptly with the appropriate Client Leader or business operations contact.
* Stay ahead of the work. Monitor risks, bottlenecks, dependencies, and competing deadlines; offer practical options and raise decisions when they fall outside your authority.
* Make day\-to\-day work easier to manage. When a shared worksheet, better Monday board, cleaner notes system, or simple workflow adjustment would reduce confusion or rework, set it up, recommend it, and help the team use it.
* Be a steady, generous teammate. Communicate respectfully, stay constructive when priorities shift, share what others need to know, and help people leave conversations clear about what happens next.

**What Will You Bring?**

* Four or more years of account management, client services, or closely related project\-management experience in an integrated agency environment.
* Demonstrated success coordinating multiple concurrent client accounts, multi\-channel campaigns, or integrated projects with overlapping teams, deadlines, approvals, and outside partners.
* A working understanding of how strategy, account service, creative development, copy, digital marketing, paid media, public relations, websites, social media, analytics, and production connect during delivery. You do not need to perform every discipline, but you should understand how the pieces affect one another.
* Strong command of agency account and project fundamentals, including briefing, workback schedules, milestones, dependencies, resource coordination, routing, approvals, risk tracking, scope awareness, and closeout.
* Exceptional organization and attention to detail, paired with the judgment to know which details matter most to timing, quality, scope, and the client experience.
* Excellent written communication. Your agendas are useful, your recaps are clear, your action lists identify owners, and your status reports tell people what they actually need to know.
* Confident, tactful verbal communication with clients, agency leaders, specialists, vendors, and partners. You can ask a direct question, surface a concern, and keep the relationship intact.
* A proactive, solutions\-oriented approach. You anticipate needs, investigate gaps, offer workable options, and follow through without waiting to be reminded.
* Experience coordinating creative or production vendors and managing specifications, quotes, proofs, schedules, deliveries, and final assets.
* Practical budget and scope awareness, including the ability to track estimates and outside costs and recognize when a request needs leadership review or a scope adjustment.
* Comfort in a fast\-moving, hands\-on agency where priorities can change, several disciplines may contribute to one outcome, and being unflappable is a genuine professional advantage.

Los Virtuality is a nationwide interactive entertainment rental company based in Los Angeles. We bring unforgettable fun to events of all types with our innovative attractions, including VR, Racing Simulators, Golf Simulators, LED Dance Floors, and other interactive solutions.

Our mission is to spark joy and encourage participation through technology\-driven entertainment. Whether it’s a corporate event, private party, or community festival, we create experiences people won’t forget.

We’re looking for individuals who are tech\-savvy, energetic, and thrive on making people smile. If you enjoy working with people of all ages, solving problems on the fly, and being part of something exciting, you might be the perfect fit for our team.

**Position Overview**

Los Virtuality is seeking a motivated and personable Part\-Time Sales Representative to support the growth of our interactive event entertainment business. This role focuses on identifying potential clients, responding to sales inquiries, building relationships, following up on leads, and converting opportunities into confirmed bookings.

The ideal candidate is confident in client communication, organized with follow\-ups, comfortable discussing event needs and pricing, and driven to meet sales goals. This individual should also be willing to learn Los Virtuality's services and equipment in order to confidently recommend the best event solutions for each client.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Respond to incoming sales inquiries and client requests in a timely, professional manner.

* Communicate with prospective clients by phone, email, and other approved platforms.

* Assess client needs and recommend appropriate entertainment options based on event type, audience, venue, and budget.
* Prepare and communicate quotes, proposals, and service information as directed
* Follow up consistently with prospects to move opportunities through the sales process.
* Maintain accurate records of leads, client communications, follow\-ups, and sales activity using Company\-approved systems.
* Coordinate with management and operations to confirm service availability and event requirements before finalizing commitments.
* Develop and maintain positive client relationships to encourage repeat business and referrals.
* Support sales initiatives, promotions, partnerships, and business development efforts.
* Meet established sales activity and performance expectations.
* Represent Los Virtuality professionally in all client and business interactions.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Valid driver’s license, clean driving record, and reliable transportation.
* Previous experience in sales, customer service, business development, hospitality, events, or a related field preferred.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Professional, personable, and comfortable speaking with prospective clients.
* Strong follow\-up and organizational skills.
* Ability to manage multiple leads and competing priorities.
* Comfortable learning new products, services, technology, and sales systems.
* Self\-motivated and able to work independently while maintaining communication with management.
* Experience within the events, entertainment, hospitality, or rental industry is a plus.

**Traits We Love**

* Friendly, cheerful, and outgoing with excellent communication skills.
* Punctuality, professionalism, strong communication, and problem\-solving ability.
* Reliable, proactive, and detail\-oriented.
* Enjoys working in fast\-paced, ever\-changing environments.
* Skilled in client relationship management, sales follow\-up, and closing.

* Professional Growth Opportunities – Develop sales, negotiation, client relationship, and business development skills.

**What Makes Us Different**

* Work with the latest and coolest simulator tech and interactive solutions.

jobs.description:
Outside Sales Representative – PCBA KING

**PCBA KING \| U.S. Field Sales**

**Pay:** $40,000–$60,000 per year

Job Description

PCBA KING is looking for a driven, competitive **Outside Sales Representative** to develop new business and grow our customer base across the U.S.

**This is a true boots\-on\-the\-ground outside sales position.** We are looking for someone who will literally **knock on doors, visit customers and prospects in person, follow up on leads, and hand\-deliver line cards and sales materials.**

This is **not an order\-taking or desk sales role.** We want a hunter who enjoys getting out into the market, meeting customers face\-to\-face, opening doors, and creating new business from scratch.

What You'll Do

* **Visit customers and prospective customers in person**
* **Knock on doors and introduce PCBA KING to new businesses**
* **Visit and qualify leads face\-to\-face**
* **Hand\-deliver line cards and sales materials**
* Prospect aggressively for new accounts within your territory
* Cold call, email, network, and prospect in person
* Connect with purchasing, procurement, engineering, operations, and supply\-chain professionals
* Develop relationships with OEMs, electronics manufacturers, technology companies, and other B2B customers
* Identify customer needs related to **PCB and PCBA manufacturing**
* Generate RFQ opportunities and work with our team to support customer requirements
* Follow up consistently and persistently with prospects
* Build and manage an active sales pipeline
* Turn cold prospects into long\-term customers
* Maintain and grow relationships after opening an account
* Take ownership of your territory and sales results

Who We're Looking For

We want a **true sales hunter** who is:

* Comfortable walking into a business and starting a conversation
* Willing to spend significant time in the field
* Persistent and comfortable hearing “no”
* Competitive, self\-motivated, and results\-driven
* Confident meeting new customers face\-to\-face
* Excellent at prospecting and follow\-up
* Able to build relationships from the ground up
* Organized and capable of managing a territory independently
* Professional in appearance and communication
* Focused on generating new business rather than waiting for inbound opportunities

Preferred Experience

Outside sales or business\-development experience is strongly preferred.

Experience selling **PCBs, PCB assemblies (PCBA), electronics manufacturing services (EMS), contract manufacturing, electronic components, or related technology products** is a major advantage.

Experience calling on **OEMs, electronics manufacturers, engineering teams, purchasing departments, procurement teams, and supply\-chain professionals** is highly valued.

What Success Looks Like

We are looking for someone who wakes up thinking about **where the next customer is coming from.**

You should be willing to get in your car, visit companies, knock on doors, deliver a line card, introduce **PCBA KING**, find the right decision\-maker, uncover an opportunity, generate RFQs, and keep following up until you earn the business.

**Find the opportunity. Open the door. Build the relationship. Win the business.**

How to Apply

Please submit your resume and tell us:

* What products or services you've sold
* Who you've sold to
* Your outside/field sales experience
* The U.S. territory or geographic market you know best
* Your experience with PCB, PCBA, EMS, or electronics manufacturing
* The largest new account you've personally opened

If you're a hunter who would rather be **in front of customers than sitting behind a desk**, we want to hear from you.

**Work Location:** In person / Field Sales

jobs.title: Office Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Office Operations Coordinator**



At Salas O’Brien we tell our clients that we’re engineered for impact. This passion for making a difference applies just as much to our team as it does to our projects. That’s why we’re committed to living our values every day: inspiring, achieving, and connecting as shared owners of our success with a focus on a sustainable future.



Building for the long\-term means that all of our team members can expect to work on amazing projects with a people\-first approach to problem solving. It also means that each member of our team has truly limitless potential to build a unique, meaningful, and high\-impact career—and they’ll receive great total rewards along the way.


### **About Us**



Founded in 1975, Salas O’Brien is an employee\-owned engineering and professional services firm focused on achieving impact for our clients, our team, and the world. We know that tomorrow’s requirements are today’s opportunities, and we are here to design lasting solutions for pressing challenges.



We work across a variety of industries providing integrated engineering and consulting services. Our specialized experience includes design for data centers, healthcare, science and technology, high\-rise buildings, clean energy, education, and other building types as well as structural and building sciences, infrastructure asset management, advanced robotics, and more.



Our technical expertise is paired with an exceptional team of business development, human resources, finance and accounting, information technology, and marketing professionals, all of whom play a key role in bringing our commitments to life every day.


### **Job Summary**



The Office Operations Coordinator provides administrative, operational, and project support to help ensure the efficient day\-to\-day functioning of the Tustin office. This role serves as a key resource for office operations, project administration, proposal support, and leadership coordination while helping maintain organized and effective business practices across the office.



What makes this role unique is the opportunity to work across many aspects of the business. The Office Operations Coordinator will collaborate closely with project teams, accounting, business development, and office leadership while helping ensure the office operates efficiently and team members have the support they need to be successful. The ideal candidate is highly organized, proactive, detail\-oriented, and capable of managing multiple priorities in a fast\-paced professional services environment.


### **Responsibilities**



Office Operations \& Administrative Support


* Coordinate day\-to\-day office operations to maintain an efficient and professional work environment.
* Manage office vendors, service providers, supplies, and facility\-related needs.
* Coordinate workspace setup, office access, equipment requests, and first\-day office logistics for new team members in partnership with Human Resources and hiring managers.
* Serve as a welcoming on\-site resource for team members and visitors, helping to foster a positive office experience.
* Coordinate office meetings, events, training sessions, and team activities.
* Maintain office records, files, and administrative procedures.
* Provide administrative and organizational support to office leadership, including meeting scheduling, document preparation, and special projects.


Project Administration Support


* Assist project teams with document control and project\-related administrative activities.
* Support the preparation, distribution, and tracking of project documents, including RFIs, submittals, meeting minutes, and action items.
* Maintain project records and assist with project documentation organization and filing.
* Coordinate internal project meetings and support follow\-up communication and action item tracking.


Regulatory \& Compliance Support


* Assist with project compliance documentation and tracking requirements.
* Support HCAI documentation and form management processes as directed by project teams.
* Maintain organized records and documentation associated with project requirements and regulatory submittals.


Proposal \& Business Support


* Assist with the preparation and coordination of proposals, qualifications packages, and client deliverables.
* Support marketing and business development efforts through document preparation, formatting, and information gathering.
* Help maintain project and company information used for proposals and presentations.


Project \& Financial Administration


* Support project setup and administrative activities within company systems.
* Assist with invoicing coordination, project tracking, and record management.
* Maintain accurate project documentation and supporting records.

### **Qualifications and Experience**


### **Required**


* Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
* 3\+ years of experience in office administration, operations coordination, project coordination, or a related support role.
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, including Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
* Demonstrated attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with multiple teams and stakeholders.
* Strong customer service mindset and professional demeanor.

### **Preferred**


* Experience supporting architecture, engineering, construction (AEC), consulting, or professional services organizations.
* Experience with project administration, document control, or construction administration processes.
* Familiarity with RFIs, submittals, meeting documentation, and project coordination practices.
* Experience supporting proposal preparation and client deliverables.
* Knowledge of HCAI documentation

jobs.title: Key Account Manager - Critical Industries
jobs.description:
At **ABB**, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

**This position reports to:**


Strategic Program Director
\_\_


In this role, you’ll develop, implement, and manage the strategy and relationship with assigned data center\-related accounts for the ABB Electrification (EL) business, specifically related to the Industry, Building and Channel (IBC) organization. The position will have significant cross\-functional responsibilities across the ABB EL. As the point person for the ABB IBC relationship within those accounts, this position is responsible for growing share of wallet, profitability, and elevating customer satisfaction. Coordinates executive relationships within the accounts, sets goals, tracks pipeline, organizes sales activities, monitors current projects, and manages the resolution of the strategic customer challenges.


The work model for the role is: remote (\#LI\-Remote) and willingness to travel as needed is required.

**Your role and responsibilities:**

* **Lead Strategic Account Planning:** Develop and implement account plans and Statements of Work (SoW) to drive growth across divisions and locations.
* **Drive Customer\-Centric Sales Strategy:** Understand key business drivers and risks (e.g., sustainability, digitalization, cybersecurity) to shape tailored sales strategies and targets.
* **Build Trusted Relationships:** Engage decision\-makers within data center organizations, delivering comprehensive ABB solutions aligned with customer needs and profitability goals.
* **Enable Competitive \& Coordinated Execution:** Monitor market trends and competitors, apply standardized sales tools (e.g., Salesforce), and ensure a unified approach to sales planning and issue resolution.

**Our Team Dynamics**


Our teams support each other, collaborate, and never stop learning. Everyone brings something unique, and together we push ideas forward to solve real problems. Being part of our team means your work matters \- because the progress we make here creates real impact out there.

**Qualifications for the role:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Marketing or related field and a minimum of 10 years of experience within the industry OR Associate’s degree and a minimum of 12 years of experience within the industry.
* Experience working with data center customers is a plus.
* Strong understanding of the Electrification products
* Proven ability to conduct market analysis and develop business plans with a structured, strategic mindset; experienced in building strong relationships with electrical contractors, distributors, and channel partners. Brings a technical background (preferably in the data center market), strong communication skills, and an agile, collaborative leadership style that fosters teamwork and innovation.
* Solid technical understanding of 3\-phase AC power systems including, but not limited to: medium and low voltage switchgear, medium and low voltage motor control centers, switchboards, panelboards, and ancillary electrical distribution products and experience with quoting projects for contractors  

Solid technical understanding and field sales experience selling power monitoring and control software, associated metering and communications systems, direct current, and battery energy storage/microgrid solutions.
* Candidates must already have work authorization that would permit them to work for ABB in the US.

**What's in it for you**

We empower you to take initiative, challenge ideas, and lead with confidence. You’ll grow through meaningful work, continuous learning, and support that’s tailored to your goals. Every idea you share and every action you take contributes to something bigger


ABB is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer for protected Veterans and Individuals with Disabilities at ABB.


All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their\- sex (gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation), marital status, citizenship, age, race and ethnicity, inclusive of traits historically associated with race or ethnicity, including but not limited to hair texture and protective hairstyles, color, religious creed, national origin, pregnancy, physical or mental disability, genetic information, protected Veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal and state law.


For more information regarding your (EEO) rights as an applicant, please visit the following websites: https://www.eeoc.gov/sites/default/files/2023\-06/22\-088\_EEOC\_KnowYourRights6\.12ScreenRdr.pdf

You may request reasonable accommodations by calling an ABB HR Representative at 1\-888\-694\-7762 or by sending an email to US\-AskHR@abb.com. Resumes and applications will not be accepted in this manner.

jobs.title: Inside Sales Representative – B2B Appointment Setting
jobs.description:
**Location:** Irvine, CA

**Job Type:** Part\-Time (with opportunity to transition to Full\-Time)

**Schedule:** Monday–Friday, approximately 4 hours per day (16–20 hours/week)

**Pay:** $18–$20/hour (based on experience) \+ Performance Bonus \+ Commission

**About Us**

We are an Irvine\-based company providing Advertising \& Marketing, Commercial Signage, Branding, Printing, Video Production, and Trade Show Exhibit solutions to businesses throughout Southern California.

We are looking for an energetic and persistent B2B Inside Sales / Appointment Setter who is comfortable making outbound calls, speaking with business owners and decision\-makers, and developing new sales opportunities.

The core of this position is simple:

Call → Reach the Decision Maker → Identify Needs → Qualify the Opportunity → Schedule an Appointment → Follow Up

Qualified opportunities will be supported by our Sales and Project teams through proposals, site visits, and closing.

**Key Responsibilities**

1\. Make outbound calls to prospective business clients using company\-provided lead lists and market resources.

2\. Use phone, email, LinkedIn, and other channels to initiate conversations with potential B2B clients.

3\. Connect with business owners, managers, marketing teams, operations managers, property managers, and other relevant decision\-makers.

4\. Introduce our services, including:

(1\) Advertising \& Marketing

(2\) Social Media \& Content Creation

(3\) Video Production

(4\) Commercial Signage

(5\) Storefront \& Lobby Signs

(6\) Interior Branding \& Wall Graphics

(7\) Commercial Printing \& Event Displays

(8\) Trade Show Booths \& Exhibits

5\. Identify potential needs such as new business openings, signage projects, renovations, rebranding, marketing campaigns, social media content, events, and trade shows.

6\. Qualify potential opportunities and schedule phone calls, Zoom meetings, client meetings, or site visits for the Sales team.

7\. Maintain accurate records of conversations, client needs, and follow\-up status.

8\. Consistently follow up with previous leads and identify new sales opportunities.

**Qualifications**

1\. Comfortable with Cold Calling and speaking with new business prospects.

2\. Strong English speaking and telephone communication skills.

3\. Experience in Telesales, Inside Sales, Telemarketing, Appointment Setting, Customer Service, or Business Development is preferred.

4\. Persistent and comfortable following up multiple times when appropriate.

5\. Self\-motivated and able to work toward clear activity and sales goals.

6\. B2B Sales, Advertising, Marketing, Signage, Printing, Trade Show, Event, or related industry experience is a plus.

**Compensation \& Schedule**

**Starting Position:** Part\-Time

**Schedule:** Monday–Friday

**Hours:** Approximately 16–20 hours per week

**Base Pay:** $18–$20/hour, depending on experience

**Additional Compensation:** Performance\-Based Bonus \+ Sales Commission

Additional compensation may be earned based on qualified opportunities, appointments, and closed sales.

**How We Measure Success**

We care about call activity, but results matter more than simply making a high number of calls.

Performance will be evaluated based on the sales pipeline you help create:

Meaningful Conversations → Qualified Leads → Appointments → Quotes → Closed Sales

**Who We're Looking For**

We are not looking for someone who simply wants to complete a daily call quota.

We want someone who is comfortable picking up the phone, starting conversations with new businesses, following up consistently, and turning cold prospects into real sales opportunities.

This is not a passive customer service position.

If you enjoy talking to people, aren't afraid of cold calling, and want the opportunity to increase your income through performance, we'd like to hear from you.

Pay: $18\.00 \- $20\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 16\.0 – 20\.0 per week

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Irvine, CA 92612

jobs.title: Hybrid Digital Marketing & Social Media Creator
jobs.description:
**Job Overview**

We are looking for a “doer” who can take an idea and turn it into content, a campaign, and ultimately new customers. Dedicated and sincere Type A team member.  
We are looking for a **creative, tech\-savvy, results\-oriented Digital Marketing \& Social Media Creator** to help grow our Montessori Preschool and Tutoring Academy and Business.

This is a **hybrid role** combining social media management, digital marketing, content creation, advertising, and day\-to\-day digital support.

We are seeking a dynamic and innovative Hybrid Digital Marketing \& Social Media Creator to elevate our brand presence across multiple digital platforms. This role combines strategic content creation, social media management, and digital campaign execution to engage audiences and drive measurable results. The ideal candidate is passionate about digital marketing trends, skilled in content development, and proficient in leveraging various advertising tools to maximize reach and impact. Join us to craft compelling narratives, optimize campaigns for performance, and contribute to our growth in a fast\-paced, creative environment.

**Duties**

* Develop and implement engaging social media strategies across platforms such as Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, and Tiktok to increase brand awareness and audience engagement.
* Create high\-quality visual content using Canva and graphic design principles that align with brand identity.
* Manage website content and updates through WordPress or other content management systems to ensure fresh, relevant information.
* Plan, execute, and optimize paid advertising campaigns using Google Ads, Facebook Advertising, SEM (Search Engine Marketing), and paid search marketing techniques.
* Conduct keyword research and utilize SEO tools to enhance organic visibility; optimize website content for SEO best practices.
* Monitor campaign performance through web analytics reporting tools like Google Analytics and Google Tag Manager; analyze data to inform ongoing strategy adjustments.
* Coordinate email marketing campaigns using marketing automation platforms to nurture leads and maintain customer engagement.
* Implement conversion optimization strategies by analyzing user behavior data to improve landing pages and call\-to\-actions for better results.
* Track digital marketing metrics regularly to evaluate campaign success; prepare comprehensive reports on web analytics and marketing performance.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams on digital campaign setup, content management, and social media advertising campaigns to ensure cohesive messaging.

**Skills**

* Manage and grow our **Facebook, Instagram, Google Business Profile, and other social media accounts**
* Create engaging, creative content for social media that increases **reach, engagement, leads, and enrollment**
* Design professional flyers, posts, reels, stories, newsletters, and promotional materials using **Canva**
* Create content that has the potential to **go viral and increase brand awareness**
* Manage and optimize **Facebook/Instagram Ads and Google Ads**
* Monitor advertising performance, leads, clicks, conversions, and ROI
* Develop monthly social media and marketing content calendars
* Write engaging captions, newsletters, email campaigns, and promotional content
* Create and edit short\-form videos/reels for Instagram and Facebook
* Maintain and improve our digital presence across Google and social platforms
* Help with website updates, digital forms, links, tracking, and other online tools
* Work with CRM and marketing platforms such as **GoHighLevel**
* Track leads and help improve the process from **inquiry → consultation → enrollment**
* Research trends, competitors, hashtags, and new digital marketing strategies
* Identify opportunities to increase preschool enrollment and tutoring clients
* Provide creative ideas for promotions, campaigns, events, and community outreach

Ideal Candidate

We are looking for someone who:

* Is **highly creative and proactive**
* Has strong knowledge of **Canva**
* Understands **social media marketing and content strategy**
* Has experience with **Facebook/Instagram Ads and Google Ads**
* Can create attractive graphics and engaging video content
* Understands what makes content **engaging and shareable**
* Has excellent written English and can write compelling captions and newsletters
* Is comfortable learning and managing different digital platforms
* Is organized and able to manage multiple projects independently
* Understands basic analytics and can identify what is working and what needs improvement
* Has experience with **preschools, education, childcare, local businesses, or service\-based businesses** — a plus
* Is willing to take ownership and bring new ideas rather than simply waiting for instructions

Position

**Hybrid — Part\-Time or Full\-Time**

The ideal person will be someone who can become our **go\-to digital marketing person** and help manage the digital side of the business from content creation to advertising to lead generation.

Join us as a Hybrid Digital Marketing \& Social Media Creator to harness your creativity and technical expertise—driving impactful campaigns that resonate globally!

Pay: $18\.00 \- $22\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 5\.0 – 36\.0 per week

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Paid time off
* Professional development assistance
* Referral program
* Tuition reimbursement

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Irvine, CA 92606
