jobs.title: Shopify E-Commerce Specialist (SEO & Digital Marketing)
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

We are is seeking a hands\-on **Shopify E\-Commerce Specialist** to support and grow our direct\-to\-consumer (DTC) e\-commerce business.

Our company currently has an established Amazon business and is expanding our Shopify independent website as an important sales and brand\-building channel.

We are looking for someone who can **independently handle the day\-to\-day operation and optimization of a Shopify store**, including product management, SEO, keyword research, digital advertising, email marketing, website optimization, and performance analysis.

This is a hands\-on execution role. The ideal candidate should be comfortable actually working inside Shopify, Google, Meta, Klaviyo, and other e\-commerce platforms rather than only coordinating with agencies or outside vendors.

**Responsibilities**

Shopify Store Operations

* Independently manage the daily operation of our Shopify store
* Create and update products, collections, pricing, promotions, bundles, and website content
* Optimize product pages, collection pages, landing pages, and navigation
* Manage Shopify apps and integrations
* Update homepage banners, promotional content, and seasonal campaigns
* Improve mobile and desktop shopping experiences
* Monitor website issues and troubleshoot basic Shopify problems
* Coordinate product launches and promotional campaigns
* Implement upselling, cross\-selling, bundles, and other strategies to improve sales
* Continuously improve website conversion and overall customer experience

SEO \& Keyword Optimization

* Conduct keyword research for products, collections, landing pages, and website content
* Identify high\-value and relevant search terms
* Optimize product titles, descriptions, URLs, meta titles, meta descriptions, headings, images, and alt text
* Improve internal linking and website structure
* Optimize product and collection pages for Google search
* Monitor organic traffic, keyword rankings, impressions, clicks, and CTR
* Identify and fix basic technical SEO issues
* Monitor indexing and coverage through Google Search Console
* Conduct competitor keyword and SEO research
* Support content and blog development based on search demand

Experience with **SEMrush, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog, or similar SEO tools** is preferred.

Google Ads \& Google Shopping

* Create, monitor, and optimize Google Ads campaigns
* Assist with Search, Shopping, Performance Max, and remarketing campaigns
* Conduct paid\-search keyword research
* Monitor search terms and negative keywords
* Manage and optimize Google Merchant Center product feeds
* Troubleshoot product\-feed errors and disapprovals
* Monitor advertising performance including ROAS, CPA, CPC, CTR, and conversions
* Adjust campaigns based on performance data

Meta Ads

* Create and optimize Facebook and Instagram advertising campaigns
* Assist with prospecting and retargeting campaigns
* Manage audiences and product catalog campaigns
* Monitor Meta Pixel and conversion tracking
* Test advertising creatives, copy, audiences, and offers
* Track ROAS, CPA, CTR, conversion rate, and other performance metrics
* Identify opportunities to improve advertising efficiency

Email \& SMS Marketing

* Manage email and SMS marketing through **Klaviyo**
* Create and send promotional email campaigns
* Build and optimize automated flows, including Welcome, Abandoned Cart, Browse Abandonment, Post\-Purchase, Cross\-Sell, and Win\-Back flows
* Create customer segments for targeted marketing
* Monitor open rates, click rates, conversion rates, and email\-generated revenue
* Assist with customer retention and repeat\-purchase strategies

Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO)

* Monitor and improve website conversion rate
* Analyze customer behavior and identify areas where customers drop off
* Optimize product pages, landing pages, cart experience, and calls\-to\-action
* Test different layouts, product messaging, images, promotions, bundles, and offers
* Assist with A/B testing
* Use data to recommend and implement website improvements

Analytics \& Reporting

Work with platforms including:

**Shopify Analytics**  Google Analytics 4 (GA4\) **Google Search Console**  Google Merchant Center **Google Ads**  Meta Ads Manager **Klaviyo**  SEMrush / Ahrefs **Amazon**

Monitor key performance indicators including:

* Website Traffic
* Organic Traffic
* Sales Revenue
* Conversion Rate (CVR)
* Average Order Value (AOV)
* Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC)
* Cost Per Acquisition (CPA)
* Return on Ad Spend (ROAS)
* Click\-Through Rate (CTR)
* Keyword Rankings
* Email/SMS Performance
* Repeat Purchase Rate

The candidate should be comfortable analyzing data and using it to make practical improvements to the website and marketing campaigns.

Amazon Support

Our company currently operates an established Amazon sales channel while expanding our Shopify DTC business.

This position will primarily focus on **Shopify and DTC growth**, but may also assist with Amazon\-related work when needed.

Responsibilities may include:

* Updating Amazon product listings
* Keyword research and listing optimization
* Assisting with Amazon Advertising
* Reviewing Amazon sales and advertising performance
* Coordinating product information and promotions between Amazon and Shopify
* Using successful Amazon products and keyword data to support Shopify growth

Experience with **Amazon Seller Central and Amazon Advertising** is preferred but not required.

Qualifications

* 2\+ years of e\-commerce or digital marketing experience preferred
* Hands\-on Shopify experience
* Experience operating or supporting a DTC e\-commerce website
* Knowledge of SEO and keyword research
* Familiarity with Google Analytics 4 (GA4\)
* Familiarity with Google Search Console
* Familiarity with Google Merchant Center
* Experience with Google Ads and/or Meta Ads
* Experience with Klaviyo or similar email marketing platforms
* Understanding of Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO)
* Ability to analyze websit

jobs.description:
Infinite Electronics is a leading global supplier of electronic components, serving engineers’ urgent needs through a family of highly recognized and trusted brands. Our core mission is to support those requirements with an extensive offering of RF, industrial, and connectivity solutions. Same\-day shipping, broad inventory selection, and 24/7 service are all part of what makes Infinite Electronics go. This simple, essential belief in positive urgency is the DNA that drives our business.
  
  

We are actively seeking a customer\-focused Strategic Inside Sales Representative I with a talent for quickly and effectively building customer rapport. This role plays a critical part in assisting customers with urgent product\-based needs while supporting revenue growth and delivering a best\-in\-class customer experience. The position reports directly to the Senior Strategic Inside Sales Manager and works closely with customer service, operation, and technical sales support teams in a collaborative, fast\-paced environment.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
Handle a high volume of customer interactions, including calls, chats, and emails, while processing orders during live conversations with Regional Sales Managers, field reps and end customers.
  
Demonstrate strong multitasking skills to address customer inquiries efficiently and provide real\-time assistance.
  
Generate and deliver real\-time quotes to customers with a strong understanding of product pricing and offerings.
  
Ensure accuracy and quality in pricing information while maintaining Infinite Electronics’ commitment to same\-day responsiveness.
  
Identify and understand customer buying needs by using effective questioning techniques to uncover requirements and preferences.
  
Exercise sound business judgment to determine when additional support or escalation is needed.
  
Make outbound calls to follow up on sales inquiries and quotes, perform customer discovery, and discuss additional product recommendations based on buying history.
  
Maintain customer satisfaction and loyalty during difficult interactions by using strong conflict resolution skills to deliver an excellent customer experience.
  
Communicate and collaborate cross\-functionally to provide accurate, up\-to\-date information internally and externally.
  
Gather critical information that supports continuous improvement of the customer experience and informs company strategy.
  
Adhere to established sales processes and guidelines to ensure consistency and quality in service delivery.
  
Participate in ongoing training and development to strengthen customer service and sales capabilities.
  
Meet daily qualitative and quantitative targets and contribute to overall service, productivity, and quality objectives.
  
Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities
  
Demonstrate Infinite Electronics’ Hedgehog behaviors of Positive Urgency, Accountability, Ownership, Same\-Day Responsiveness, Collaboration, and Solution Orientation.
  
Commitment to achieving and exceeding sales targets, with a focus on measurable results and overall sales success.
  
Ability to communicate ideas clearly and persuasively, both verbally and in writing, to convey the value of products and services effectively.
  
Strong active listening skills to understand customer needs and tailor solutions accordingly.
  
Strong problem\-solving skills to address customer challenges and objections effectively and turn them into sales opportunities.
  
Adaptability to different customer personalities, industries, and changing market conditions in order to tailor sales strategies for maximum effectiveness.
  
Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, and Outlook, with the ability to work across multiple systems concurrently, including a CCaaS platform.
  
Power BI and CRM usage will be heavy and necessary to build reports, analysis and tract opportunities, sales growth, quotes etc..
  
Ability to learn new concepts quickly and adapt to a changing, fast\-paced environment.
  
Strong work ethic and collaborative mindset that contributes to a culture of teamwork.
  
Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple opportunities simultaneously.
  
Education and Experience
  
1\+ years of experience in a fast\-paced, customer\-facing sales or service environment.
  
Demonstrated track record of meeting or exceeding established sales quotas.
  
Experience working across multiple brands and navigating internal systems, including Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems, is preferred.
  
High school diploma required; college degree preferred.
  
Technology\-related B2B experience preferred.
  
Physical Job Requirements
  
This role requires repetitive motion and routine use of standard office equipment such as computers, telephones, copiers, and scanners. The position also requires prolonged periods of sitting at a desk.
  
  

Environment
  
Work is typically performed in an office environment during normal or extended business hours. This position requires a minimum of two days per week in the office. Infinite Electronics continually reviews its deployment and work environment policies, which are subject to change at any time to meet business needs, including a potential requirement to work on\-site up to three days per week.

So, if you're excited about this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every single qualification in the job description, nobody’s perfect – and we encourage you to apply. * Attend meetings you’ve scheduled and conduct routine check\-ins with your Sales Consultant to receive feedback on the opportunities you have created.
* Execute a follow\-up strategy on prospects that were not interested but maybe in the future or were interested but did not buy.

* Performs other duties as assigned

Minimal

* Work in clean, pleasant, and comfortable office or home setting. jobs.title: Talent Development Program Specialist
jobs.description:
**Human Interest is on a mission to ensure that people in all lines of work have access to retirement benefits.**



More than half of all working Americans are not saving enough for their future. Too often, it's because they are employed by a company that doesn't offer a retirement plan. Human Interest is changing that by making it affordable and accessible for small and medium\-sized businesses to offer employees a path to financial independence through retirement savings.



We're a high\-growth fintech company changing the retirement industry. We are backed by a number of investors. This includes funding from Marshall Wace and Baillie Gifford, as well as top investors such as BlackRock, TPG (The Rise Fund), SoftBank, Glynn Capital, NewView Capital, USVP, Wing, Uncork, and more.


**About the role**



As a Talent Development Program Specialist, you will play a key role in designing, building, and executing modern learning programs at Human Interest. You will act as both an instructional designer and an engaging facilitator, mixing strategy with storytelling to create resources, processes, and experiences that shape careers and drive our high\-performance culture.



We are looking for someone who is tech\-forward—who actively leverages modern AI tools to streamline content creation, elevate slide presentations, and scale enablement across the entire employee lifecycle.


**What you get to do every day**


**Tech\-Forward Instructional Design and Content Creation**


* Design and build contemporary, self\-led e\-learning modules, on\-demand micro\-learning assets, training guides, facilitator materials, and slide decks.
* Actively leverage AI tools to write scripts, generate visual assets, draft assessments, and accelerate instructional design.
* Document processes and update People Team resources in our intranet (Confluence).
* Build structured project proposals and training deployment plans that clearly articulate learning objectives, target outcomes, and agile rollout strategies.
* Uphold Human Interest's brand consistently through communications and experiences.
* Assess feedback and internal data to enhance, expand, change and/or adapt our offerings and ways of doing things.

jobs.description:
### **About Parametrix**



Parametrix is a 100% employee\-owned consulting firm helping clients deliver resilient infrastructure, vibrant and livable communities, and environmentally sustainable solutions. We are a team of professional construction managers, engineers, management consultants, planners, scientists, and surveyors dedicated to delivering outstanding client service. We build lasting partnerships and collaborate with our clients to envision possibilities and create tomorrow, together.



Recognized as a top workplace, we're committed to a culture that values work\-life balance, professional growth, and the well\-being of our people.

### **About the Opportunity**



We are looking for a Marketing Coordinator to join our Southwest Region team. In this role, you will support marketing and proposal efforts that help grow Parametrix's presence across the region.



You will work closely with technical teams, regional leaders, and other Parametrix marketing professionals to develop high\-quality, client\-focused proposals and qualification packages. Pursuits will range in size and complexity; however, this position will primarily coordinate smaller and mid\-sized opportunities and provide support on larger, more complex pursuits led by senior marketing professionals.



This is an opportunity for an organized, collaborative marketing professional to contribute to meaningful project wins while continuing to grow their skills in proposal development, pursuit coordination, and professional services marketing.



This position will follow a hybrid schedule and work from one of our Parametrix Southwest offices located in Albuquerque, Las Vegas, Salt Lake City, San Diego, or San Francisco. The role will include a combination of in\-office and remote work, allowing for flexibility while supporting collaboration and connection with regional teams.


**Your Role on the Team**



As a member of the Southwest Region marketing team, you will:


* Coordinate responses to RFQs, RFPs, statements of qualifications, and related marketing materials.
* Develop proposal schedules, outlines, compliance matrices, and production plans to help teams meet submission requirements and deadlines.
* Collaborate with technical staff and pursuit leaders to gather information and develop clear, compelling, and client\-focused content.
* Write, edit, format, and proofread proposal materials for consistency, accuracy, readability, and compliance.
* Support the development of win themes, differentiators, project descriptions, resumes, and other pursuit content.
* Coordinate proposal reviews, team meetings, document production, and final submission activities.
* Create and update marketing collateral, presentations, resumes, project descriptions, and other qualifications materials.
* Maintain accurate pursuit, client, and project information in the CRM system and other marketing databases.
* Track upcoming opportunities, pursuit activities, deadlines, outcomes, and related reporting information.


**What You Bring to the Team**



The ideal candidate brings:


* 4\+ years of experience in proposal coordination, marketing, communications, or business development, preferably within engineering, construction, or professional services industry.
* Experience coordinating RFQ, RFP, and statement of qualifications responses.
* Proficiency in Adobe InDesign and Microsoft Word.
* Strong writing, editing, proofreading, and document\-production skills.
* Strong organization and time\-management skills, with the ability to coordinate multiple deadlines and priorities.
* Attention to detail and the ability to interpret and follow solicitation requirements.
* A collaborative, proactive, and client\-service\-focused approach.

### **Why Join Parametrix?**


**Employee Ownership \& Great Benefits:** As a 100% employee\-owned company, you will share in and contribute to Parametrix's success. You will earn stock in your Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP) account and be an important contributor to our collective achievements.



Our Benefits include:


* Comprehensive Healthcare (medical, dental, vision, short\- \& long\-term disability insurance)
* Employee Stock Ownership Plan (financial profit sharing)
* Performance\-based bonuses
* 401(k) Plan
* Paid Time Off (both vacation \& sick/wellness time accruals)
* Paid Holidays
* Parental Bonding Leave


**Exciting, Award\-Winning Project Work:** Our work earns recognition for its innovation and positive impact on communities, giving you the opportunity to contribute to projects that make a difference. Learn more at https://www.parametrix.com/our\-work/


**Flexible Work Arrangements:** We understand the importance of work\-life balance and offer flexible work arrangements to support our employee\-owners' diverse needs. Whether it is hybrid, remote, or in\-office, we provide options that allow you to work in a way that best suits your lifestyle while staying connected and engaged with your team.


Compensation is determined by factors such as education, experience, location, and role. As employee\-owners, we are eligible for performance\-based bonuses and our salaries are reviewed annually. We value transparency and look forward to discussing our compensation structure.

jobs.description:
**Note: Please apply via email and follow the Application Instructions below. Please do not apply on Indeed.**

***Application Deadline: September 22, 2026 \| Desired start date: October 2026***

Greater Farallones Association (GFA) is a 501(c)(3\) nonprofit organization and the primary nonprofit partner to NOAA’s Greater Farallones and Cordell Bank National Marine Sanctuaries. GFA conducts joint research, conservation, and education to support healthy, resilient ecosystems along 210 miles of California’s north\-central coast. GFA has 30 staff members and an annual operating budget of approximately $5 million, and is co\-located with Sanctuary staff in a historic building on Crissy Field in the Presidio.

**Position Overview**

GFA seeks a **Program Operations Coordinator** to run the day\-to\-day operations of a growing coastal resilience program spanning multiple state and federal grants, partners, and deliverables. Supervised by the Coastal Resilience Program Lead, this role is responsible for building and maintaining the structure that keeps projects on track and teams aligned.

We’re looking for someone who takes ownership, builds systems, and keeps work moving in a complex, fast\-paced environment. The right candidate is organized, resourceful, and motivated by helping a team operate more effectively.

Beyond operations, the Coordinator will contribute from day one to drafting deliverables, synthesizing project information, and preparing management\-facing communications, including progress reports, presentations, and summaries that translate technical work for agency partners and stakeholders. A background in coastal, environmental, or marine science is an asset: the ability to accurately distill scientific findings, ask questions of project scientists, and recognize what matters to resource managers will make this person effective quickly and central to how the program communicates its work.

**Job Duties**

* Own tracking of deliverables, deadlines, reporting requirements, and follow\-up across multiple concurrent grants and projects
* Build and maintain program trackers, calendars, and internal systems that create visibility, accountability, and smooth day\-to\-day execution
* Coordinate meetings with project partners, agencies, and stakeholders, including scheduling, agenda preparation, notes, and follow\-up on action items
* Coordinate the North\-central California Coastal Sediment Coordination Committee, including scheduling, communications, and meeting preparation
* Prepare first drafts of progress reports, presentations, slide decks, meeting summaries, and other management\-facing materials
* Synthesize information across projects into clear, accessible internal and external communications
* Identify gaps, bottlenecks, or tasks at risk and proactively propose solutions to keep work moving
* Communicate across an interdisciplinary team of scientists, consultants, agency partners, and community stakeholders on behalf of the Program Lead
* Draft deliverables and synthesize project findings across grants, with growing ownership of management\-facing products

**Minimum Qualifications**

* 3\+ years of experience coordinating or managing complex, multi\-stakeholder projects, ideally in a nonprofit, government, consulting, or applied research setting
* Background in coastal, environmental, or marine science, with experience translating technical findings for non\-technical audiences
* Experience developing or improving systems, workflows, or tracking tools that increase team efficiency and organization
* Demonstrated ability to identify issues, gaps, or risks in projects and take initiative to address them
* Strong writing skills, with the ability to produce clear, structured drafts of reports, presentations, or summaries, including distilling technical or scientific material for non\-technical readers
* Proven ability to manage multiple workstreams, track deadlines, and follow through on deliverables in a fast\-paced environment
* Experience working with interdisciplinary teams and communicating across scientists, partners, or stakeholders
* High level of organization, reliability, and ownership, with the ability to operate independently and proactively

**Preferred Qualifications** 

* Experience supporting or managing federal or state grant\-funded projects, including reporting and deliverables
* Experience using or building project management tools or systems
* Experience synthesizing technical or scientific information into accessible materials for broader audiences
* Experience working in small, fast\-moving teams where roles evolve over time
* Familiarity with coastal or environmental data workflows, field logistics, or science project management is a plus

**Administrative Requirements**

* Pass a mandatory federal background check and defensive driving course
* Have a valid driver’s license, proof of automobile insurance, a clean driving record, and access to reliable transportation to and from the office in the Presidio, San Francisco
* Candidates must hold legal authorization to work in the United States without organizational sponsorship now or in the future. GFA is unable to offer work visa sponsorship

**Employee Status and Benefits** 

This position may be worked at either 32 or 40 hours per week, based on the successful candidate’s preference, with an estimated start date of October 1, 2026\. The role is hybrid, with an estimated 4 days per month requirement onsite at 991 Marine Drive on Crissy Field in San Francisco, CA. The majority of the working schedule can be completed remotely. For these reasons, the position must be locally based with the ability to travel to San Francisco for scheduled meetings. The organization will not reimburse out\-of\-area employees to commute to this location.

jobs.description:
**About Avive:**

Avive Solutions, Inc. (https://avive.life) is a growth stage Automated External Defibrillator (AED) company with a connected response system that is rapidly gaining market share. We are a mission driven team that is quite literally saving lives. Sudden Cardiac Arrest (SCA) is a leading cause of death in the United States, and we are on a mission to change that! We are a dynamic organization that builds elegant, creative solutions to solve complex problems. Ultimately, our mission is for all cardiac arrest victims to have rapid access to life\-saving defibrillation.

Avive is taking a fresh approach to addressing this decades\-old problem by innovating AED technology, coupled with a first\-of\-its\-kind software platform solution to enable a quicker and more streamlined response to SCA emergencies. We believe that this unique combination of deploying advanced – yet still accessible – hardware, and software, has the potential to revolutionize out\-of\-hospital cardiac arrest response and massively impact SCA survival rates.

Check out this short video that shows a glimpse of how our team is working to re\-think cardiac arrest response and save lives! https://www.youtube.com/watch?v\=2p4zfOWo62E

Learn more about working at Avive: https://avive.life/careers/

Field Equipment Management

* Maintain organized storage areas and conduct periodic inventory audits to ensure accuracy.
* Coordinate inbound and outbound shipments for Marketing, Sales, and channel partners, maintaining accurate tracking information.

* Support outbound and return shipping for events and field activations.

* Attend trade shows and other in\-person marketing events to support the commercial team and engage prospects.
* Assemble event kits and activation materials.
* Support field activations, CPR/AED trainings, customer events, product demonstrations, and event logistics.
* Represent Avive professionally while supporting customers, prospects, and partners at events.

* Fulfill marketing requests from Sales and support preparation of materials for meetings, trainings, and customer presentations.
* Coordinate printing and production of marketing collateral and swag.
* Maintain marketing storage areas and organizational systems.

* 1–3 years of experience in event coordination, marketing operations, field marketing, logistics, or a related role.
* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, Event Management, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and Google Workspace.
* Willingness to travel approximately 15–25% for trade shows and field events.

### **Bonus Points For:**

* Experience supporting trade shows, conferences, field marketing programs, or customer events.
* Experience coordinating inventory, shipping, fulfillment, or equipment logistics.
* Experience coordinating vendors, shipments, or event logistics across multiple stakeholders.
* Familiarity with project management tools such as Asana.
* Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills with a customer\-service mindset.
* Self\-motivated with the ability to work independently and proactively solve problems.
* Flexible and adaptable in a fast\-paced environment with changing priorities.
* Experience working with CRM or marketing platforms such as Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar systems.

Office**Job Description**


The Account Manager (AM) is a key commercial role within the Chromatography and Mass Spectrometry Division (CMD) of Thermo Fisher Scientific. This is an Account focused role with the primary responsibility for selling and supporting all CMD products. This role maintains effective and long\-lasting customer relationships, develops opportunities for strategic growth of the account and works collaboratively and effectively to bring extraordinary support and customer experience, making it easier for our customers to do business with Thermo Fisher Scientific. The AM is the primary point of contact and provides sales expertise and drives all CMD commercial activities within the account.

**Major end market focus areas include:**

* Analytical Science account examples: Pharma QA/QC, Environmental, Industrial, food safety, and Healthcare. Product
* competency is required, for the (relevant) CMD product offering.
* Scientific Research account examples: Academic, Pharmaceutical R\&D/drug development and BioPharma R\&D. Product
* competency is required for the (relevant) CMD product offering
* The Portfolio AM will be handling both Scientific Research and Analytical Science accounts

**Key Responsibilities:**  

**Selling Agility**

* Identifies and prioritizes new client opportunities and develops solution implementation and growth strategies.
* Increase share of wallet within existing accounts by identifying under penetrated areas, demonstrating CMD’s value proposition, designing the appropriate solution, and closure of opportunities.
* Leads and cultivates account relationships to drive expansion and renewals across the full CMD portfolio (analytical instruments, consumables, services); provides product assistance, consultation, and problem solving to customers as vital and expedites orders.
* Identifies, documents and confirms the best technology choice to meet the customer needs.
* Provides quotation, negotiates contracts and closes orders with end users as well as purchasing departments and supports all procurement processes.
* Applies data and metrics to develop and report on account development strategies and tactics.
* Adaptable to customers’ needs, as well as to conditions and trends that affect them and work independently to lead customer relationships.

**Results Leadership**

* Expands current account penetration and share of wallet. Grows organically, broader and deeper with all primary products. Leverages cross\-sell motions and activities.
* Leads direction for the territory; Develops sales strategies to meet plan and expand business within assigned territory; Maintains pipeline of opportunities to meet or exceed all quarterly sales objectives.
* Uses Thermo Fisher Scientific’s sales tools to effectively handle accounts, opportunities, pipelines and forecast in an accurate and timely manner.
* Maintains awareness of competitor and industry activity. Introduces new products and services as available.

**Technical Knowledge**

* Leads partnership and coordination with (technical) sales\-/ field application\-/ lab application/ and IES specialists (as well as any other internal partner) to provide technical expertise
* Attends and runs technical business presentations, and when required, trade shows, user meetings and other customer events; Positively always represents Thermo Fisher Scientific throughout customer locations
* Exchanges of account information and Sales Leads within and across Thermo Fisher Scientific commercial divisions
* Works adeptly in a team selling environment engaging the best internal company resources to address customer challenges
* Proficiency in analyzing sales data, market trends, customer behavior, and financial metrics to create accurate financial projections and revenue forecasts.
* Experience in developing and adjusting sales forecasts based on historical data, market trends, sales pipeline information, and changing market conditions.

**Minimum Requirements/Qualifications:**

* 3\+ years of validated sales experience preferred in analytical instrument markets, with a track record of achieving sales targets and driving revenue growth.
* Bachelor’s degree in the sciences or equivalent work experience
* Strong market knowledge and professional network.
* Experience in conducting on site customer seminars and technical presentations.
* Commercial mentality, strongly motivated by desire to win new business, with shown steadfast pursuit of opportunities
* Strong interpersonal, oral and written communication, and presentation skills
* Fluent in English and Spanish as need in the assigned region
* Confirmed commercial excellence working in matrix environment
* Computer proficiency in MS Office, CRM
* Ability to explain and sell the technical aspects of Thermo Fisher Scientific’s scientific product portfolio
* Ability to travel to customer locations up to 80% including overnight travel
* Demonstrate Thermo Fisher Scientific values – Integrity, Intensity, Innovation and Involvement

**Compensation and Benefits**


The salary range estimated for this position based in California is $90,750\.00–$116,650\.00\.
This position may also be eligible to receive a variable annual bonus based on company, team, and/or individual performance results in accordance with company policy. We offer a comprehensive Total Rewards package that our U.S. colleagues and their families can count on, which includes:

* A choice of national medical and dental plans, and a national vision plan, including health incentive programs
* Employee assistance and family support programs, including commuter benefits and tuition reimbursement
* At least 120 hours paid time off (PTO), 10 paid holidays annually, paid parental leave (3 weeks for bonding and 8 weeks for caregiver leave), accident and life insurance, and short\- and long\-term disability in accordance with company policy
* Retirement and saving

jobs.title: SMB Account Manager - Services
jobs.description:
Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn't work together.  

  

So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we've embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.  

  

Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise\-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We're building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.


#### **The Role**



Small businesses are the backbone of any community\- and you'll be the partner that helps them thrive with Square. From the local salon to the personal trainer down the street, we're looking for someone with a genuine passion for SMBs in the Services space, excited by the opportunity to work alongside business owners and champion their growth.



In this role, you'll build meaningful partnerships with clients, understanding their unique needs, crafting tailored solutions, and advocating for them within Square. You'll become a creative problem\-solver, finding ways to apply our products to complex business scenarios. As a trusted advisor, you'll support clients day\-to\-day while uncovering new growth opportunities and expanding partnerships that fuel their success.



Your day\-to\-day blends high\-energy outreach, consultative conversations, and business coaching, with a focus on helping sellers get the most from Square. You'll have autonomy to lead your playbook and influence how Square scales in the Services industry, delivering tangible results for your merchants.

  

**You will:**


* Own, retain, and grow a portfolio of SMB Services merchants, helping them thrive through tailored adoption of Square tools.
* Drive expansion through product adoption, upselling, and value\-based recommendations.
* Act as the voice of your merchants within Square, advocating for their needs with empathy and surfacing insights that shape our products.
* Balance proactive outreach, retention activities, and growth opportunities through strong organization and time management.
* Work with our Sales, Support and Product teams to ensure customers have the best possible experience across all aspects of Square


**You have:**


* 3\+ years experience in Sales, Account Management or related field
* Experience discovering and closing sales opportunities and building client relationships.
* Experience successfully managing a pipeline to achieve revenue targets

jobs.title: Key Account Manager - Critical Industries
jobs.description:
At **ABB**, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

**This position reports to:**


Strategic Program Director
\_\_


In this role, you’ll develop, implement, and manage the strategy and relationship with assigned data center\-related accounts for the ABB Electrification (EL) business, specifically related to the Industry, Building and Channel (IBC) organization. The position will have significant cross\-functional responsibilities across the ABB EL. As the point person for the ABB IBC relationship within those accounts, this position is responsible for growing share of wallet, profitability, and elevating customer satisfaction. Coordinates executive relationships within the accounts, sets goals, tracks pipeline, organizes sales activities, monitors current projects, and manages the resolution of the strategic customer challenges.


The work model for the role is: remote (\#LI\-Remote) and willingness to travel as needed is required.

**Your role and responsibilities:**

* **Lead Strategic Account Planning:** Develop and implement account plans and Statements of Work (SoW) to drive growth across divisions and locations.
* **Drive Customer\-Centric Sales Strategy:** Understand key business drivers and risks (e.g., sustainability, digitalization, cybersecurity) to shape tailored sales strategies and targets.
* **Build Trusted Relationships:** Engage decision\-makers within data center organizations, delivering comprehensive ABB solutions aligned with customer needs and profitability goals.
* **Enable Competitive \& Coordinated Execution:** Monitor market trends and competitors, apply standardized sales tools (e.g., Salesforce), and ensure a unified approach to sales planning and issue resolution.

**Our Team Dynamics**


Our teams support each other, collaborate, and never stop learning. Everyone brings something unique, and together we push ideas forward to solve real problems. Being part of our team means your work matters \- because the progress we make here creates real impact out there.

**Qualifications for the role:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Marketing or related field and a minimum of 10 years of experience within the industry OR Associate’s degree and a minimum of 12 years of experience within the industry.
* Experience working with data center customers is a plus.
* Strong understanding of the Electrification products
* Proven ability to conduct market analysis and develop business plans with a structured, strategic mindset; experienced in building strong relationships with electrical contractors, distributors, and channel partners. Brings a technical background (preferably in the data center market), strong communication skills, and an agile, collaborative leadership style that fosters teamwork and innovation.
* Solid technical understanding of 3\-phase AC power systems including, but not limited to: medium and low voltage switchgear, medium and low voltage motor control centers, switchboards, panelboards, and ancillary electrical distribution products and experience with quoting projects for contractors  

Solid technical understanding and field sales experience selling power monitoring and control software, associated metering and communications systems, direct current, and battery energy storage/microgrid solutions.
* Candidates must already have work authorization that would permit them to work for ABB in the US.

**What's in it for you**

We empower you to take initiative, challenge ideas, and lead with confidence. You’ll grow through meaningful work, continuous learning, and support that’s tailored to your goals. Every idea you share and every action you take contributes to something bigger

Overview:

Keysight is at the forefront of technology innovation, delivering breakthroughs and trusted insights in electronic design, simulation, prototyping, test, manufacturing, and optimization. Our \~16,800 employees create world\-class solutions in communications, 5G, automotive, energy, quantum, aerospace, defense, and semiconductor markets for customers in over 100 countries. Learn more about what we do.  

Our award\-winning culture embraces a bold vision of where technology can take us and a passion for tackling challenging problems with industry\-first solutions. We believe that when people feel a sense of belonging, they can be more creative, innovative, and thrive at all points in their careers.
Responsibilities:
**Key Responsibilities:*** Develop and execute an account and territory strategy for Bay Area startups and emerging technology companies.
* Identify high\-potential startups based on funding, technology development, hiring, product maturity, and expected test and measurement requirements.
* Establish relationships with founders, CTOs, engineering leaders, hardware teams, and procurement organizations.
* Develop new accounts from initial engagement through design\-in, evaluation, purchase, and expansion.
* Position Keysight’s portfolio of electronic design and test solutions to address customer development challenges.
* Partner closely with Industry Solution teams, Solution Engineers, Business Development, Inside Sales, and Keysight channel partners.
* Engage customers across areas including AI accelerators, high\-speed digital, networking, data center, optical communications, photonics, semiconductor, and related technologies.
* Build and maintain a healthy sales pipeline and accurately forecast business opportunities.
* Develop multi\-year account strategies for high\-growth customers with significant expansion potential.
* Monitor startup funding, technology trends, competitive activity, and market developments to identify new opportunities.
* Drive executive\-level engagement and develop long\-term strategic customer relationships.
* Collaborate across Keysight organizations to deliver comprehensive solutions and maximize customer value.


Qualifications:
**Required:*** Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Business, or a related field.
* Strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship\-building skills.
* Demonstrated ability to develop customer relationships and identify business opportunities.
* Strong interest in technology and the ability to learn complex technical concepts.
* Self\-motivated, entrepreneurial, and comfortable working in a fast\-paced environment.
* Ability to manage multiple opportunities and prioritize activities based on business impact.

**Preferred:*** 2\+ years of sales, account management, business development, or technical customer\-facing experience.
* Experience with semiconductor, AI, networking, data center, optical communications, photonics, or electronic test and measurement technologies.
* Existing relationships within the Bay Area technology ecosystem.
* Experience working with startups or venture\-backed technology companies.
* Technical degree or engineering background.

jobs.title: GTM AI Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
GTM AI Operations Specialist  



This role has been designed as ‘’Onsite’ with an expectation that you will primarily work from an HPE office.**Who We Are:**


Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge\-to\-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.

**Job Description:**

  



We are looking for a GTM AI Operations Specialist to design, build, and deliver AI agents that sellers use every day. This is a hands\-on role focused on writing prompts, configuring agents, testing outputs, and launching seller\-facing tools that reduce friction and help close revenue faster.

  

This role connects Sales Operations, AI tooling, and enterprise data to put working AI agents directly in front of sellers. You will turn GTM priorities into seller\-facing agents and automated workflows using platforms like Salesforce Agentforce, Microsoft Copilot Studio, Claude Code, Gemini, Snowflake, and Databricks.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Prompt Engineering \& AI Agent Development**

* **Design and deploy autonomous agents:**Prototype, test, and ship AI agents and custom copilots that handle key seller motions, including deal inspection, account research, opportunity updates, and meeting prep.
* **Optimize****prompts:**Write, refine, and maintain prompt templates, system instructions, and context that give sales teams accurate, consistent, and relevant output.
* **Tune agent behavior:**Decide how agents interact with sellers and prospects. Set the guardrails, tone, persona, and fallback logic across platforms like Salesforce Agentforce and Microsoft Copilot Studio.
**Workflow Automation \& Execution**

* **Ship production workflows:**Re\-engineer revenue processes by connecting LLMs and agentic workflows to our core GTM systems such as Salesforce, Clari, Zoominfo, People.ai, Gong.
* **Prototype and iterate quickly:**Build fast, test in the field, and refine using tools like Microsoft CoPilot, Claude Code, ChatGPT Enterprise, Gemini, and orchestrators such as Power Automate, or direct API integrations.
* **Build for scale:**Document agent logic, prompt structures, and standard procedures so the automations you build can grow across the global GTM organization without depending on one person.
**Experimentation \& Performance**

* **Test prompts and models:**Run structured experiments on system prompts, context retrieval, and model selection to improve output quality, seller adoption, and deal velocity.
* **Monitor live performance:**Track, audit, and improve agent behavior and prompt accuracy in production, and fix output drift or performance gaps as they show up.
**Data, Enablement \& Governance**

* **Use enterprise data:**Work with the Data and BI teams to tap into Snowflake and Databricks so agents can draw on real\-time customer and pipeline data.
* **Drive field adoption:**Build practical prompt libraries, quick\-reference playbooks, and short training sessions that show sellers how to get real value from these tools.
* **Keep it responsible:**Make sure every prompt, workflow, and data pipeline meets our security, privacy, and responsible AI standards.
**Required Qualifications**

* 3 to 5 years in Sales Operations, RevOps, GTM strategy, or AI operations, with hands\-on experience putting prompt\-engineered workflows or LLM agents into production.
* Proven ability to write complex prompts and build agentic workflows on enterprise AI platforms such as Salesforce Agentforce, Microsoft Copilot Studio, Claude Code or Claude for Work, Gemini Enterprise, or ChatGPT Enterprise.
* Strong working knowledge of Salesforce and comfort with enterprise data environments like Snowflake and Databricks.
* A builder's mindset. You enjoy testing, troubleshooting, and shipping working automations rather than just putting together slide decks.
* Comfortable using data through SQL, Power BI, or spreadsheets to track adoption, agent performance, and productivity gains in the field.
**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with revenue intelligence tools like Clari, Gong, People.ai, and other GTM tools.
* Relevant certifications are a plus, including Salesforce Agentforce, Microsoft Copilot accreditation, Azure AI Fundamentals, or recognized prompt engineering or enterprise AI certifications.
**Core Competencies**

* Prompt engineering and agent design
* GTM execution and workflow automation
* Working knowledge of Salesforce, Snowflake, and Databricks
* Rapid prototyping and experimentation
**What Success Looks Like**

* Sellers spend measurably fewer hours a week on admin work.
* Agentforce, Copilot, and custom prompts see strong, active use across the field.
* Live prompts and agents run with low error and drift rates.
* A standardized prompt library and GTM agent catalog are up and actively used.
**What We Can Offer You:**

**Health \& Wellbeing**


We strive to provide our team members and their loved ones with a comprehensive suite of benefits that supports their physical, financial and emotional wellbeing.

**Personal \& Professional Development**


We also invest in your career because the better you are, the better we all are. We have specific programs catered to helping you reach any career goals you have — whether you want to become a knowledge expert in your field or apply your skills to another division.

**Unconditional Inclusion**


We are unconditionally inclusive in the way we work and celebrate individual uniqueness. W

jobs.description:
**Be the Person who keeps it all Moving**




Ashby Lumber is looking for an **Executive Assistant \- Sales \& Marketing** to partner with our VP of Sales \& Marketing and help keep a busy, multi\-location operation organized and moving forward.


This isn’t your typical Executive Assistant role. You’ll combine executive support with sales and marketing coordination \- from preparing meetings and tracking priorities to supporting campaigns, events, and our sales teams.


WHO YOU ARE:


You’re organized, proactive, and naturally think a few steps ahead. You enjoy variety, take ownership of your work, and are someone others can count on to follow through.

* Highly organized and detail oriented
* Proactive, resourceful, and dependable
* Comfortable juggling changing priorities
* A strong written and verbal communicator
* Professional and discreet with confidential information
* Creative, collaborative, and team\-focused


WHAT YOU’LL DO:

* Manage calendars, meetings, communications, and follow\-ups
* Prepare meeting materials and keep action items moving
* Support sales reporting, meetings, promotions, and CRM upkeep
* Create and schedule social media content and assist with website updates
* Coordinate with marketing vendors and support campaigns and promotional materials
* Help plan contractor events, trainings, vendor meetings, and customer events
* Take ownership of special projects and help turn ideas into action


WHAT YOU BRING:

* 3\+ years of executive assistant, administrative, sales support, marketing coordination, or similar experience
* Experience supporting a senior leader
* Strong Google Workspace skills
* Experience managing business social media
* Excellent communication, organization, and follow through skills
* Ability to travel between Berkeley and Concord

**Bonus:** Experience with Canva, website content, events, reporting, or the building materials/construction industry




WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE:


You’re making life easier for the people you support. Meetings are prepared, follow\-ups happen without reminders, sales reporting is accurate and on time, marketing projects stay moving, and events run smoothly.


Most importantly, you become a trusted partner who can be counted on to keep things moving.




WHY ASHBY LUMBER?:


Ashby Lumber is a family\-owned building materials company with deep roots in the Bay Area. We’ve built our reputation on expertise, strong relationships, and exceptional service. You’ll have the opportunity to work closely with leadership while making an impact across sales, marketing, events, and the customer experience.

**Benefits include medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k) with company match, paid time off, paid holidays, employee discounts, and career development opportunities.**


If you’re ready for a role where your organization, creativity, and follow\-through can make a visible impact, **apply today and grow with Ashby Lumber.**




***This job description in no way states or implies that these are the only duties to be performed. You will be expected to follow any other job\-related instructions and to perform other job\-related duties as requested by your Supervisor, the Store Managers, or the Owners.***


You will be evaluated based on your performance of the objectives, duties, and responsibilities listed in this job description, the accomplishment of other assigned tasks, and adherence to Ashby Lumber’s Policies as outlined in the Employee Manual. Your supervisor or the Manager has the right to revise this job description at any time.


This job description is not a contract for employment, and either you or Ashby Lumber may terminate employment at any time, for any reason.

jobs.title: Social Media Manager
jobs.description:
**TEAM ELITE ACADEMY**

**Social Media Manager**

**Location:** Menlo Park, CA

**Employment Type:** Part\-Time / Full\-Time

**Department:** Marketing \& Brand Communications

**Join the Team Elite Academy**

Team Elite Academy is more than a basketball organization—we're developing confident athletes, strong leaders, and thriving communities through sports.

We're looking for a creative, strategic, and organized Social Media Manager to lead our digital presence while helping tell the story of Team Elite Academy across every platform.

If you're passionate about sports, branding, storytelling, and building meaningful communities online, we'd love to meet you.

**About the Role**

The Social Media Manager is responsible for developing and executing Team Elite Academy's social media strategy while ensuring a consistent, engaging, and professional brand presence.

You'll oversee content planning, manage social media platforms, collaborate with our Assistant Social Media Manager, and work alongside leadership to showcase our athletes, coaches, programs, partners, and community impact.

This role combines creativity, strategy, and analytics to help grow one of the premier basketball development brands in the country.

**What You'll Do**

* Develop and manage Team Elite's social media strategy and content calendar.
* Oversee Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, and emerging platforms.
* Create engaging posts, captions, Reels, and promotional campaigns.
* Review, organize, and publish content captured by the Assistant Social Media Manager.
* Maintain a consistent posting schedule across all platforms.
* Collaborate with leadership on announcements, partnerships, events, and organizational initiatives.
* Monitor audience engagement and respond to comments and messages when appropriate.
* Track analytics and recommend strategies to increase engagement, reach, and brand awareness.
* Ensure all content reflects the Team Elite brand, mission, and visual identity.

**What We're Looking For**

We're looking for someone who understands that every post represents the Team Elite brand.

The ideal candidate is creative, highly organized, trend\-aware, and passionate about visual storytelling. They know how to create content that informs, inspires, and builds lasting relationships with athletes, families, and the community.

**What You'll Bring**

* Experience managing social media accounts for a brand or organization.
* Strong understanding of Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, and LinkedIn.
* Experience creating engaging content and writing compelling captions.
* Proficiency with Canva, CapCut, Adobe Creative Suite, or similar creative tools.
* Knowledge of social media analytics and performance reporting.
* Strong communication, organization, and project management skills.
* Excellent attention to detail and visual design.
* Passion for sports, branding, and digital marketing.

Basketball knowledge is preferred but not required.

**Benefits**

* Competitive Compensation
* Nike Team Apparel \& Staff Gear
* Flexible Scheduling
* Professional Development Opportunities
* Creative Leadership \& Growth
* Collaborative Team Environment
* Opportunities for Advancement Within Team Elite

**Our Hiring Process**

**01 Apply** – Submit your application and share examples of your work, portfolio, or social media experience.

**02 Connect** – Qualified candidates will meet with our leadership team to discuss the role, creative process, and vision for Team Elite Academy.

**03 Interview** – Final candidates will participate in an interview focused on creativity, brand strategy, communication, and organizational fit.

**Join Our Team**

If you're passionate about storytelling, branding, and building an inspiring digital presence, we'd love to hear from you.

Help us grow the Team Elite brand and inspire the next generation of athletes, families, and communities.

**Apply Today**

**info@teameliteca.com**

**TEAM ELITE ACADEMY**

*Building The Next Generation of Athletes.*

Pay: Up to $3,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Social Media Specialist
jobs.description:
**ABOUT US** 

For over 12 years, L\&P Aesthetics has been a leading provider of facial aesthetics in the Bay Area. Led by three nationally recognized, double board\-certified facial plastic surgeons and a team of highly skilled facial experts, L\&P Aesthetics specializes in surgical transformations that look effortlessly natural, alongside strategic nonsurgical treatments tailored to meet every patient wherever they are on their aesthetic journey.

We're looking for a highly creative, motivated Social Media Specialist to join our marketing team and elevate our clinics and brands with engaging, trendsetting content across multiple platforms.

**JOB OVERVIEW** 

As a Social Media Specialist on our marketing team, you'll plan, capture, edit, post short\-form content that showcases our treatments, services, and office personalities. You'll create on\-brand, informative, and entertaining videos aligned with the latest social trends to educate our community and attract new clients.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 

* Film, edit, and post engaging, on\-brand content for Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, YouTube Shorts, and other platforms.
* Collaborate with the Marketing Director and social team to plan and execute content that aligns with campaigns and seasonal promotions.
* Coordinate with the medical team's schedule to film content featuring consenting patients and providers.
* Develop and maintain content calendars across multiple accounts and platforms.
* Engage with followers, respond to comments, and cultivate active online communities across platforms.
* Track content performance using analytics tools to inform and optimize future posts and drive engagement.
* Experiment with new creative concepts and campaigns to keep content fresh and highly engaging.
* Maintain a consistent brand voice and aesthetic across all content.
* Stay current on social media trends and challenges, and pivot strategy quickly when needed.

**REQUIREMENTS** 

* Proven experience as a creative content creator on Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube. Must have a portfolio or content examples to apply.
* Strong grasp of social trends, algorithms, and best practices, with a track record of growing accounts.
* Skilled in filming, editing, and basic graphic design, with experience including but not limited to CapCut and Adobe Premiere.
* Highly creative and self\-motivated, able to manage multiple projects independently while also collaborating with a marketing team.
* Comfortable capturing content in real time in clinical settings, including procedure rooms, with patients and providers.
* Quick to adapt to new trends and platform changes, with the ability to develop fresh strategies to grow visibility.
* Able to work efficiently within busy schedules and tight deadlines.
* Excellent verbal and written communication and collaboration skills.

**BONUS QUALIFICATIONS** 

* Experience in the beauty, skincare, or medical aesthetic industry.
* Familiarity with influencer marketing and social media growth strategies.

**PERKS \& BENEFITS** 

Competitive pay and benefits package: medical, dental, 401(k), PTO plus paid holidays, annual CME budget. Generous employee discounts, and an excellent work environment.

Note: All duties and responsibilities stated are essential job functions. Staff members may be required to perform additional job\-related duties as assigned by management.

Job Types: Full\-time, in\-office

Expected hours: 40 per week

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Employee discount
* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Work Location:

* In\-office

If you're passionate about social media, beauty, and creating content that gets noticed, we’d love to see your application!

**HOW TO APPLY**

Please submit your resume, portfolio (or links to content you’ve produced), and a brief pitch as to why you’d be the perfect fit for this role. Applications without a portfolio or links to media examples will not be considered. Email: careers@ForTheFace.com

Pay: $25\.00 \- $35\.00 per hour

Expected hours: No less than 32\.0 per week

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Employee discount
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Retirement plan
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:
**San Jose, California**


**Outside Sales Representative**


**Pay from $80,000 to $110,000 per year**


Uline, a name millions of businesses across North America know and trust, is looking for an experienced Outside Sales Representative to build our growing San Jose, California market.


Your role on our Sales team is to help businesses from every industry discover quality products with speed and service you’ll be proud to deliver.


**Why Sales at Uline?**

* **“CEO” of Your Territory** \- Identify growth opportunities within your markets. Meet with existing customers on\-site and build relationships.
* **Be a Part of a Winning Team** \- Join our Fremont, CA sales team for comradery, training, and department meetings via regular trips to the office.
* **Learn from the Best** \- Receive 4 weeks of Uline\-specific sales training followed by a 12\-week mentorship program and continuous career development.

**Position Responsibilities**


* Manage and grow existing accounts as well as prospect for new business.
* Spend Monday planning and scheduling, on\-site visits with customers Tuesday \- Friday.
* Create effective solutions for customers using our 43,000 high quality products.

**Minimum Requirements**


* Bachelor’s degree.
* 5\+ years previous sales experience **preferred.**
* Excellent written / verbal communication, problem\-solving and presentation skills.
* Valid driver’s license and great driving record.

**Benefits**


* Great pay and bonus program.  

Additionally, there are sales goals, contests and top performer incentives.
* Complete health insurance coverage and 401(k) with 6% employer match that starts day one!
* Paid holidays and generous paid time off.
* Internet, mobile phone allowance.
* Auto mileage reimbursement.

**About Uline**


Uline, a family\-owned company, is North America’s leading distributor of shipping, industrial, and packaging materials with over 9,800 employees across 14 locations and 17 sales offices.


Uline is a drug\-free workplace. All new hires must complete a pre\-employment hair follicle drug screening.

In partnership with a team of Inside Sales and Customer Support representatives, communicate product information and features that will enhance client knowledge and confidence. Forecast future sales and prepare periodic reports as required, recording activity and opportunity in CRM system.


**ESSENTIAL JOB DUTIES:**


* Solidify customer relationships as a trusted, consultative business advisor and partner. Probe and identify customer’s business initiatives and needs, develop account plans to support growth, provide implementation support to increase product utilization.

* Build and maintain an active sales funnel. Prospect, qualify and close new business opportunities, including cross\-sell opportunities with current customers.

* Pre\-plan and align account penetration strategy with Inside Sales and Special Markets partners.
* Participate in tradeshows, educational offerings and other customer training and showcase events.

* Medical, Healthcare or dental sales experience highly preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to digest, to comprehend, and verbalize highly technical product and clinical information related to company and industry products.
* Demonstrated professional sales skills.

jobs.title: Vitas Sales Representative
jobs.description:
**WHO WE ARE**
  

  

At VITAS Healthcare, we’ve been the nation’s leading end\-of\-life care provider for more than 45 years. We’re not just a hospice company—we’re a mission\-driven movement built on compassion, support, and growth
  

  

When you join VITAS, you’re stepping into a culture that invests in you: your development, your goals, and your impact. With programs in 15\+ states and a nationally recognized employee experience, we promote from within, reward performance, and support ambitious professionals ready to make a difference.
  

  

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**
  

  

As a VITAS Representative, you’ll be at the front line of change—educating physicians, healthcare leaders \& professionals about the value of hospice care. You’ll:
* Build trusted relationships with physician, healthcare leaders \& professionals
* Confidently guide referral sources through understanding the prognostication, the value proposition of hospice \& how to have effective conversations for families facing serious illness
* Champion the benefits of the Medicare hospice benefit
* Work alongside clinical partners to ensure patients receive the right care at the right time
* This is a role for someone who’s ready to grow, eager to learn, and driven to serve.

**WHERE YOU’LL WORK**
  

  

You’ll be based out of a local VITAS office and actively engaging across your territory. Whether it’s a physician's office, hospital, or care facility—you’ll go where the need is, always focused on making meaningful connections.
  

  

**WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR**
  

  

You’re a strong communicator. You thrive on challenges. You’re passionate about helping others and hungry to learn a meaningful, evolving business.
  

If you’re a motivated professional who wants to grow into a mission\-aligned career, you’ll find the tools, mentorship, and momentum here.
  

At VITAS, we value:
* Adaptability in dynamic, people\-driven environments
* A solution\-oriented mindset that thrives on overcoming obstacles
* The heart and drive to connect, educate, and truly make a difference


  

**WHY THIS MATTERS**
  

  

Every day, you’ll help ensure that patients and families receive comfort, dignity, and peace at life’s most important moments. And in doing so, you’ll grow your career, your confidence, and your sense of purpose.
  

  

This is more than a sales role—it’s a calling. Ready to answer?
  

  

**QUALIFICATIONS**
  

* Minimum 2 years sales experience or in healthcare services preferred
* Participated in competitive team environment that involved individual accountably and teamwork
* Able to demonstrate examples on critical thinking and created solutions
* Past military service a plus
* Experience with volunteer organization a plus
* Hospice experience preferred but, not required
* Evidence of achieving sales goals within the market and/or demonstrates track record of consistently exceeding corporate goals
* Strong customer service, sense of urgency and problem solving skills
* Time Management and Organizational Skills
* Demonstrated knowledge and successful application of a need satisfaction selling process
* Ability to manage a territory, to conduct sales calls and to generate sales by building long term business partnerships
* Strong interpersonal skills within all levels of an organization


  

**EDUCATION**
* Bachelor’s degree in Nursing or related field from an accredited college or university or the international equivalent preferred. See table above for specific requirements per state.


VITAS® Healthcare is the nation’s leading provider of end\-of\-life care, and has the resources and expertise to support your personal and professional growth. As a member of the VITAS team, you’ll find fulfillment working for a people\-focused organization dedicated to making a difference in the lives of others. You will be more than just an employee: You will be counted on as an expert in your field, and as a valued team member whose efforts are respected and vital to our hospice mission.


All VITAS employees commit to fulfilling their duties and responsibilities with the highest regard for professionalism, collaboration and teamwork, and an eye focused constantly on growth and improvement. We serve with commitment and compassion, and position ourselves for the future by embracing, innovating, and leading change. If you are that person, make your voice heard—find your purpose at VITAS today.


Benefits Include:


* Competitive compensation
* Health, dental, vision, life and disability insurance
* Pre\-tax healthcare and dependent care flexible spending accounts
* Life insurance
* 401(k) plan with numerous investment options and generous company match
* Cancer and/or critical illness benefit
* Tuition Reimbursement
* Paid Time Off
* Employee Assistance Program
* Legal Insurance
* Roadside Assistance
* Affinity Program

  

Many of our positions offer the opportunity to work day or night shifts, weekdays or weekends.

jobs.title: Assistant Project Manager
jobs.description:
Epicus Group is a professional project and construction management firm providing owner’s representative consulting services, including workplace strategy, capital program planning, and facilities management. Our work spans the Life Sciences, Energy, and Government sectors, where we deliver comprehensive management and advisory services. We serve as an unbiased advocate for our clients, providing leadership and strategic guidance to navigate complex real estate challenges while minimizing risk and maximizing outcomes.

As we continue to expand our portfolio of exciting projects in Northern California, we are seeking a passionate Assistant Project Manager to join our growing team and deliver exceptional outcomes for our clients. This role will help lead capital projects as the owner’s representative, bringing comprehensive knowledge of the real estate development lifecycle, approval processes, and regulatory requirements.

The Assistant Project Manager will support the development and maintenance of strong client relationships, serving as a key point of coordination for internal stakeholders and external partners. In this role, you will assist in facilitating clear communication, contributing to strategic decision\-making, and supporting efforts to enhance the performance of the client’s real estate assets. If you thrive in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment, bring a proactive and detail\-oriented mindset, and are passionate about delivering exceptional results while growing within a forward\-thinking firm, we invite you to join Epicus Group.

**Your Role:** 

As an Assistant Project Manager, you will interface with Epicus clients and project teams through a successful process of strategic real estate planning, design, and construction of new buildings, tenant improvement buildouts, and facilities assignments. Some of the ways you will support our projects are:

* Support all phases of capital projects, including planning, design, construction, and close\-out, ensuring successful delivery within scope, budget, and schedule.
* Assist with stakeholder engagement, needs assessments, qualitative program reviews, business case development, and entitlement management to define and verify project goals and objectives.
* Serve as the key point of coordination between clients, architects, engineers, contractors, consultants, and city officials, fostering strong partnerships and effective collaboration throughout the project lifecycle.
* Support procurement efforts for design, construction, peer reviews, and specialty consultant services, including drafting scopes, evaluating proposals, negotiating contracts, and authorizing contract execution and purchase orders.
* Assist in preparing and implementing the project execution plan, project kick\-off activities, meetings, presentations, and ongoing project communications to ensure alignment with client objectives and company goals.
* Support the design and construction phases, including oversight of architectural and engineering drawings, bid documents, contractor coordination, and agency approvals to ensure program, budget, and schedule conformance.
* Provide construction administration support, including oversight of meetings, progress reporting, RFIs, submittals, cost control, schedule management, FF\&E coordination, and contractor performance.
* Track and monitor project budgets and schedules using web\-based project controls; perform meaningful financial and schedule analysis and proactively identify and resolve potential risks, changes, or impacts.
* Assist in organizing and evaluating value engineering alternatives in collaboration with owners and design teams to support financial and performance objectives.
* Support project administration, including resource planning, contract compliance, forecasting, invoicing, progress draw reviews, issue resolution, and strategic decision\-making.
* Coordinate architects’ review of contractor and vendor onsite activities to verify compliance with contractual documents, design intent, schedules, and workmanship standards.
* Observe and report on construction activities and construction\-related issues, ensuring timely escalation and resolution.
* Coordinate and document project meetings; clearly communicate project status, risks, and mitigation strategies to stakeholders.
* Support and collaborate with Project Managers and internal team members, contributing to accountability, performance development, and achievement of project milestones.
* Assist with project close\-out process, ensuring all deliverables, documentation, financial reconciliation, and contractual requirements are completed successfully.
* Support business development efforts, including leading RFQ/RFP responses, proposal development, presentations, interviews, and contract negotiations, and ensuring a seamless transition from business development to project execution
* Represent the company at industry events, conferences, and networking opportunities to strengthen brand presence and support business development initiatives.

**Qualifications:**

* Minimum 3 years of experience
* Bachelor’s or associate degree in engineering, architecture, construction management, business, or related field.
* Certification as a Project Management Professional (PMP), Certified Construction Manager (CCM) or LEED AP is desired.
* Experience in the Northern California market, having strong relationships with clients, design firms, general contractors, and stakeholders
* Knowledge of the real estate development lifecycle, approval processes, and regulations, from programming, entitlement and design through construction and operations.
* Highly motivated, ambitious and demonstrated business acumen, with a track record of exceeding targets. Expert at building relationships and earning trust.
* Detail\-oriented and analytical, excellent communication skills, strong organization and time management skills, and ability to operate independently.
* Advanced MS Office

Full Time

3201 Citrus Circle, Suite 205, Walnut Creek, CA 94598
