**Job Description**
-------------------


In order to be considered for this position candidate must be serving permanently in the title, or be reachable on the civil service list.
  

  

Transportation Planning and Management (TPM) is responsible for the safe, efficient, and environmentally responsible movement of people and goods on the City's streets, supporting the larger goals of economic and social vitality for people living, working, and doing business in New York City. The Division’s responsibilities include planning, street design, technical analysis, signs, transit development, freight mobility and markings, ensuring the safety of motor vehicle occupants, pedestrians, and cyclists.
  

  

The Office of Livable Streets (OLS) is tasked with prioritizing strategic planning, community engagement, research, policy, design, implementation, and long\-term management. Their goal is to create streets that are livable, supporting safety, accessibility, inclusion, resiliency, active modes, community cohesion, and economic vitality citywide. Additionally, they aim to enhance New York City's pedestrian, bicycle, and micromobility networks, providing comfortable, connected, green, and reliable transportation options across the five boroughs. They place special emphasis on Priority Investment Areas, mode shift, and reimagining streets. The office also develops innovative new programs, design typologies, project delivery, and analysis tools to meet the demands of a rapidly changing population with evolving needs and technologies.
  

  

The Cycling \& Micromobility Unit is responsible for the nation's largest network of on\-street bicycle facilities (1,200\+ lane\-miles), enhancing street safety for all users, and increasing bike ridership in the five boroughs. The team's focus is the innovative redesign of city streets to expand and improve the bike network, with emphasis on improving connectivity between neighborhoods, increasing access to safe bicycle infrastructure across the city, and creating a more equitable transportation network that serves all New Yorkers.
  

  

The Cycling \& Micromobility Unit seeks to hire two motivated, detail\-oriented Project Coordinators to support the design and development of construction\-ready plans for bicycle infrastructure projects across all five boroughs of New York City. Under the supervision of a Senior Project Coordinator, the Project Coordinators play a critical role in collaborating with engineers and planners to develop innovative, sustainable bicycle infrastructure projects. The selected candidates will help advance safe, high\-quality street designs that reduce traffic fatalities and serious injuries, improve mobility, and encourage a shift to sustainable transportation modes in support of the NYC Streets Plan.
  

  

The candidate will develop detailed proposed street designs that rebalance existing streets to integrate bicycle facilities, pedestrian improvements, and traffic calming to enhance safety for all street users. The candidates will create comprehensive AutoCAD drawings showing vehicle and bike lane configurations, intersection treatments, curb alignments, roadway dimensions, vertical elements, and pavement markings. The candidates will ensure all designs comply with AASHTO, MUTCD, and NYC DOT standards. The candidates will perform basic traffic operations analyses using Synchro, including evaluating intersection capacity, delay, and level of service under the guidance of senior staff. The candidates will manage multiple concurrent design projects and prioritize work to meet critical deadlines. The candidates will coordinate with other DOT divisions, including Geometric Design, Borough Engineering, and Traffic Signals Division, to ensure design consistency. The candidates will conduct site visits and field measurements to verify existing conditions and inform design decisions. The candidates will prepare design presentations and graphics for community meetings, stakeholder engagement, and internal coordination.
  

  

The Department of Transportation’s (DOT) mission is to provide for the safe, efficient, and environmentally responsible movement of people and goods in the City of New York and to maintain and enhance the transportation infrastructure crucial to the economic vitality and quality of life of our primary customers, City residents. DOT is an equal opportunity employer, committed to recruiting and maintaining a diverse workforce in an open and inclusive environment.

Experience with survey data, existing conditions mapping, and incorporating field measurements into designs
  

Familiarity with Synchro traffic analysis software and an understanding of basic traffic operations principles

Excellent organizational skills and ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously
  

Outstanding written and verbal communication skills to coordinate with multidisciplinary teams

**Job Description**
-------------------


In order to be considered for this position candidate must be serving permanently in the title, or be reachable on the civil service list, exam \# 5045\.
  

  

Transportation Planning and Management (TPM) is responsible for the safe, efficient, and environmentally responsible movement of people and goods on the City's streets, supporting the larger goals of economic and social vitality for people living, working, and doing business in New York City. The Division’s responsibilities include planning, street design, technical analysis, signs, transit development, freight mobility and markings, ensuring the safety of motor vehicle occupants, pedestrians, and cyclists.
  

  

The Office of Livable Streets (OLS) is tasked with prioritizing strategic planning, community engagement, research, policy, design, implementation, and long\-term management. Their goal is to create streets that are livable, supporting safety, accessibility, inclusion, resiliency, active modes, community cohesion, and economic vitality citywide. Additionally, they aim to enhance New York City's pedestrian, bicycle, and micromobility networks, providing comfortable, connected, green, and reliable transportation options across the five boroughs. They place special emphasis on Priority Investment Areas, mode shift, and reimagining streets. The office also develops innovative new programs, design typologies, project delivery, and analysis tools to meet the demands of a rapidly changing population with evolving needs and technologies.
  

  

The Cycling \& Micromobility Unit is responsible for the nation's largest network of on\-street bicycle facilities (1,200\+ lane\-miles), enhancing street safety for all users, and increasing bike ridership in the five boroughs. The team's focus is the innovative redesign of city streets to expand and improve the bike network, with emphasis on improving connectivity between neighborhoods, increasing access to safe bicycle infrastructure across the city, and creating a more equitable transportation network that serves all New Yorkers.
  

  

The Cycling \& Micromobility Unit seeks to hire two highly motivated and detail\-oriented Project Coordinators to support the planning, development, and delivery of capital bicycle and micromobility projects throughout New York City. Under the supervision of senior staff, the selected candidates will manage complex capital projects, coordinate with multidisciplinary teams and partner agencies, and help advance projects from concept through design and implementation. The selected candidates will support the identification and development of new capital project opportunities, coordinate the review of transportation and development projects led by partner agencies, and collaborate with planners, engineers, and designers to ensure high\-quality bicycle and micromobility infrastructure is incorporated into capital projects citywide. The position offers the opportunity to work on some of New York City's most significant transportation projects while helping shape the future of the City's cycling network.
  

  

The candidate will manage Cycling \& Micromobility\-sponsored capital projects through planning, design, and implementation, including project scope, schedule, budget, consultant management, and coordination with internal DOT divisions and external agencies. The candidate will support the identification, evaluation, and development of new capital bicycle and micromobility projects through site investigations, existing conditions analysis, conceptual planning, and project scoping. The candidate will review roadway reconstruction, bridge, public space, land development, and other transportation projects to identify opportunities for bicycle and micromobility improvements and provide technical comments throughout project development, ensuring designs comply with AASHTO, MUTCD, and NYC DOT standards and best practices. The candidate will coordinate with planners, engineers, architects, landscape architects, operations staff, and consultants to incorporate high\-quality cycling and micromobility facilities into capital projects, and assist in the development of conceptual designs and planning studies. The candidate will prepare reports, presentations, correspondence, briefing materials, and other technical documents to support project development, executive decision\-making, funding requests, and grant applications. The candidate will track project schedules, milestones, design comments, commitments, and follow\-up actions to support coordination across multiple concurrent capital projects. The candidate will perform other related duties as assigned.
  

  

The Department of Transportation’s (DOT) mission is to provide for the safe, efficient, and environmentally responsible movement of people and goods in the City of New York and to maintain and enhance the transportation infrastructure crucial to the economic vitality and quality of life of our primary customers, City residents. DOT is an equal opportunity employer, committed to recruiting and maintaining a diverse workforce in an open and inclusive environment.

jobs.title: PALS Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**ORGANIZATION OVERVIEW**



Founded in 1980, Urban Resource Institute (URI) is the nation’s largest provider of domestic violence shelter services and a leader in supporting homeless families. Operating 24 shelters across New York City, URI provides 3,700 beds nightly in purpose\-built shelters that offer trauma\-informed services including counseling, childcare, case management, and more. URI’s Justice Initiatives extend support beyond shelter, offering programs in economic empowerment, legal advocacy, youth prevention, and abusive partner intervention. URI also develops permanent affordable housing as part of its long\-term commitment to safety, stability, and healing.


**POSITION OVERVIEW**



The position supports families participating in the PALS program by assessing and addressing animal welfare needs throughout their shelter stay. Responsibilities include coordinating veterinary and behavioral services, providing pet welfare education, assisting clients with pet\-friendly resources and housing options, and collaborating with shelter staff and community partners.


**Salary: $49,000**


**MAJOR DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**


* Conduct comprehensive assessments for families seeking shelter and participation in PALS and offer ongoing support to ensure animal welfare issues are addressed, including assisting with safety planning, ensuring access to appropriate pet supplies, addressing medical needs, and overseeing the discharge planning process.
* Work closely with shelter staff and community partners to coordinate timely access to veterinary care for pets, including a vet exam, spay/neuter, vaccinations, micro\-chipping, basic care, and treatment related to animal abuse.
* Conduct preliminary pet assessments for animal behavior concerns and coordinate access to behavior therapy, where appropriate. Provide ongoing pet welfare education to clients, including an initial PALS orientation, case conferences and individual and group counseling, to support the continuum of care for adults, children and pets residing in shelter.
* Assist clients to identify and access “pet friendly” practices, including obtaining orders of protections for pets, exploring suitable temporary or permanent housing options, and addressing pet ownership issues.
* Identify, secure and monitor all necessary pet supplies and products related to PALS and oversee the inventory management process.
* In partnership with other PALS team members, coordinate and/or facilitate staff training related to animal welfare safety, including identifying signs of animal abuse, proper pet care and handling, and accessing appropriate community resources.
* Work closely with animal welfare partners to coordinate fostering, boarding and animal surrender, where appropriate.
* Represent URI at coalitions, taskforces and committees to ensure the continuation of solid collaborative approaches.
* Other duties as requested based on department, program and/or organizational needs.


**SPECIFICATIONS FOR EDUCATION/CERTIFICATIONS/LICENSES**


* High School Diploma or GED equivalent
* College Degree a plus
* Driver’s license, a plus

* Commitment to the vision and mission of Urban Resource Institute.

jobs.description:
**About Company:**


Evolution Research Group (ERG) is dedicated to delivering high\-quality Phase I–IV clinical trial execution to help sponsors bring lifesaving and life\-enhancing therapies to market quickly and safely. Founded in 2014, ERG has grown into a leading neuroscience clinical development company, with affiliate sites across the U.S. and deep expertise in clinical pharmacology, psychiatry, neurology, acute pain, and metabolic disorders. ERG has completed over 5,000 trials and continues to expand into high\-need therapeutic areas in the U.S. and globally.

**Why join us?** We offer a supportive culture, meaningful work, and the opportunity to contribute to cutting\-edge research alongside industry leaders. Plus, we offer competitive benefits include medical and dental coverage, a matching 401(k), and paid time off to recharge.

**Job Description:**


The Clinical Research Coordinator is responsible for the overall coordination, organization, management, and efficient implementation of clinical trials. The CRC completes all study related procedures and distributes study medication and instructions to research subjects under the direction of the Principal Investigator and the Site Director. They maintain accurate, confidential files and documentation of study participants. In executing these position responsibilities, the Clinical Research Coordinator is guided by FDA regulations, Good Clinical Practice (GCP), and company standard operating procedures and policies.

**Responsibilities:**

**General**

* Obtain detailed knowledge of all components of each study protocol through review and analysis of study information with Principal Investigator and Site Director prior to the effective date of the study.
* Assist to develop draft source documents and review the documents for accuracy and clarity prior to study start up.
* Review with Principal Investigator and Site Director, any components of the study for which additional information or clarification are required prior to the initiation of the study.
* Manage studies with direct oversight from Site Director, and Principal Investigator to ensure compliance with protocol requirements.
* Manage studies with Principal Investigator, Site Director, and Recruitment Manager to develop effective programs for study enrollment.
* Contribute to the SOP review and development as delegated by the Site Director.

**Study Management**

* Perform study activities as delegated by the Principal Investigator and under the supervision of the Site Director.
* Attend the investigator meeting for each assigned protocol, as appropriate with directive from Site Director.
* In conjunction with Site Director and Principal Investigator, ensure adherence to the protocols and document breaches or violations with sponsors and appropriate Institutional Review Boards (IRBs) and other outside regulatory organizations, as required.
* Screen, enroll subjects and schedule subject visits in conjunction with Principal Investigator
* Review and obtain informed consent from with potential study volunteer
* Document all written and phone correspondences with sponsor, labs, IRB other regulatory organizations
* Maintain organized, accurate and complete study records
* Assist Principal Investigator in conducting studies in manner to ensure integrity of data and safety of subjects.
* Enter data as appropriate for protocol (paper\-electronic data capture)
* In conjunction with Principal Investigator, accurately report and track adverse events as defined by each study protocol.
* Perform study close\-out procedures.
* Store study records appropriately
* Additionally, this role may encompass responsibilities beyond those outlined above, as required by the evolving needs of the organization. This job description is intended as a foundation and may be subject to expansion or modification to best suit ERG’s objectives.

**Skills and Qualifications:**

* **Education and experience**
	+ High School Diploma or its equivalent; College degree preferred.
	+ Able to communicate with providers, co\-workers, sponsors, and others in a collaborative and courteous manner.
	+ Knowledgeable in medical terminology to communicate with physician office and laboratory staff.
	+ Demonstrate the initiative to act independently, initiate activity as required and make appropriate decisions within the constraints of study protocols, regulatory requirements, and company policy.
	+ Able to initiate or modify behavior to achieve desired outcomes in spite of environmental factors, priorities, or problems that might not be well defined or that are subject to change.
* **Requirements**
	+ Understand regulatory requirements, as well as Good Clinical Practices (GCP) and International Conference of Harmonization (ICH) guidelines.
	+ Excellent communication skills (interpersonal, written, verbal)
	+ Basic computer skills to include Word, Excel, as well as proprietary applications unique to the clinical research industry (such as Study Manager)

Some products are designed and produced under our own label with specialist manufacturers in Europe, while others are sourced from makers and artisans around the world. Customers can purchase a ready\-made gift box, build their own, or shop individual pieces.

We are a small team, which means the work is broad, visible, and moves quickly.

**The Role**

We are looking for an E\-commerce Coordinator to help manage and grow Maure's online store, with a particular focus on Shopify merchandising, email marketing, product presentation, and digital creative production.

This is a hands\-on role for someone who enjoys the intersection of e\-commerce and creative work. You will spend part of your day working inside Shopify and Klaviyo and part of your day creating the visual and written content that brings our products and campaigns to life.

You will work closely with the founder and operations team on product launches, seasonal campaigns, merchandising, email, and website updates.

The ideal candidate is organized, visually minded, detail\-oriented, and comfortable taking a project from a general direction through execution. You should be someone who notices when a product page needs attention, recognizes when an image isn't working, and can figure out how to improve it.

This is an in\-person position based in New York.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Shopify \& E\-commerce**

* Manage day\-to\-day updates to the Maure Shopify store
* Add and maintain products, SKUs, pricing, collections, descriptions, and product content
* Build and update collection pages, landing pages, homepage content, and promotional placements
* Prepare new products for launch, ensuring product information, imagery, pricing, and merchandising are accurate and complete
* Maintain accurate product information across the site
* Monitor inventory and product availability and adjust merchandising accordingly
* Prioritize seasonal, promotional, and best\-selling products throughout the site
* Identify opportunities to improve product presentation, collection organization, navigation, and the overall shopping experience
* Maintain and organize the product image library
* Identify gaps in product imagery and create or coordinate the visual content needed to address them
* Conduct regular site checks to identify errors, outdated content, broken links, or other issues

**Email Marketing**

* Create and send approximately 2 Klaviyo campaigns per week
* Develop email concepts, copy, layouts, imagery, and calls to action
* Build and QA email campaigns before they are sent
* Coordinate email content with product launches, promotions, seasonal moments, and inventory priorities
* Maintain the email marketing calendar
* Review campaign performance and identify opportunities to improve future campaigns
* Ensure email content is accurate, proofread, on\-brand, and ready to send

**Creative \& Visual Production**

* Create original visual assets for the website, email, campaigns, and editorial content
* Develop product compositions, styled lifestyle imagery, seasonal campaign visuals, gift guides, and editorial imagery
* Take creative concepts from initial direction through final, publish\-ready asset
* Adapt, edit, and retouch existing photography and visual assets
* Create assets in the appropriate formats and dimensions for Shopify and Klaviyo
* Maintain a consistent visual identity across the website and other customer\-facing digital channels
* Work efficiently with existing product photography and brand assets to create new materials
* Stay current with evolving creative tools and techniques and identify opportunities to improve the quality and efficiency of content production

**Editorial \& Product Content**

* Create 1–2 gift guides per month
* Create 2–3 Maure Journal articles per month
* Write and edit product descriptions, promotional copy, collection copy, and other website content as needed
* Develop supporting content for product launches and seasonal campaigns
* Ensure all customer\-facing copy is clear, accurate, grammatically correct, and consistent with the Maure brand voice
* Repurpose existing product and campaign assets where appropriate

**Campaign \& Merchandising Support**

* Maintain a content and merchandising calendar across Shopify, Klaviyo, and editorial initiatives
* Coordinate website and email updates around product launches, promotions, holidays, and seasonal campaigns
* Assist in developing campaign concepts and translating them into cohesive website, email, and visual assets
* Work directly with the founder on seasonal creative direction and campaign planning
* Manage assigned projects from initial direction through creation, approval, scheduling, and publication
* Proactively identify upcoming content and merchandising needs
* Help ensure campaigns and recurring e\-commerce initiatives are completed accurately and on schedule

**Performance \& Optimization**

* Monitor website and email performance using Shopify and Klaviyo
* Track campaign performance and identify opportunities for improvement
* Review product and merchandising performance and flag opportunities to the team
* Test different creative approaches, messaging, products, and formats
* Use performance data and customer behavior to inform future merchandising and email decisions
* Bring recommendations to the founder based on what is working and what could be improved

**Qualifications**

* 1–3 years of experience in e\-commerce, digital merchandising, e\-commerce marketing, or a related role
* Hands\-on experience with Shopify
* Experience with Klaviyo or another comparable email marketing platform
* Proficiency with

jobs.title: Rail Operations Coordinator (Track Access and Outages)
jobs.description:
**This Opportunity**
--------------------

WSP is currently seeking a full\-time **Rail Operations Coordinator (Track Access and Outages)** to support construction projects managed from WSP's New York office located at One Penn Plaza. Potential work locations include project sites throughout the New York City region, including Manhattan, Brooklyn, Queens, Staten Island, and the Bronx.  



**This position requires full\-time, on\-site support at WSP construction field office locations. Remote or hybrid work arrangements are not available for this role.**

The selected candidate will perform technical and administrative functions critical to the planning, coordination, and execution of rail construction activities. Responsibilities include supporting track access and outage planning, coordinating with railroad operations and project stakeholders, facilitating contractor access requirements, and assisting in the development and implementation of construction staging and work\-window strategies. These efforts are essential to ensuring the safe, efficient, and uninterrupted execution of construction activities within active rail operating environments.  



This position offers the opportunity to work as part of WSP's nationally recognized Project Management and Construction Management practice, supporting complex transportation and infrastructure projects while contributing to solutions that help clients achieve their objectives and address operational challenges.


**Your Impact**
---------------

* Coordinate the development and implementation of Track Access Plans to maximize available access opportunities, optimize the use of scheduled rail outages, and consider competing access needs for other work.
* Assist in evaluating and identifying solutions to increase available track access time and support the efficient completion of contract work.
* Coordinate with the client and project team to evaluate potential operations and track access alternatives using client simulation models, which may include reverse running, service rerouting, temporary shutdowns, and other measures intended to provide additional track access time with minimal impact on passenger travel.
* Assist in identifying operational restrictions, limitations, and constraints that may affect project execution.
* Coordinate service plans, timetables, outages, work trains, Roadway Worker Protection requirements, and flagging activities required to support contractor operations within the railroad right\-of\-way.
* Coordinate planned construction activities with revenue service timetables and work train movements as required to progress the work.
* Coordinate planned work, in accordance with the approved schedule, with the client’s protective forces and the rail outages required to progress contract work.
* Verify that the contractor coordinates with required third\-party utilities and agencies in a timely manner to minimize interference with client operations.
* Monitor the use of the client’s Force Account resources and report variances.
* Coordinate and track approvals for contractor rail outage requests, access and protection requests, flagging requests, work train requests, test train requests, and related submissions.
* For weekend rail outage work, coordinate the team’s evaluation of work scheduled and accomplished, and document the reasons when scheduled work is not completed.
* Assist in planning and implementing field survey efforts that support construction activities.
* Assist with testing and commissioning planning activities.
* Coordinate the Flagging Team, including Change of Location requests and meetings.
* Assist in tracking work train usage and reviewing manifests.
* Assist in tracking field inspector timesheets and overtime sheets.
* Attend project coordination, operations planning, construction progress, and outage planning meetings, as required.
* Prepare reports, meeting minutes, schedules, logs, and other project documentation, as required.
* Exercise responsible and ethical decision\-making regarding company funds, resources, and conduct, and adhere to WSP’s Code of Conduct and related policies and procedures.
* Perform additional responsibilities as required by business needs.
**Who You Are**
---------------

**Required Qualifications**

* Minimum of 5 years of experience supporting construction, rail operations, project coordination, infrastructure programs, or related fields.
* High School Diploma or equivalent.
* Experience with construction planning, project coordination, inspections, or field operations.
* Experience coordinating, attending, documenting, and tracking regularly scheduled and ad hoc project meetings.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to prepare reports, meeting minutes, and project documentation.
* Strong organizational, time management, and multitasking skills.
* Demonstrated proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, including Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Outlook.
* Demonstrated experience on large\-scale governmental agency capital construction projects, including rail infrastructure construction.
* Demonstrated ability to evaluate contractor requests and coordinate with team members, clients, contractors, consultants, operations personnel, and project stakeholders.
* Familiarity with construction schedules, work planning, and project coordination activities.
* Possess a valid driver’s license.
* Must successfully complete and pass WSP’s Motor Vehicle screening.
* Proven track record of upholding workplace safety and ability to abide by WSP’s health, safety, drug/alcohol, and harassment policies.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management , Civil Engineering, Transportation, Project Management, Business Administration, or a related field from an accredited institution.
* Experience supporting railroad, transit, or transportation infrastructure projects.
* Experience working on major public agency

jobs.title: Reporting & Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Company Overview**  
Trusted by over 40,000 salons worldwide, Milbon has been exclusively partnering with salons and stylists for over 60 years. As the \#1 professional haircare company in Japan, with a rapidly expanding global footprint, we honor stylists for their expert skills, knowledge and professionalism. Through our continuous collaboration with stylists, we are able to find groundbreaking solutions that push the boundaries of the haircare industry.

**Position Overview**

The Reporting \& Operations Coordinator is a full\-time hybrid role based in New York, NY, with work\-from\-home flexibility. This role supports business operations through the preparation, maintenance, and distribution of business reports and operational data. This position is responsible for recurring reporting, data management, report development, and operational support while assisting with internal IT coordination and administrative functions.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Prepare, maintain, and distribute recurring business reports to support sales and operational decision\-making.
* Analyze, validate, and organize data from multiple sources, ensuring accuracy and consistency across reports.
* Develop and enhance reporting tools, templates, and dashboards based on business needs.
* Support promotional rebate reporting, including data collection, reconciliation, documentation, and coordination with internal and external stakeholders.
* Respond to reporting requests and provide insights to support business operations and performance tracking.
* Coordinate employee device procurement, deployment, inventory management, and basic IT support.
* Serve as a liaison with external vendors for equipment setup, system\-related issues, and technical support.
* Assist with business systems support, including Microsoft Dynamics Business Central (BC) and Direct Sales platforms.
* Provide administrative and operational support to the Business Operations team and contribute to process improvement initiatives.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams on projects and other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* Minimum 3 years of office administration, reporting, operations support, or related experience.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Office applications.
* Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment.

**Preferred**

* Experience in creating reports, dashboards, and business performance analyses.
* Background in Sales Operations, Business Operations, or a related function.
* Working knowledge of ERP systems, such as Microsoft Dynamics Business Central.
* Experience using Tableau, Power BI, or similar data visualization tools.
* Interest in reporting, business intelligence, and data\-driven decision\-making.

**Compensation**  
The annual salary range for this position is $50,000 \- $55,000 \+ semi\-annual bonus. Compensation will be determined based on relevant experience, skills, qualifications, and other job\-related factors.

**Location**  
Hybrid (New York, NY) Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States. This position follows a hybrid work schedule and requires onsite attendance at our New York headquarters approximately one day per week.

**Benefits include**

* Medical, Dental \& Vision Insurance
* Simple IRA with Company Match
* Semi\-Annual Bonus Opportunity
* Generous Paid Time Off and Sick Leave
* Paid Maternity, Paternity \& Prenatal Leave
* Life and Disability Insurance
* Employee Product Discounts
* Commuter Benefits

Milbon USA is an Equal Opportunity Employer. As a global organization, we value diversity, inclusion, and cross\-cultural collaboration. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees and make employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable law.

Pay: $50,000\.00 \- $55,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Commuter assistance
* Dental insurance
* Employee discount
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid parental leave
* Paid time off
* Retirement plan
* Vision insurance

Application Question(s):

* Will you now, or in the future, require sponsorship for employment visa status (e.g. H\-1B visa status)?

* Administrative: 1 year (Required)
* Analytical Reporting: 1 year (Required)
* Microsoft Office: 1 year (Required)

Ability to Commute:

* New York, NY 10036 (Required)

jobs.description:
**Community Coordinator \- P.S. 328 Phyllis Wheatley (19K328\)**
================================================================


* Posted Date: Aug 26, 2026 Deadline: Sep 7, 2026
**Job Details**
---------------


### **Position Summary:**


Under the supervision of the Principal, the Community Coordinator will perform duties related to developing and improving community relations. The Community Coordinator will support the school in its efforts to increase and maintain communication between the school and our students, families, staff, and community partners and other community organizations and high schools and colleges. The Community Coordinator will similarly work to develop and sustain positive relations with other schools in the community and other organizations within the NYC Department of Education. The Community Coordinator will also work with local businesses, corporations and community\-based organizations to solicit interest in supporting and/or providing sites for the school’s fieldwork, internship, community service or community farming programs. Current groups working with the school include: After\-school All Stars (CBO), Interborough Developmental and Consultation Center, District 19 partners, our afterschool program, and additional local community\-based organizations and educational partners. Performs related work.


### **Reports to:**


STH Regional Manager and Principal

Serves as a liaison between school administration and community groups by coordinating and facilitating communication between the school, staff, students, families, community organizations, businesses, government agencies and the communities that these vital organizations represent.

* Maintains ongoing contact with community based organizations (CBO’s) that are involved with providing services to support the school’s educational programs.
* Assists students and staff in building relationships with external partners including those connected to the school.
* Meets with community leaders and the administration to plan community events.
* Meets regularly and communicate with community partners to schedule a calendar of events for the fiscal year.

* Works with our various departments and Parent Association to support and develop the community workshops.
* Prepares correspondence, documents, and other forms of written communication for internal and external community outreach purposes.
* Provides logistical and administrative support to the Parent Coordinator and the Principal related to community outreach and parent engagement.
* Encourages participation from the school’s community groups in recreational activities and assists with the provision of related operational support including outreach to community agencies.
* Communicates school resources to parent community and supports the utilization of such resources by family members.
* Progress monitors STH student data, CEP goals and carries out action plans that support school priorities and achieving related goals.
* Identifies and applies for grant opportunities that support STH families.
* Facilitates student facing activities that support SEL and increase student outcomes such as small group discussions, incentive and rewards programs.
* Conducts attendance outreach in alignment of the school's attendance plan, including collaboration with local shelters and partners.
* Actively participate in school team meetings as the STH point person.
* Collaborate with school staff to coordinate and troubleshoot scheduling conflicts.
* Collaborate and work with office staff to support daily functions of the office as regards family interactions.
* Collaborate with the school’s payroll secretary to support the vetting and coordination of vendors, monitor the delivery of contracted services, and ensure required documentation, invoices, and supporting paperwork are complete and submitted in accordance with DOE procedures and timelines.

#### **Minimum**


* A baccalaureate degree from an accredited college and two years of experience in community work or community centered activities in an area related to the duties described above; or

#### **Preferred**


* Public speaking ability and good people skills.
* Ability to interact with people of all social and economic levels.
* Prior experience in school setting and interaction with students, parents, and school staff.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications.
* Ability to work with students, teachers, and supervisors.
* Knowledge of school program objectives.
* Strong literacy skills and the ability to troubleshoot complex issues when necessary.
* Ability to analyze and present data to all stakeholdergroups
* Proficiency with google applications
* Ability to organize and maintain records.

jobs.title: Administrative Coordinator, Legal & Sporting
jobs.description:
The National Women’s Soccer League (NWSL) is one of the fastest\-growing professional sports leagues in the U.S., powered by 16 clubs and a deep roster of the world’s best players, and built on record\-shattering fan, media and commercial growth. Now in its 14th season, the league’s momentum continues to accelerate, with viewership and attendance numbers growing rapidly, social media fandom on the rise, team valuations massively increasing and new top sponsors investing in the NWSL brand. This unprecedented growth in audience, media reach, and franchise value reflects the NWSL’s expanding fan base and increasing dominance in the sports\-media landscape and popular culture.

  

The future of the NWSL is now — and we’re looking for world\-class talent like you to help us continue the momentum.

### **The Role**


We are seeking an Administrative Coordinator to provide dedicated administrative and strategic support to the Chief Legal Officer (CLO) and Vice President, Sporting (VPS). The ideal candidate will demonstrate exceptional judgment and discretion, strong communication and organizational skills, and the ability to prioritize in a fast\-paced environment. This individual should proactively anticipate the needs of both executives, ensuring smooth daily operations and effective communication across departments.

### **What You Will Own \& Drive**

* Deliver strategic administrative support to the CLO and VPS, including managing schedules, coordinating travel, handling correspondence, and organizing meetings.
* Act as a liaison between the CLO and VPS, and other internal departments and external stakeholders, ensuring seamless communication and timely updates on key initiatives.
* Prepare materials for executive commitments, including presentations, press / speaking engagement briefings, project plans, and meeting summaries.
* Facilitate cross\-functional projects by working closely with the CLO and VPS, and other executives.
* Schedule and attend meetings, take detailed notes and document action items for follow\-up.
* Monitor and prioritize incoming communications, ensuring timely responses and efficient workflow.
* Maintain confidentiality and exercise discretion in handling sensitive information.
* Assist in documenting processes and workflows to enhance operational efficiency
* Assist in managing document retention policy

### **What You Will Bring**

#### **Core Qualifications**

* **Experience:** 3\+ years of progressive experience supporting senior executives or leadership teams.
* **Executive Support:** Proven ability to coordinate complex projects and manage rigorous executive follow\-up to ensure deliverables are met.
* **Communication:** Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to draft clear, concise professional correspondence.
* **Technical Proficiency:** Proficiency in Google Workspace (Gmail, Drive, Slides, Docs), Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint), and Slack.
* **Operational Skills:** Excellent organizational, time\-management, and problem\-solving abilities, with a proven track record of prioritizing tasks in a dynamic environment.
* **Adaptability:** Flexibility to work non\-traditional hours, including evenings and weekends, to support executive needs as they arise.

#### **Preferred Qualifications**

* **Strategic Foresight:** Demonstrated ability to "look around corners"—anticipating potential obstacles and proactively recommending ways to optimize an executive’s time.
* **Process Improvement:** Experience not only managing recurring cadences but also identifying and implementing opportunities for process improvement.
* **Crisis \& Priority Management:** Advanced ability to navigate urgent, competing priorities while maintaining a focus on long\-term strategic goals.
* **Autonomous Execution:** Highly self\-started and capable of working independently

### **Our Investment in You**


In addition to working in an incredible, inclusive, and committed\-to\-diversity culture, we offer:

* **Competitive Compensation:**$75,000\-$85,000 (Salary is contingent upon candidate qualifications and functional business needs).
* **Time \& Flexibility:** Unlimited Paid Time Off (PTO), sick days, and an end\-of\-year office closure.
* **Hybrid Work Model:** Three days in\-office and two remote days per week.
* **Robust Health Coverage:** Medical, Dental, Vision, and Mental Health benefits for employees and dependents.
* **Financial Future:** 401k with employer match and safe harbor contributions.
* **Comprehensive Benefits \& Perks:** Commuter Benefits, Short/Long\-Term Disability, Life Insurance, Gym On\-Site, Voluntary Pet Insurance, and more!

### **Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion**


The NWSL is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.


We celebrate diversity and are deeply committed to creating an inclusive and equitable environment for all employees. All employment decisions—including recruitment, hiring, placement, promotion, compensation, and termination—are made without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, pregnancy or childbirth, personal appearance, family responsibilities, sexual orientation or preference, gender identity, political affiliation, source of income, place of residence, national or ethnic origin, ancestry, age, marital status, military veteran status, unfavorable discharge from military service, physical or mental disability, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

  

If you need assistance or an accommodation during the application process due to a disability, you may contact us at careers@nwslsoccer.com.

jobs.title: Event Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
**Title:** Events Marketing Manager


**Reports to:** Chief Marketing Officer


**Location:** Brooklyn, NY or Marina del Rey, CA — onsite Monday–Friday


**Who is Flip?**



There are 3 runaway categories in B2B AI — coding, legal, and customer support. We're at the center of the third, with a one\-of\-one market position and hundreds of diehard fan clients, from Under Armour to Tory Burch to some of the largest healthcare institutions in the country.



The market is dividing into two camps: generic tooling\-and\-FDE players building custom agents from scratch, and industry\-specific solutions winning on client love due to speed of ROI. We're firmly the latter. Retail and healthcare alone represent $5B\+ TAMs each, and we're still early.



We built the company on a simple idea: the best way to grow is to have a reference list as long as your customer list. We're a team of 100\+ now, with offices in NYC, LA, and the UK. Many people here will tell you it's the best place they've worked and the hardest they've worked. Both are true.


### **The Role**



Events are one of the biggest ways we grow across the three industries we serve — retail, healthcare, and transportation. From major trade shows and conferences to client experiences (Flippin' Legends), brand activations, and internal company events, you'll own Flip's event presence end to end.



You know the B2B trade show world inside and out, love planning the work and working the plan, and hold everyone around you to the same standard. Our creative and content teams bring the ideas — your job is to execute them exceptionally. Not just done, but done right, on time, and on budget.


### **What You'll Own**


* **Trade shows \& conferences.** Own Flip's presence end to end. Identify the right events across retail, healthcare, and transportation, negotiate sponsorships and booth packages, manage all logistics, and ensure Flip shows up in a way that turns heads and drives pipeline. Retail industry trade show experience is a strong plus.
* **Pre\-event planning.** Build detailed event plans and timelines well in advance. Coordinate across sales, marketing, and leadership to align on goals, messaging, and on\-site experience. Manage all vendor relationships, contracts, and deadlines.
* **Budget management \& ROI.** Own event budgets from estimate through reconciliation, delivering maximum impact within a reasonable spend. Track and report ROI for every event — leads generated, pipeline influenced, brand impressions, follow\-up conversion — and use that data to prioritize the events that deliver.
* **On\-site execution \& team leadership.** Lead the team on the ground at every event. Manage setup, staffing, scheduling, and real\-time problem solving. Ensure every detail is executed to plan and the Flip team is set up to have meaningful conversations and capture every lead.
* **Post\-event follow\-through.** Debrief the team, report results, coordinate with sales on lead follow\-up, and document learnings. Every event should make the next one better.
* **Brand activations, swag \& content.** Partner with creative and content to bring activations to life; source and track event merchandise and collateral; coordinate photo, video, and client interview capture for social and post\-event promotion.
* **Internal events.** Plan and coordinate events for the Flip team — company meetings, offsites, industry parties, and client dinners.

### **What We're Looking For**


* **3\+ years managing B2B trade shows and industry conferences**, with end\-to\-end ownership of logistics, sponsorships, and on\-site execution.
* **Retail industry familiarity is a strong plus** — you know its major trade shows and how buyers show up at them.
* **Exceptional organizational and project management skills** — multiple events and deadlines at once, without dropping a detail.
* **Proven budget ownership and ROI fluency.** You've built and managed event budgets, negotiated with vendors and organizers, and used performance data to inform future strategy.
* **Strong leadership on the ground** — comfortable directing teams and vendors in a fast\-paced environment, and holding partners accountable without losing the relationship.
* **A natural collaborator** who translates creative and content teams' ideas into flawless execution.
* **Relentless attention to detail.** You love a checklist, own every open item, and don't stop until everything is closed out.
* **Adaptable and calm under pressure.** If you're a chaos\-wrangler who brings order to complexity, we want to meet you.

### **More About Us**


* We're international, spanning the US, UK, and Canada
* We've raised \+$30M to date including our recent $20M Series A \- backed by Ridge, Next Coast, ScOp, Bullpen Capital, Data Point and Forum Ventures, as well as founders \& executives from Amazon Alexa, Ada, Attentive, and Simon Data
* We are hiring two Customer Content Marketers in this role; one for our eCom/retail vertical and one for our Healthcare vertical.
* Comprehensive healthcare and unlimited vacation, including a mandatory half week for everyone over July 4, and a full week off at the end of the year

jobs.title: Client Account Manager- SMB

SpaceXAI's mission is to create AI systems that can accurately understand the universe and aid humanity in its pursuit of knowledge. Our team is small, highly motivated, and focused on engineering excellence. This organization is for individuals who appreciate challenging themselves and thrive on curiosity. We operate with a flat organizational structure. All employees are expected to be hands\-on and to contribute directly to the company's mission. Leadership is given to those who show initiative and consistently deliver excellence. Work ethic and strong prioritization skills are important. All employees are expected to have strong communication skills. They should be able to concisely and accurately share knowledge with their teammates.

### **ABOUT THE ROLE:**



We are hiring an SMB Client Account Manager to own a portfolio of small\- and medium\-sized advertisers and their agencies. You will act as a trusted advisor: uncovering business goals, recommending X advertising products and best practices, executing and optimizing campaigns, and driving measurable growth. This role blends hands\-on campaign management with strategic relationship\-building and a bias toward action in a fast\-moving environment.



Ideal candidates are proactive, analytically minded, and comfortable working with limited supervision while collaborating across sales, product, and finance teams.


### **RESPONSIBILITIES:**


* Own a portfolio of SMB advertisers: understand growth drivers, identify opportunities and risks, and build plans that help clients meet or exceed their goals.
* Consult clients and agencies on X advertising products, campaign setup, targeting, creative, and measurement; educate them on best practices so they can succeed independently and with our support.

* Conduct outreach and regular business reviews to strengthen relationships, surface new opportunities, and improve results.
* Identify key stakeholders at each account and help shape their digital marketing plans around X.
* Resolve campaign and operational issues quickly; flag process gaps and feed insights back to product and tools teams.
* Support contract, renewal, billing, and collections processes in partnership with Sales Finance.
* Collaborate with the broader sales team to align on priorities, share learnings, and deliver a consistent client experience.
* Mentor newer teammates as the team scales.

### **BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:**


* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 2–3\+ years in digital advertising, sales, marketing, media account management, or consulting (agency or client\-side).
* Proven ability to build and grow client relationships, manage multiple accounts, and navigate competing priorities.
* Experience translating marketing objectives into campaigns, then optimizing them using performance data.
* Strong written and verbal communication and presentation skills; comfort speaking with business owners and marketing leads.
* Demonstrated ownership, attention to detail, and ability to work independently in a small, high\-pace team.
* Solid understanding of the digital advertising landscape and competitive platforms.

### **PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:**


* Direct experience managing SMB or mid\-market advertisers and hitting growth or revenue targets.
* Familiarity with social/platform advertising products (X Ads a plus) and how they fit into a broader media mix.
* Ability to use data and questioning to uncover insights, handle objections, and build compelling recommendations.
* Experience mentoring or onboarding others in a growth\-stage environment.
* Passion for X's mission around free speech and open public conversation, plus comfort in a dynamic, high\-ownership culture.

### **COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:**



$72,000 \- $95,000 USD base salary \+ commission



Base salary is just one part of our total rewards package at SpaceXAI, which also includes equity, comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short \& long\-term disability insurance, life insurance, and various other discounts and perks.

jobs.description:
At Trustpilot, we're on an incredible journey. We're a profitable, high\-growth FTSE\-250 company with a big vision: to become the universal symbol of trust. We run the world's largest open customer review platform, and while we've come a long way, there's still so much exciting work to do. Come join us at the heart of trust!


As a SMB Account Manager, you are responsible for retaining and growing a defined portfolio of existing customers in the US market. You act as the commercial owner of each relationship — driving renewals, expanding accounts, and positioning Trustpilot as a long\-term partner that delivers measurable business value.



You combine commercial acumen with relationship depth, collaborating closely with Customer Success Managers to ensure adoption, satisfaction, and sustainable revenue growth.



You are accountable for contributing to strong Gross Renewal Rate (GRR) and Net Revenue Retention (NRR) results by executing defined renewal processes, maintaining Salesforce accuracy, and supporting customers to achieve measurable value.


**What you'll be doing:**


* Retention \& Renewal: Own the end\-to\-end renewal process, delivering high Gross Renewal Rates (GRR) and predictable retention.
* Growth \& NRR: Drive portfolio expansion through upsell and cross\-sell to achieve strong Net Revenue Retention (NRR) and overall portfolio growth.
* Account Planning: Build and maintain detailed account plans, stakeholder maps, and accurate forecasts in Salesforce.
* Customer Engagement: Lead commercial and strategic conversations, including business reviews and contract discussions.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Customer Success to ensure value realization, with Marketing on customer stories, and with Product on feedback loops.
* Operational Excellence: Ensure accurate data, forecasting discipline, and pipeline visibility across your portfolio.


**Who you are:**


* You have experience in account management, renewals, or a similar customer\-facing role within a SaaS or subscription\-based company.
* Strong understanding of retention, NRR, upsell, and cross\-sell motions.
* Solid commercial awareness with the ability to link product value to customer outcomes.
* Skilled at managing a large portfolio and keeping accurate account data in CRM systems.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and negotiation skills.
* Comfortable analysing account performance data and forecasting renewals.
* Able to work cross\-functionally and thrive in a fast\-moving, target\-driven environment.
* A good understanding of the digital advertising/search marketing industry – preferred.


**What's in it for you:**


* A competitive base salary of $70,000\-77,000 gross per year (depending on level and experience), plus a competitive commission structure. The base salary range stated doesn't include any variable pay such as bonuses or commission, or other benefits.
* A range of flexible working options to dedicate time to what matters to you
* 20 vacation days \+ 2 personal days \+10 paid holidays per year
* Two (paid) volunteering days a year to spend your time giving back to the causes that matter to you and your community
* Rich learning and development opportunities supported through the Trustpilot Academy, and Blinkist
* Full health insurance
* 401k matching your contributions dollar\-for\-dollar up to 4% of your base salary
* 24/7 Employee Assistance Plan and full access to Headspace, a popular mindfulness app to promote positive mental health
* Paid parental leave for employees who have been employed for over 6 months with full full scope of benefit after 12 months
* Regular opportunities to connect and get to know your fellow Trusties, including company\-wide celebrations and events, ERG activities and team socials
* A friendly, fun and open office complete with a rooftop, gaming room and fully stocked fridge with ever changing snacks and drinks
* Dog friendly office


**Still unsure?**  

We want everyone to feel welcome at Trustpilot. We're excited to hear about your experiences and how you can help us create a great culture for our team. So don't worry if you don't tick every single box \- we'd still love to hear from you!



\#LI\-JL1

 **About us**



Trustpilot began in 2007 with a simple yet powerful idea that is more relevant today than ever — to be the universal symbol of trust, bringing consumers and businesses together through reviews. Trustpilot is open, independent, and impartial — we help consumers make the right choices and businesses to build trust, grow and improve.



Today, we have more than 350 million reviews and 60 million monthly active users across the globe, with 149 billion annual Trustpilot brand impressions, and the numbers keep growing. We have more than 1000 employees and we're headquartered in Copenhagen, with operations in Amsterdam, Denver, Edinburgh, Hamburg, London, Melbourne, Milan and New York.



We're driven by connection. It's at the heart of what we do. Our culture keeps things fresh –– it's built on the relationships we create. We talk, we laugh, we collaborate and we respect each other. We work across borders and cultures to be the universal symbol of trust in an ever\-changing world. With vibrant office locations worldwide and over 50 nationalities, we're proud to be an equal opportunity workplace with diverse perspectives and ideas.



Our purpose to help people and businesses help each other is a tall order, but we keep it real. We're a great bunch of humans, doing awesome stuff, without fuss or pretense. A successful Trustpilot future is driven by you –– we give you the autonomy to shape a career you can be proud of. If you're ready to grow, let's go.

As a catalyst for breakthrough science, amfAR supports innovative research in HIV and other diseases where viruses and the immune system play a critical role. Since 1985, amfAR has raised more than $950 million and awarded in excess of 3,900 grants to scientists worldwide.

**PRIMARY FUNCTION:**

The Social Media Manager will lead the execution and growth of amfAR’s social media presence, prioritizing Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn and YouTube (while also being proficient in Facebook and X). Reporting to the Director of Integrated Marketing, this role will develop and produce compelling digital storytelling that highlights amfAR’s scientific leadership, global impact, and philanthropic community. This hands\-on content role will not only shape strategy, but will also create original content, including video, photography, and written posts, as well as capture real\-time moments that bring amfAR’s mission to life online.

A key part of this role will be covering amfAR’s high\-profile fundraising events and galas, producing dynamic social content that highlights the impact and community behind these gatherings.

The ideal candidate is adept at identifying trending stories and cultural moments, and who can use social media to translate mission\-driven work into content that informs, inspires, and mobilizes audiences.

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Plan, create, edit, and schedule organic and sponsored social media content ensuring alignment with voice, brand, and organization initiatives.
* Develop and maintain integrated social media content calendar aligned with marketing campaigns, research announcements, special events, and advocacy initiatives.
* Create social media strategy for amfAR’s portfolio of domestic and international fundraising events and galas, including leading development of platform specific coverage live on\-site before, during, and after events (behind\-the\-scenes content, interviews, and highlight moments) in collaboration with Media Relations team.
* Liaise with sponsors and partners to develop unique content that aligns with amfAR’s mission and exposes new audiences to the organization.
* Work interdepartmentally among Public Information, Public Policy and Research teams to highlight amfAR’s grantees and supporters, translating complex research and policy topics into accessible, engaging digital content.
* Partner with Philanthropy team and find new ways for utilizing social media for fundraising, and building donor loyalty.
* Manage social listening and engage in organization\-related online conversations; respond to social media inquiries in a timely and courteous fashion.
* Collaborate with the media relations team to build and foster relationships with influencers and creators, developing platform\-specific content that supports brand campaigns, events and overall organizational goals.
* Monitor social media industry trends, tools, and applications and recommend actions and next steps.
* Create quantitative and qualitative analysis reports of social media content performance for the management team and Board of Trustees.
* Demonstrated ability and willingness to leverage AI technologies to support job responsibilities, improve workflows, and adapt to evolving business needs.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* 5\-7 years of social media management experience with a brand, nonprofit organization, media company, or digital agency and a proven history of growing social audiences.
* Proficiency in creating and producing niche\-specific content for social media platforms (especially with TikTok, Instagram, and LinkedIn).
* Technical knowledge and understanding of Meta Business Suite, LinkedIn Business Manager, and TikTok Ads Manager.
* Familiarity with social media management and listening platforms such as Sprout Social and Meltwater to support content planning, publishing, audience engagement, and performance analytics.
* BA in communications, marketing or a related field preferred.
* Experience with global health media and knowledge of HIV/AIDS issues and policies preferred, but not required.
* Excellent creative writing and oral communication skills with the ability to adapt tone for different audiences and platforms.
* Basic video editing capabilities required.
* Proficiency with common computer office applications.
* Strong team collaboration and interpersonal skills.
* Exceptional organizational skills and the ability to multi\-task and work in a fast\-moving environment.
* Flexibility to work extended hours and travel both domestically and internationally.

Outstanding benefits package that encompasses: medical, dental, life, STD, LTD, vision coverage, commuter, dependent care and medical FSA savings, 403B with a very generous employer match. Time off includes: vacation, personal, sick days, and Summer Fridays.

jobs.description:
**Break Into Tech Sales — No Experience Needed**


If you’ve been trying to get your foot in the door but keep hearing “you need experience first”… this is for you.


We’re hiring driven, curious individuals ready to start a career in tech sales as a Business Development Representative (BDR). Whether you’re coming from retail, teaching, hospitality, admin, or something completely different—what matters most is your mindset, not your resume.

**You don't pay us. We pay you.**


SV Academy is hiring **Business Development Representatives**. Free sales training, a 90\-day paid Residency at $2,500/month plus 100% commission, then transfer to a partner company's payroll at $65,000 \- $95,000 with full benefits.


No tuition. No loans. No deferred\-income agreement. We're paid out of the hiring budget the partner was already going to spend — which is why this costs you nothing.


Cohorts begin every week and are limited to 25 Residents. Apply early to be considered for the next available start date.

* Reaching out to potential customers through calls, emails, and LinkedIn

**What You’ll Gain:**

* Real, in\-demand sales experience from day one
* Ongoing coaching and support (not just a one\-week onboarding)
* A clear path into long\-term roles in tech

**Who This Is For:**

* You’re early in your career or making a career switch

* You want a role where effort actually translates into growth and opportunity


If you’re tired of being overlooked because you don’t have traditional experience, this is your chance to change that.


Compensation at Each Stage* **Days 1–10** — Free sales training. No tuition, no fee, no debt. Live, instructor\-led training on Zoom, Monday through Thursday, 6–9 pm (ET or PT).
* **Days 11–100** — Paid Residency. $2,500/month base \+ 100% of the commissions you earn. You'll be a W\-2 employee of SV Academy, embedded at a partner company.
* **Day 100 onward** — Transfer to the partner's payroll. $65,000 \- $95,000 in total annual compensation (base \+ commission). Full health, dental, vision, and retirement benefits begin the day you transfer.


About SV Academy
Since 2017, we've placed more than **6,000** people into full\-time tech sales careers and worked with **400\+ employer partners** across SaaS, AI, fintech, cybersecurity, and other high\-growth verticals.


Led by CEO Michael Colonnese, a 15\+ year veteran of workforce development focused on building debt\-free pathways into tech careers.


Our partners pay us. You don't. That's the entire business model.


Who Tends to Succeed Here
No prior sales experience required. We hire people who are competitive and motivated by clear goals, comfortable on the phone (including cold calls), coachable, resilient, and strong communicators.


If you've worked in retail, hospitality, customer service, fundraising, fitness instruction, teaching, or any role where you spent your day talking to people and meeting goals — you already have the foundation to be excellent at this.

* Full\-time availability during the 100\-day program
* Legal authorization to work in the country where this role is posted
* Strong written and verbal English communication
* Available for evening training sessions (Mon–Thu, 6–9 pm EDT) during the first 2 weeks
* Located in or able to reliably commute to the partner site (the Residency portion is hybrid)

  

**Requirements**  

  

Required Qualifications:* Interest in starting a career in tech sales (SDR/BDR roles)
* Comfort with cold calling and outbound outreach
* Willingness and ability to learn common SDR tools such as CRM systems (Salesforce or HubSpot), sales engagement platforms (Outreach or Salesloft), prospecting tools (ZoomInfo), dialers, and LinkedIn Sales Navigator
* Interest in working in a tech sales context within Information Technology and Services
* Experience in a customer\-facing role requiring strong written and verbal communication skills
* Professional proficiency in English
* Authorization to work in the United States without sponsorship

  

**Benefits**  

* Comprehensive 2\-week online bootcamp training
* Paid 3\-month residency with an employer partner
* Remote work environment
* Exposure to leading technology companies and sales teams
* Professional development and mentorship opportunities
* Supportive community and network of peers

jobs.title: Sales Representative I
jobs.description:
**About NYC Health \+ Hospitals**
---------------------------------

  


MetroPlus**Health** provides the highest quality healthcare services to residents of Bronx, Brooklyn, Manhattan, Queens and Staten Island through a comprehensive list of products, including, but not limited to, New York State Medicaid Managed Care, Medicare, Child Health Plus, Exchange, Partnership in Care, MetroPlus Gold, Essential Plan, etc. As a wholly\-owned subsidiary of NYC Health \+ Hospitals, the largest public health system in the United States, MetroPlus**Health**'s network includes over 27,000 primary care providers, specialists and participating clinics. For more than 40 years, MetroPlus**Health** has been committed to building strong relationships with its members and providers.


Purpose of Position:


Under supervision, identifies qualified participants and educates them as to the benefits of selecting MetroPlus as a managed care provider. Achieves predetermined monthly enrollments based on regularly updated goals and objectives. May provide training of and/or supervision to subordinate staff and maintains a positive public relations presence within the community.


**Work Shifts**
---------------

  


**9:00 A.M – 5:00 P.M**

  

**Duties \& Responsibilities**
------------------------------

  


Level I

* Implement methods, activities and action plans necessary to achieve daily, weekly and monthly objectives.
* Presents clear and accurate information regarding health plan to eligible recipients and community\-at\-large.
* Performs group and individual presentations for purpose of educating and enrolling qualified participants in a variety of arenas included but not limited to income support centers, provider sites, churches, WIC programs and shelters.
* Presents MetroPlusHealth Plan information to HHC employees at annually designated open enrollment periods.
* Performs telemarketing activities as appropriate for purposes of enrollment and follow\-up activity.
* Maintains accurate documentation related to enrollment and field activities.
* Participates in regularly scheduled sales/marketing meetings as required.
* Performs other related tasks as directed.


**Minimum Qualifications**
--------------------------

  


1\. Satisfactory completion of three months of training and orientation administered by MHP personnel; or,  

2\. High School graduation or evidence of having satisfactorily passed a High School  

Equivalency Program; and,  

3\. Demonstrated skills in written and or oral communication; and,  

4\. Minimum one year of experience in direct consumer contact, sales and/or social services; or,  

5\. A satisfactory equivalent combination of education, training and experience.  

6\. Knowledge of a second language may be required.  

  

Special Notes:  

1\. For placement in Assignment Level II, candidates must possess one (1\) year of experience in Assignment Level I or an additional year of related full\-time experience.  

2\. For placement in Assignment Level III, candidates must possess one (1\) year of experience in Assignment Level II or an additional two (2\) years of related full\-time experience, with at least one (1\) of those years in a supervisory capacity.


**Benefits**
------------

  


NYC Health and Hospitals offers a competitive benefits package that includes:

* Comprehensive Health Benefits for employees hired to work 20\+ hrs. per week
* Retirement Savings and Pension Plans
* Paid Holidays and Vacation in accordance with employees' Collectively bargained contracts
* Loan Forgiveness Programs for eligible employees
* College tuition discounts and professional development opportunities
* College Savings Program
* Union Benefits for eligible titles
* Multiple employee discounts programs
* Commuter Benefits Programs


**How To Apply**
----------------

  


If you wish to apply for this position, please apply online by clicking the "Apply for Job" button.

**Pay:** $40,000–$60,000 per year

Job Description

PCBA KING is looking for a driven, competitive **Outside Sales Representative** to develop new business and grow our customer base across the U.S.

**This is a true boots\-on\-the\-ground outside sales position.** We are looking for someone who will literally **knock on doors, visit customers and prospects in person, follow up on leads, and hand\-deliver line cards and sales materials.**

This is **not an order\-taking or desk sales role.** We want a hunter who enjoys getting out into the market, meeting customers face\-to\-face, opening doors, and creating new business from scratch.

What You'll Do

* **Visit customers and prospective customers in person**
* **Knock on doors and introduce PCBA KING to new businesses**
* **Visit and qualify leads face\-to\-face**
* **Hand\-deliver line cards and sales materials**
* Prospect aggressively for new accounts within your territory

* Comfortable walking into a business and starting a conversation

* Competitive, self\-motivated, and results\-driven

jobs.description:
Discover Your Career at Emory University: Emory University is a leading research university that fosters excellence and attracts world\-class talent to innovate today and prepare leaders for the future. We welcome candidates who can contribute to the excellence of our academic community. Description:

A team of researchers in the Departments of Epidemiology and Global Health at Emory University’s Rollins School of Public Health has been conducting research aimed at improving prevention, care, and treatment of tuberculosis (TB) including drug\-resistant TB, TB/HIV co\-infection and latent TB infection, post\-TB lung disease, as well as examining the impact of TB on non\-communicable diseases such as diabetes and cardiovascular health. The group collaborates with partners at other U.S. institutions as well as partners based at international sites in Botswana, country of Georgia, Philippines, South Africa and Brazil.
We are seeking a self\-motivated, highly\-organized Project Coordinator with experience in research project management and enthusiasm for public health work, who will be responsible for coordinating and monitoring the quality and project progress of a NIH\-funded TB research project being conducted in Botswana. This position requires up to 30\-35% travel to the study site for monitoring project progress on a quarterly basis (1\-2 week trips). This position will support the work of Principal Investigators within our team and report directly to the Program Director. The Project Coordinator is a hybrid position, with a requirement of working on campus a minimum of 2 days per week.

* Manages a project.

* Assists in developing, administering and monitoring project related budgets.
* Coordinates logistical arrangements for related conferences, conventions or meetings.
* May assist in identifying funding resources and in developing funding strategies and initiatives.

* Develop, implement, and track project work plans for all relevant study activities in collaboration with study personnel at domestic sites.

* Conduct quarterly domestic site visits lasting 1\-2 weeks for project implementation and monitoring, and to represent the Emory\-based study team. * Work with Principal Investigator and Program Director to monitor project\-related budgets including reviewing project ledgers and invoices and tracking project expenses.
* Except for during site visits, work from assigned desk located in Rollins School of Public Health as part of a hybrid work schedule, including 2\-3 on\-campus workdays per week.
