**Posting Expires: 9/8/2026**

**Salary Range: $58,977\.96\- $78,735\.58**

**General Description and Classification Standards**  

First point of contact with the public and serve liaisons between the public and all aspects of the permitting process across all offices within the City of Atlanta. Work to proactively resolve issues through reports, and work in real\-time to resolve issues via inbound calls, emails, and face\-to\-face interactions. The incumbent must provide exceptional customer service on behalf of the City of Atlanta. The ideal candidate provides best\-in\-class customer service to all customers (internal and external) who either call or enter the office; approach customers courteously, conversationally, and immediately – with a smile. The candidate must be able to quickly assess and identify the needs of the customer through probing and listening – eventually suggesting and providing general direction and assistance to the public. Must be a
  

curious and intentional learner; one who is willing to go the extra mile to assist customers. This is a public\-facing opportunity that ensures our department standards are maintained through consistent efforts. This position advises upper\-level management of any process and procedure inconsistencies. While in this role, a large degree of professionalism and problem\-solving skills is expected. The candidate must be able to work in a team\-centered environment yet can function independently. This
  

person will also serve as a member of the Development Services Team and work to maneuver customers who are experiencing lags in the permitting process. Incumbents must be versed in reading and understanding the associated reports and can communicate across departmental lines to move stagnant permits to the point of issuance. The incumbent must ensure that best\-in\-class customer service is provided to both internal and external customers and embrace, support, and promote the City’s core values, beliefs, and culture.  

  



**Supervision Received**  

Works under general supervision reporting directly to the Building \& Development Manager.


  
**Essential Duties \& Responsibilities**  

Establish and maintain positive and professional relationships with customers, assigned staff, and coworkers.
  

Maintain professionalism, and composure, and demonstrate tact, patience, and courtesy always.
  

Greets customers in a friendly, kind, and helpful manner.
  

Process intake and issuance of all types of building permit applications. This function requires the candidate
  

to have the ability to read and understand civil and architectural plans.
  

Promptly answer phone calls, emails, and other correspondence within the Office of Buildings and
  

accurately direct guests to appropriate personnel or Work Stream
  

Provide a variety of administrative and customer service activities to assist any customer visiting the Office
  

of Buildings. Assist with customers who are seeking information or requesting copies of documents retained by the Office
  

of Buildings through the Records Retention process.
  

Receive, respond, and provide the outcome to complaints from customers.
  

Interview citizens either by phone or in person to determine the details of the inquiry or problem.
  

Advise departmental personnel, citizens, and others on the status of permit applications that are pending
  

and make referrals to other agencies as appropriate.
  

  

Demonstrate excellent customer service, organizational, and communication skills.
  

Provide proactive support to a variety of internal and external customers concerning a broad base of City
  

issues relating to permitting/zoning, projects, services, and customer concerns.
  

Enter, and update data into the computer system (Accela).
  

Review daily updates concerning new City activities/events/ordinances/legislation.
  

Ensures all inquiries from the mail, walk\-in, and telephone receive prompt and courteous responses.
  

Escalate problems as necessary to ensure resolution; follow up on open tickets and request for final
  

resolution.
  

Taking ownership of the entire permitting process; Attending to all permit\-related customer service
  

inquiries; Moving Stagnant Permits; Educating customers on the permitting process; Resolving issues
  

without escalation; Walking customers through the electronic submittal process when necessary;
  

Communicating issues that require escalation through the proper chain of command; Registering and

jobs.title: Field Sales Representative
jobs.description:
**Company Description**  

At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content \- wherever and whenever it’s consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future.

 **Job Description**  

As a Senior Panel Recruitment Coordinator I, you'll be the face of our company, recruiting households to participate in Nielsen ratings. This role requires travel up to 50% of the time. You'll use your unique combination of skills, knowledge, and style to consistently achieve in\-person recruitment, resolution, and installation targets across various locations.


Candidates must reside in the Buffalo, NY area to be considered for this position.

 **Qualifications**  

Key Responsibilities:

* Drive to selected homes using a company\-provided vehicle, with frequent travel (up to 50%)
* Conduct in\-person interviews and recruit statistically selected households
* Collect and enter household demographics and technical data
* Collaborate with various departments to ensure compliance with procedures
* Meet performance goals, quality standards, and customer satisfaction targets
* Be prepared for overnight stays up to half of your working time


What are the qualifications?

* High School Diploma/GED OR 2\+ years equivalent work experience
* Valid driver's license and satisfactory driving record
* Strong computer skills (iOS, MS Windows, Google applications)
* Excellent communication and persuasion skills
* Ability to read and write English
* Ability to work non\-traditional hours, including evenings and weekends
* Willingness and ability to travel overnight up to 50% of the time
* Adaptability and openness to diverse environments:
* Due to the nature of randomly selected panel homes, you must be willing and able to interact with diverse people, neighborhoods, and conditions of homes for several hours at a time.
* Be prepared to encounter varying situations, which may include a variety of pets, as well as different levels of cleanliness or disarray that meet Nielsen's health and safety standards.
* Comfort with working in various home environments while maintaining professionalism
* Strong interpersonal skills to navigate diverse social situations effectively


Physical Requirements:

* Must be willing and able (with or without reasonable accommodation) to be outside, in all weather conditions recruiting preselected residential addresses.
* Be able to navigate stairs, elevators, walkways, and driveways (paved and unpaved) and a wide variety of entrances into people’s homes
* Driving for up to 8 hours a day
* Standing for up to 6 hours a day
* Kneeling for up to 2 hours a day
* Ability to walk 1/2 mile
* Ability to lift 20 lbs.

  

**Additional Information** **Enabling your best to power a better media future.**

**Holistic Rewards:** We are committed to an inclusive benefits package that supports our employees and their families. This includes comprehensive health and wellness plans, a 401(k) with a Nielsen company match, and a generous paid time off policy. Depending on the role, additional benefits may include a company\-provided vehicle and/or discretionary incentive/bonus eligibility.

**Compensation Transparency:** The posted base salary range is a reasonable estimate that may be adjusted based on the final work location of the selected employee. Individual pay within the range is determined by factors such as experience, training, geography, certifications, and business needs. Beyond base salary, this role may be eligible for bonuses, equity, or other incentives**.**



Nielsen makes hiring decisions without regard to disability status, protected veteran status, or membership in any other protected class.



Please be aware that job\-seekers may be at risk of targeting by scammers seeking personal data or money. Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a nielsen.com domain. Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nielsen via other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. Always verify that email communications come from an @nielsen.com address. If you're unsure about the authenticity of a job offer or communication, please contact Nielsen directly through our official website or verified social media channels.

Description:

The TPA Account Manager owns the overall client and broker relationship and is responsible for delivering proactive, high\-quality client experience. The TPA Account Manager should know the account, understand the numbers, identify issues early, and bring recommendations and solutions.

* Own assigned client relationships and understand key contacts, goals, concerns, plan design, funding, stop\-loss, network/RBP, pharmacy, vendors and renewal timing.

* Experience in account management, client services, employee benefits, healthcare, TPA, PBM, insurance or a related field.

* Strong communication, organization, analytical, presentation and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to work cross\-functionally and take ownership of outcomes.
* Ability to travel as needed for client meetings

**Preferred**

* Experience with self\-funded health plans, RBP, network products, pharmacy benefits or cost\-containment programs.
* Experience interpreting claims and utilization reporting.

**Key Competencies**

* Client relationship management and strategic account management
* Proactive communication and responsiveness
* Claims and financial understanding
* Problem solving and issue resolution
* Accountability and ownership
* Cross\-functional collaboration
* Organization and attention to detail
* Presentation and communication skills
* Ability to identify risks and opportunities

As a Telephone Sales Representative (TSR), you will be responsible for making outbound fundraising calls to potential donors, engaging in conversations, and soliciting pledges for client projects. * **Stamina:** Telephone fundraisers spend long hours on the phone, making numerous calls throughout their shifts. They should have the physical stamina to maintain energy and enthusiasm during extended periods of talking.
* **Sitting or Standing:** Telephone fundraisers typically work on computers with headsets attached, where they are seated for most of their shifts. However, some employees may invest in standing workstations where they would be allowed limited movement during calls.
* **Manual Dexterity:** Basic computer skills are often required for data entry and managing donor information. Telephone fundraisers should be comfortable using a computer, typing quickly, and navigating various software or database systems.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager II - Atlanta, GA
jobs.description:
OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category\-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high\-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com.

**Job Summary**
---------------


As a Customer Success Manager II at OpenGov, you own and manage a portfolio of \~80 customers, ensuring they don’t just use our software but transform how they serve their communities. This is not a passive support role; it is a proactive, commercially\-driven position designed for a high\-achiever who thrives on organization, relationship\-building, and hitting retention targets.

**What You’ll Do (Responsibilities)**
-------------------------------------

* **Strategic Portfolio Management**: Own the end\-to\-end lifecycle for your customers, moving beyond reactive support to become a proactive partner in their success.
* **Risk Mitigation \& Retention:** Use data\-driven insights to identify "at\-risk" accounts early. You will develop and execute plans to stabilize usage and secure renewals on time.
* **Commercial Ownership**: Manage the full renewal cycle. You are responsible for maintaining high Net Revenue Retention (NRR) and identifying expansion opportunities where our solutions meet evolving customer needs.
* **Adoption Mastery**: Conduct regular executive business reviews (EBRs) to align OpenGov’s value proposition with the customer’s changing legislative or budgetary goals.
* **Internal Advocacy**: Act as the "Voice of the Customer" for our Product and Engineering teams, ensuring the frontline reality of government work shapes our roadmap.
* **Process Excellence:** Contribute to the "playbook." As a CSM II, you’ll help refine our workflows for churn prevention and onboarding efficiency.

**What You Bring (Requirements)**
---------------------------------

* **Proven SaaS Experience:** Minimum 1\.5\+ years of experience in Customer Success or Account Management within the SaaS industry. You understand what it means to carry a quota or a retention target.
* **Passion for CS**: Demonstrated experience in Customer Success or equivalent research completed; strong desire to build a sustainable career in Customer Success
* **High\-Volume Proficiency:** You have experience managing a large book of business (50\+ accounts) and have mastered the "art of the scale"—knowing when to automate and when to pick up the phone.
* **Commercial Acumen**: You are comfortable discussing budgets, navigating renewal contracts, and handling objections.
* **Resilience \& Grit:** You enjoy the challenge of turning a frustrated customer into a brand advocate. You are comfortable in the "gray areas" of problem\-solving.
* **GovTech Passion (Preferred):** Experience working with (or selling to) local/state government is a significant plus.
* **Analytical Skills:** Ability to look at a health score or usage dashboard and translate that data into an actionable outreach strategy.

**Compensation:**

Atlanta, GA: $80,000 \- $90,000


On target ranges above include base plus a portion of variable compensation that is earned based on company and individual performance.


The final compensation will be determined by a number of factors such as qualifications, expertise, and the candidate’s geographical location.

**Why OpenGov?**
================

**A Mission That Matters.**

At OpenGov, public service is personal. We are passionate about our mission to power more effective and accountable government. Government that operates efficiently, adapts to change, and strengthens public trust. Some people say this is boring. We think it’s the core of our democracy.

**Opportunity to Innovate**


The next great wave of innovation is unfolding with AI, and it will impact everything—from the way we work to the way governments interact with their residents. Join a trusted team with the passion, technology, and expertise to drive innovation and bring AI to local government. We’ve touched 2,000 communities so far, and we’re just getting started.

**A Team of Passionate, Driven People**


This isn’t your typical 9\-to\-5 job; we operate in a fast\-paced, results\-driven environment where impact matters more than simply clocking in and out. Our global team of 800\+ employees is united in our commitment to challenge the status quo. OpenGov is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dubuque, Dallas, and Pune.

**A Place to Make Your Mark**


We pride ourselves on our performance\-based culture, where every employee is encouraged to jump in head\-first and take action to help us improve. If you have a great idea, we want to hear it. Excellent performance is recognized and rewarded, and we love to promote from within.

**Benefits That Work for You**


Enjoy an award\-winning workplace with the benefits to match, including:

* Comprehensive healthcare options for individuals and families
* Flexible vacation policy and paid company holidays
* 401(k) with company match
* Paid parental leave, wellness stipends, and HSA contributions
* Professional development and growth opportunities
* A collaborative office environment with weekly catered lunches.


Compensation Range: $80K \- $100K

jobs.description:
Are you ready?


As an Outside Sales Representative, you will be selling our products and services in a specialized market. You will develop new prospects and maintain contact with established customers, regularly visiting them at their site of business or other off\-site locations.

**In this role you will:**

* Responsible for meeting or exceeding assigned annual gross margin budget by promoting and selling products in assigned territory in compliance with the Company's pricing policies
* Handle customer complaints promptly and effectively, and report potential claims
* Keep management informed of local competition and market conditions
* Carry out sales and merchandise programs as directed, and recommend new items for stock
* Maintain current customer records, files, and reports of business transactions; assist in collection of past due accounts
* Participate in training sessions, trade shows, and sales meetings as requested.
* Demonstrate products after sale when necessary

**What you bring to the table:**

* Minimum 3 years industry\-specific experience required; 4\+ years experience preferred
* 4 year degree preferred
* Knowledge of business administration, sales, and marketing
* Negotiation skills
* Ability to learn our business and to work independently to achieve goals
* Ability to sell and be persuasive
* Extensive travel required, including some overnight travel.

**Shift and Hours:** Monday \- Friday, 8:00am \- 5:00pm

**Compensation Details:** The expected rate of pay for this position is $60,000 \- $75,000 annually. This position is also incentive eligible, based on specific and relevant business metrics.

  

This role requires the use of your personal vehicle for business purposes. Graybar offers a Fixed and Variable Rate (FAVR) reimbursement program to support eligible drivers. This program allows you to choose and drive your own vehicle, rather than a company\-assigned car, and your reimbursements can help you build equity in your vehicle over time. Please note that certain vehicle requirements, such as age and original MSRP, may impact your eligibility for tax\-free reimbursement. More information about Graybar's FAVR reimbursement program will be shared upon hire.


The Value of Graybar:


At Graybar, we are known for our comprehensive benefits and our employee stock ownership plan! Most regular, full\-time employees at Graybar may be eligible for a variety of benefits like:

* Multiple plan options for **Medical, Dental, Vision,** and **Prescription Drug** benefits.
* **Life Insurance** coverage for you and options for your family.
* Save on expenses with **Flexible Spending Accounts**.
* Enjoy our **Disability Benefits** at no cost to you.

* **401(k) Savings Plan** with company match to help secure your future.
* **Paid Vacation** \& **Sick Days** to spend time away from work or in case of an illness.

* Volunteer with **Community Time Off** to give back to the community.

* Reach your career goals with our **Educational Reimbursement** and **Career Development Programs**.
* And **More Perks** that support your well\-being and career growth.

  

Benefit eligibility may vary across locations and roles, so be sure to check in with your recruiter for more information.

At Graybar, our employees are the heart and soul of our company. We believe that employees with diverse perspectives bring the ideas and innovative thinking we need to solve our biggest challenges and compete in an ever\-changing world. Consistent with our values, we welcome people from all backgrounds, cultures and experiences into our company because we believe it’s the right thing to do and the right way to run our business.  

  

We want each of our employees to know that they matter and to feel a sense of belonging, ownership and inclusion at Graybar. We believe that everyone should be treated with dignity and respect, and we work to build a collaborative environment where our employees have the opportunity to grow, learn and make a difference, both as individuals and as part of the team.

  


That’s what our employee ownership culture is all about: working as one team and moving forward together, while honoring the unique value each person brings to our company.**Apply now and find out what’s next for you.**

Key Responsibilities Include:  


Generating volume and market share growth for assigned pharmaceutical products within a specific geographic area.  
Selling presentations to physicians and other health care professionals, primarily in an office\-based setting.  
Developing an understanding of the issues and opportunities unique to the geography, particularly in managed health care.  
Manage allocated resources (samples, promotional and educational materials) to maximize return within regulatory and ethical guidelines.  
Maintains accountability for all pharmaceutical samples in accordance with FDA and PDMA guidelines.  
Utilize the sales automation system to document call and program activity.  
Complete initial and ongoing product and development training as required.  


Requirements:  


BA/BS required

1\-2 years of Pharmaceutical Sales experience with demonstrated record of impact preferred  
Established relationships within targeted geography.

Sales ability/persuasiveness, use of appropriate interpersonal style and communication methods to facilitate an acceptance of an idea, plan, activity or product from targeted customers.  
Establishes account plans based on customer needs and business priorities.  
Establishes method for monitoring progress to goals.  
Must set high goals or standards of performance, self\-starter, able to work independently.  
Must demonstrate ability to influence events to achieve goals and take actions beyond what is required in being proactive.  
Must be able to utilize resources and create a positive/professional impression, commanding attention and respect, displaying confidence.  
Ability to maintain effectiveness in varying environments and with different tasks, responsibilities and people is key.  
Must express ideas effectively in individual and group situations, adjusting to the characteristics or needs of the target audience  


Whether you're educating prescribers, supporting patients, or engaging with physicians, you'll help demonstrate product value and contribute to real\-world medical breakthroughs. Explore your potential and help shape a healthier future with IQVIA.  


\#LI\-CES  


IQVIA is a leading global provider of clinical research services, commercial insights and healthcare intelligence to the life sciences and healthcare industries. We create intelligent connections to accelerate the development and commercialization of innovative medical treatments to help improve patient outcomes and population health worldwide. Learn more at https://jobs.iqvia.com  


IQVIA is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other status protected by applicable law. https://jobs.iqvia.com/eoe

All information and credentials submitted in your application must be truthful and complete. Any false statements, misrepresentations, or material omissions during the recruitment process will result in immediate disqualification of your application, or termination of employment if discovered later, in accordance with applicable law. We appreciate your honesty and professionalism.

The actual base pay offered may vary based on a number of factors including job\-related qualifications such as knowledge, skills, education, and experience; location; and/or schedule (full or part\-time). Where you'll work  
Field\-based  


You’ll work where the action is — out in the field, directly engaging with our customers, sites or partners. Field\-based roles offer the opportunity to build relationships face\-to\-face, gain real\-world insights and make a tangible impact.

That’s what makes this a place where people tend to stay, grow and do the best work of their careers.

jobs.title: Entry Level Sales Representative
jobs.description:
**Overview**  
Are you ready to launch your career in sales and make a real impact? We’re seeking energetic and motivated Entry Level Sales Representatives to join our dynamic team! In this role, you will be the driving force behind building strong customer relationships, promoting innovative products, and expanding our market reach. This is an exciting opportunity to develop essential sales skills, gain hands\-on experience sales, and grow within a fast\-paced environment that values your enthusiasm and initiative. If you’re passionate about communication, technology, and helping customers find solutions that fit their needs, this role is perfect for you!

**Duties**

* Engage with potential clients through warm strategies to generate new business opportunities.
* Develop and nurture relationships with prospects via face\-to\-face and CRM (Customer Relationship Management) software to support business development efforts.
* Assist in negotiating deals by understanding customer needs and presenting tailored solutions confidently.
* Collaborate with marketing teams to execute outreach campaigns that increase brand awareness and drive sales growth.
* Maintain accurate records of customer interactions and sales activities using CRM tools such as Salesforce or similar platforms.
* Support sales initiatives by qualifying leads, following up on inquiries, and closing sales opportunities efficiently.

**Requirements**

* Strong communication skills in English, with the ability to clearly articulate product benefits and negotiate effectively.
* Prior experience or familiarity with sales, telemarketing, or inside sales is a plus but not required—training will be provided!
* Knowledge of CRM software like Salesforce or other CRM tools is advantageous.
* Demonstrated ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast\-paced environment.
* Customer service mindset with a proactive approach to problem\-solving and relationship building.
* Basic understanding of technology products or technical sales concepts is preferred but not mandatory.
* Willingness to learn new skills related to marketing, business development, and outbound calling strategies. Join us as an Entry Level Sales Representative and kick\-start your career in a vibrant environment that encourages growth, innovation, and success! We’re committed to supporting your professional development every step of the way while providing valuable paid experience that prepares you for future leadership roles.

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance

* Paid training

* Vision insurance

jobs.description:
**Account Manager – Garrett Schafer State Farm Agency**

Cumming, GA (Forsyth County)  
Base Salary \+ Uncapped Commission \+ Bonuses

**Are You a Sales Hunter Who Wants Freedom, Opportunity, and Unlimited Upside?**

We're not looking for someone who wants to maintain accounts, follow a script, or spend their day waiting for direction.

We're looking for a confident, competitive, self\-driven sales professional who wants to WIN, earn exceptional income, and build a career with significant growth potential.

If you thrive in a fast\-paced environment, enjoy solving problems, love competition, and want the freedom to pursue your goals without being micromanaged, keep reading.

This is an opportunity for someone who:

* Bets on themselves
* Wants control over their income and future
* Learns quickly and adapts fast
* Enjoys solving problems and making decisions
* Is energized by people, competition, and closing deals
* Wants freedom, accountability, and opportunity
* Is interested in developing leadership and business skills
* Wants to build a career, not simply work a job

We provide coaching, mentorship, proven systems, and support. What we don't provide is constant hand\-holding.

Our top performers are self\-starters who see opportunity where others see obstacles. They take action while others are still thinking about it.

Many of our most successful team members have backgrounds in athletics, military service, entrepreneurship, commission\-based sales, or other highly competitive environments where performance matters.

**What You'll Do**

As an Account Manager with Garrett Schafer State Farm Agency, you'll help individuals, families, and business owners protect what matters most while building strong relationships throughout one of Georgia's fastest\-growing communities.

Responsibilities include:

* Generating new business through prospecting, networking, referrals, and follow\-up
* Identifying customer needs and recommending insurance and financial services solutions
* Developing leads, scheduling appointments, and closing sales
* Building long\-term client relationships that generate repeat business and referrals
* Working alongside experienced mentors while developing your own sales approach
* Helping clients with auto, home, life, business, and financial services products

This is not a "sit and wait" sales role.

You will have the freedom to pursue opportunities, build relationships, generate business, and create your own success. With that freedom comes ownership, accountability, and substantial earning potential.

**Who Thrives Here**

The right person is:

* Competitive and results\-driven
* Self\-confident and decisive
* Coachable and growth\-minded
* Friendly, outgoing, and relationship\-oriented
* Comfortable taking initiative without waiting for permission
* Motivated by achievement, advancement, and income potential
* Energized by variety, challenge, and new opportunities

This role is probably not a fit if you prefer highly structured environments where every step is prescribed, require constant direction before taking action, or are uncomfortable being measured by performance and results.

This role is an excellent fit if you enjoy taking ownership, embracing challenges, creating opportunities, and being rewarded for your effort and performance.

**Compensation \& Benefits**

**Compensation**

* Base Salary \+ Uncapped Commission
* Performance Bonuses
* Realistic First\-Year Earnings: $60,000 \- $80,000\+
* Significant upside potential for top performers

**Benefits**

* 401(k) Matching
* Health Insurance
* Dental Insurance
* Vision Insurance
* Paid Time Off
* Training \& Development
* Advancement Opportunities
* Supportive Team Environment

**Why Join Our Team?**

At Garrett Schafer State Farm Agency, we're committed to helping people protect what they've worked hard to build while creating opportunities for our team members to grow personally, professionally, and financially.

We believe in:

* Working hard
* Competing at a high level
* Taking ownership
* Serving clients exceptionally well
* Continuous improvement
* Having fun while winning

If you're looking for a career where your effort, initiative, and performance directly impact your income, freedom, growth, and future opportunities, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today and show us what you're capable of.

*This position is with an independent State Farm Agent, not State Farm Insurance Companies. Employees of State Farm agents must complete applicable licensing and training requirements. State Farm agents are independent contractors who hire their own employees.*

jobs.title: Pro Sales Representative - Atlanta
jobs.description:
Position Purpose:  


The Pro Sales Representative works to build strong relationships with our Pro customers and executes a sales strategy to profitably grow sales for assigned accounts to support the organization's goals and increases the company's market share. This role is responsible for managing the full sales cycle of a designated portfolio, both existing and new, by identifying sales opportunities, managing a sales pipeline, and achieving assigned sales goals and gross margin targets. The Pro Sales Representative drives sales growth by proactively prospecting and engaging both new and existing B2B customers through high outbound activity, including cold calls, outreach initiatives. The Pro Sales Representative is also responsible for negotiating projects, developing tailored solutions to meet customer needs, closing sales, and resolving issues effectively and in a timely manner. The Pro Sales Representative must demonstrate broad product and services knowledge and utilize comprehensive business acumen and a knowledge of other functional departments to support the growth of their portfolio and effectively collaborate with cross\-functional partners.  


Key Responsibilities:  


10% \- Customer Review and Development \- Engage with sales leadership to review sales calls, provide account insights and sales plan opportunities with manager. Participate in training sessions focused on product knowledge (including, but not limited to, building supplies, construction jobs, etc.), process improvements, and strategic initiatives.  
30% \- Inbound Customer Engagement and Sales Growth \- Resolve order and delivery issues with a professional support team. Resolve customer challenges by investigating problems and developing sustainable and scalable solutions in collaboration with the in\-store Pro Sales teams and Pro Support team. Transact and tender, when necessary, with a professional support team. Follow\-up on completed orders for feedback.  
60% \- Outbound Customer Engagement and Sales Growth \- Research accounts, identify key players and generate interest. Achieve prospecting and sales goals effectively and consistently by proactively adjusting to market changes, closing sales and achieving sales plan. Source new sales opportunities through ongoing prospecting via inbound lead follow\-up and outbound warm/hot and cold calling. Drive incremental sales growth with assigned customer portfolio. Execute sales strategy by introducing both new and existing customers to our current capabilities, ensuring they understand how these solutions align with their specific needs. Strategically build and maintain strong customer relationships to foster long\-term partnerships by understanding and anticipating customer needs, offering custom solutions while effectively communicating competitive strengths. Effectively communicate competitive strengths and develop strategic goals to acquire incremental business.  


Direct Manager/Direct Reports:  


This Position typically reports to the Pro Sales Representative Manager  
This Position has 0 Direct Reports  


Travel Requirements:  


Typically requires overnight travel less than 5% of the time.  


Physical Requirements:  


Most of the time is spent sitting in a comfortable position and there is frequent opportunity to move about. On rare occasions, there may be a need to move or lift light articles.  


Working Conditions:  


Located in a comfortable indoor area. Any unpleasant conditions would be infrequent and not objectionable.  


Minimum Qualifications:  


Must be 18 years of age or older  
Must be legally permitted to work in the United States  


Preferred Qualifications:  


Working knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite  
Working knowledge of presentation software (e.g., Microsoft PowerPoint)  
Demonstrated ability to collaborate and work effectively with cross\-functional teams  
Demonstrated project management skills  
Ability to negotiate, handle complaints, settle disputes, and resolve grievances with both internal and external customers  
Excellent written and verbal communication skills  
Retail, proven inside sales or telephone sales experience  
Experience working with Salesforce.com or similar CRM  
Understanding and application of strategic planning to identify, target and execute plans for sales growth  
Highly motivated  
Understanding and application of strategic planning to identify, target and execute plans for sales growth in areas like building supplies, construction, and lumber

The knowledge, skills and abilities typically acquired through the completion of a high school diploma and/or GED.

The knowledge, skills and abilities typically acquired through the completion of a bachelor's degree program or equivalent degree in a field of study related to the job

2

3

Certifications:

jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Who You Are**



You are a highly organized, detail\-oriented project professional who enjoys bringing structure, clarity, and follow\-through to complex work. You are comfortable coordinating multiple priorities, maintaining accurate project information, communicating with a variety of stakeholders, and identifying issues before they become larger problems. You take ownership of your commitments, learn quickly, and bring a collaborative, client\-focused mindset to every interaction.


**About The Role**



As a Project Coordinator within the Project Management Office (PMO), you will support Project Managers and Program Managers in the planning, coordination, tracking, and successful delivery of client\-facing technology projects. You will help maintain accurate project schedules, documentation, action items, risks, dependencies, financial information, and status reporting so project teams and stakeholders have timely visibility into progress and emerging concerns. This role is well suited for someone who can balance detail\-oriented administrative execution with proactive communication, sound judgment, and a desire to grow within project management.


**Must be based in the United States of America.** The role may support multiple projects, clients, and internal teams simultaneously and may occasionally coordinate with stakeholders across different time zones.


**Other responsibilities include:**


* Support Project Managers and Program Managers with project planning, coordination, tracking, and follow\-through from initiation through closeout.
* Maintain accurate project schedules, milestones, deliverables, action items, decision logs, risk registers, dependency trackers, and other project controls.
* Coordinate project meetings, prepare agendas and materials, capture notes and decisions, distribute follow\-up actions, and monitor completion.
* Prepare recurring project status updates, dashboards, and health reports using current and validated project information.

* Proactively identify missing information, schedule conflicts, unresolved decisions, and delivery risks; research issues and coordinate resolution with the appropriate owners.
* Support project closeout by confirming deliverables, documentation, financial information, lessons learned, and handoff requirements are complete.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of PMO templates, reporting standards, workflows, and project coordination practices.

* Two to four years of experience in project coordination, project administration, operations support, or a related field; equivalent professional experience will be considered.
* Experience supporting multiple projects, workstreams, customers, or stakeholders while managing competing priorities and deadlines.
* Working knowledge of project management fundamentals, including schedules, milestones, deliverables, dependencies, risks, issues, and status reporting.

* Ability to identify gaps, ask effective questions, investigate unresolved items, and escalate concerns with appropriate context and urgency.

* Self\-motivated and dependable, with the ability to work independently in a fully remote environment while staying connected to the broader team.
* A proactive, preventive mindset and eagerness to learn, grow, and take on increasing responsibility within project management.

Safe Spaces Program Coordinator (Temporary Position September 2026\-December 2026\)


ReportsTo: Director of Mental Health and Youth Programs


MISSION:


Gads Hill Center, a social service organization established in 1898, creates opportunities for children and their families to build a better life through education, access to resources, and community engagement.


At Gads Hill Center we envision a community in which all children and youth benefit from healthy, financially stable households that support their learning and growth. We invest in the potential of children, youth, and families through early childhood education, positive youth development, mental health and family support. Ultimately, Gads Hill Center supports building a community where all families can help their children have access to quality education in order to succeed in school and life.


JOB SUMMARY:


The Program Coordinator is responsible for the planning, implementation, and oversight of the My Chi. My Future. Safe Spaces program at Gads Hill Center, serving youth in the North Lawndale community. This role leads youth workforce development activities and oversees the planning and execution of youth\-driven community events that provide safe, engaging spaces for teens and young adults. The Program Coordinator ensures that programming is culturally responsive and community\-informed, centering youth voice, leadership, and positive youth development while addressing the unique strengths and needs of youth in North Lawndale.

**Operations Coordinator**

**Job Summary**

Do Right Services Co. is a growing, Chicago\-based service company providing a range

of essential services to commercial, municipal, and community clients throughout the

Chicagoland area. Our services include commercial cleaning, landscaping, snow

removal, pest control, customer service, and other client\-focused operational

services.

Do Right is committed to delivering high\-quality service while creating meaningful

employment opportunities and supporting the growth and stability of our employees.

We are looking for an Operations Coordinator who is highly organized, dependable,

proactive, and energized by helping people and teams work more effectively. This

role serves as an important connection point between field operations, client

accounts, employees, and the back office, helping ensure that information,

schedules, people, and tasks stay coordinated.

The Operations Coordinator will support the day\-to\-day execution of the business by

coordinating schedules, supporting employee onboarding, maintaining and

coordinating day\-to\-day payroll activities, supporting client fulfillment activities, and

helping identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency.

This is a hands\-on role for someone who enjoys solving problems, keeping things

organized, and making sure important details do not fall through the cracks. The ideal

candidate can balance multiple priorities while maintaining strong communication,

accuracy, and follow\-through.

**Core Responsibilities**

**Payroll Operations \& Administration**

* Coordinate the day\-to\-day upkeep of payroll information and processes, working closely with supervisors, employees, Human Resources, and payroll providers to ensure information is accurate, complete, and submitted on schedule.
* Collect, review, and maintain payroll information, including hours worked, employee changes, timekeeping information, and other payroll\-related data.
* Monitor payroll information for errors, discrepancies, missing information, or other issues and coordinate timely resolution.
* Follow up with supervisors and employees regarding missing or inaccurate payroll information.
* Assist with payroll\-related questions and issues and coordinate with the appropriate team members or payroll provider when additional support is needed.
* Maintain accurate payroll records and documentation while protecting confidential employee information.

**Employee Onboarding, Tracking \& Reporting**

* Own accurate tracking of employee onboarding progress from offer acceptance through completion of required onboarding activities.
* Work directly with new employees to collect all required personal, employment, tax, payroll, and other onboarding information and documentation.
* Ensure new employee information is complete, accurate, and properly entered into the company's payroll and other applicable systems.
* Maintain onboarding trackers and monitor completion of required documentation, training, and other onboarding requirements.
* Identify missing or delayed items and proactively follow up with new employees and the appropriate team members.
* Provide regular reporting on onboarding progress and outstanding items.
* Help ensure new employees have the information and resources needed to successfully begin their employment with Do Right.

**Coverage \& Scheduling Support**

* Support daily and weekly staffing schedules to ensure appropriate coverage across assigned operations and service lines.

Physical Demands:
  

  

Competencies:

Responsibilities:
  

Job Responsibilities:
  

1\. Coordinates all aspects of the study including recruitment, consent, screening, scheduling, tracking, and provides study updates to study participants throughout the conduct of the study.
  

2\. May collect and enter data into study case report forms and/or electronic data capture system and respond to queries in a timely manner.
  

3\. Independently submits or partners with a regulatory coordinator to submit study related documents, study protocols, and study protocol amendments to the IRB per policy and procedure, with increasing autonomy over time to prepare for independent regulatory management responsibilities.

13\. Other duties as assigned.

**Company Overview**

Kitchen Fresh Foods is a leading employer in the food production industry, specializing in fresh sandwiches, soups, salads, and desserts for convenience stores and private labels within the vending industry. With a strong distribution network spanning over 16 states, we pride ourselves on delivering high\-quality products from our dedicated facility. Our growing organization offers a comprehensive benefits package to support our team members’ well\-being and professional development.

As Territory Sales Coordinator, you will be tasked by the Territory Manager for the day\-to\-day implementation of sales and distribution operations within the territory. Working closely with your Territory Sales Manager \- DSD you will provide essential route coverage within the territory and have full accountability for the in\-store presence of KFF as a brand and company in your assigned geography. You’ll train, develop, and influence a roster of Route Sales Representatives (RSRs) while, occasionally, interacting with KFF customer support, transportation, maintenance, and safety teams at the direction of the TSM. Success in this role requires an unmatched sense of urgency to match the fast\-paced requirements of Fresh Food Direct Store Delivery operations.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

Key Position essential functions and responsibility: management of the territory sales team and fleet to best maintain servicing the customer to a high level and developing long term collaborative relationships and growth.

* People – Meet regularly with your Territory Sales Manager to aid in retention, and develop the team of RSR’s, provide feedback and ensure team members know what success looks like, communicate gaps, and solve scheduling opportunities.
* Route Coverage\- Provide route coverage across the territory for vacations, call\-ins, and open routes. Route coverage in other territories when needed.
* Equipment – Work with TSM, KFF fleet maintenance and safety teams to ensure KFF fleet equipment in your geographic area is in good working condition. Facilitate truck swaps, repairs, and fleet maintenance upkeep.
* Customers – Provide unmatched customer communication and service and complete customer audits as directed by the TSM.
* Business Development\- Conduct route rides at the direction of the TSM. Work with RSR’s and TSM to maximize profitability within the current customer base in addition to prospecting and selling of new customers.
* Routes – Review route efficiency regularly with Territory Sales Manager to ensure KFF Fresh DSD routes are servicing your geography efficiently and profitably. Make suggestions for route adjustments to accommodate route growth, new customer additions or subtractions.
* Supply – Ensure weekly orders are made in a timely fashion to allow KFF supply chain to execute to perfection. Monitor route waste, inventory levels, and space efficiency as well as communicate any interruptions to your Territory Sales Manager.
* Product \- Review product performance across the territory. Provide suggestions for production on local products you’d like to see offered and ensure new item launches are executed to expectations.
* Quality – Ensure product quality is maintained throughout the supply chain by regularly inspecting temperature monitoring software’s and doing regular shelf audits for product specification adherence. Report inconsistencies back to customer service as required.
* Compliance – Ensure staff adhere to all local and regional laws and regulations as it pertains to interstate commerce. Address non\-conformance as appropriate.

**Minimum Qualifications (Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities)**

* 5\+ years in route, territory or sales experience required.
* Direct Store or direct to consumer distribution experience preferred.
* A strong work ethic with a desire to exceed expectations both internally and externally. Demonstrated self\-motivation and leadership abilities are required.
* Exceptional planning and organizational skills, the ability to set priorities and the ability to effectively schedule time and meet deadlines are required.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Proficient with Microsoft office products, Google Maps, etc.
* Must be willing to travel within territory with the potential for extended overnight stays.

* Paid vacation and PTO

* Opportunity for advancement

jobs.title: Digital Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Chowbus is a leading AI\-powered restaurant technology SaaS platform with deep roots in the North American market. We support thousands of restaurants of every size across the U.S. and Canada, with technology solutions spanning POS, AI, and digital tools that help restaurants run more efficiently and grow their business. We compete with companies like Toast, Square, Clover, and Menusifu. Our Marketing team plays a direct role in that growth.



We are looking for a Digital Marketing Manager to own Chowbus's digital presence end to end: organic search, our website, marketing analytics, and paid search. You'll turn data into decisions and help restaurant owners find Chowbus and book a demo. You'll work closely with fellow Marketing team members, Sales colleagues, and Product specialists to keep our digital funnel consistent from first click to conversion.



This is ahybrid role based in our Chicago office.



**What You'll Focus On**
------------------------


**SEO \& Organic Growth**


* Own Chowbus's SEO roadmap, including keyword strategy, technical SEO audits, site structure, and page speed/Core Web Vitals improvements.
* Run competitive SEO analysis against Toast, Square, Clover, and Menusifu to find content and ranking opportunities.
* Partner with the content team to brief, optimize, and publish SEO\-driven blog posts, landing pages, and city\- or cuisine\-specific pages.
* Monitor rankings, organic traffic, and backlink profile using tools like Google Search Console, SEMrush, or Ahrefs, and report on progress monthly.


**Website \& CMS Management**


* Own day\-to\-day management of Chowbus's website CMS, including page builds, edits, navigation, and content governance.
* Launch and maintain landing pages for campaigns, product launches, and events, working with design and demand generation partners.
* Run A/B tests on key pages (homepage, demo request forms, pricing) to improve conversion rates.
* Maintain site performance, uptime, and technical hygiene, partnering with engineering as needed.


**Marketing Analytics \& Reporting**


* Build and maintain dashboards in GA4, Tableau, or similar tools to track website traffic, campaign performance, and lead\-to\-demo conversion.
* Define and track the digital marketing funnel from first touch to booked demo, in partnership with Sales and RevOps.
* Deliver monthly and quarterly performance reports with clear takeaways and recommendations for marketing leadership.
* Work with RevOps and Sales to keep lead data clean and consistent across the website, CRM, and marketing automation platform.

  

  

**Paid Search (Google Ads / PPC)**


* Plan, launch, and manage Google Ads campaigns (Search, Display, Performance Max) to drive qualified demo requests.
* Own the paid search budget, bidding strategy, and keyword lists. Optimize continuously for cost per lead and ROAS.
* Write and test ad copy, landing pages, and offers to improve click\-through and conversion rates.
* Partner with the Marketing Campaigns Manager so paid search complements paid social and ABM efforts.

**What You Bring**
------------------


* 6\+ years of experience in digital marketing, with hands\-on ownership of SEO, website/CMS, analytics, and paid search (Google Ads).
* Proven experience improving organic search rankings and traffic using tools like Google Search Console, SEMrush, or Ahrefs.
* Hands\-on experience managing a CMS (WordPress, Webflow, or similar), including landing page builds and site edits.
* Strong experience with Google Analytics (GA4\) and building reporting dashboards (Looker or similar).
* Experience managing a paid search budget and reporting on ROAS and cost per lead.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.


**Preferred Qualifications**


* Experience in restaurant technology, POS, payments, fintech, or another B2B SaaS company.
* Experience at a high\-growth startup or scale\-up.
* Familiarity with HubSpot, Salesforce, or a similar CRM/marketing automation platform.
* Basic HTML/CSS knowledge for CMS edits.
* Preferred: Professional or fluent proficiency in Mandarin Chinese. Most of our team and many of our restaurant partners communicate in Mandarin, so this skill helps you collaborate effectively and understand our customers.

**What We Offer**
-----------------


* Competitive compensation package
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* 401(k)
* 100% employer\-paid Short\-Term Disability (STD)
* 100% employer\-paid Life Insurance
* 100% employer\-paid AD\&D Insurance
* Company holidays
* Birthday off
* Paid Parental Leave
* Flexible Paid Time Off (PTO)
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)


**The salary for this role is $80,000–$130,000, depending on experience. This role may also be eligible for a performance bonus.**

#### **POSITION SUMMARY**


The Client Services Manager (CSM) is responsible for providing the highest quality services to assigned accounts that meet in Chicago; to disseminate service materials to such organizations in a timely fashion; to provide show management with promotional support in the form of destination marketing resources, attendance building, and city recognition.


Works in partnership with the Sales Department to service confirmed business in Chicago by acting as a liaison between show management, Choose Chicago members and city departments. The CSM is the main representative of all that is Chicago to our convention clients.

#### 

#### **ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**




* Maintain continual communication with clients through direct contact, phone calls, e\-mail, letters and personal visits and create customer/partner relationship.
* Must be a team player with a great understanding of the importance of *exceptional customer service*.
* Contribute to the development of Choose Chicagos goals by assessing each account, customizing programs and working with the appropriate budget to complement the clients needs; develop and present the proposal to the client.
* Forecast expenditures and work within \+/\- 5% of the designated client budget.
* Maintain concise account profiles in Simpleview, and complete and organized paper and electronic files in an accurate and a timely fashion.
* Manage timeline for services with assigned accounts in order to provide the highest possible level of customer service.

* Coordinate and confirm site inspections through the development of itineraries, including assignment of housing and transportation arrangements. Accompany clients on visits.
* Facilitate all city and state requests including welcome letters for the Mayor and Governor, banner requests and airport signage.
* Develop new programs, or recommendations for updating existing programs to enhance and increase the usage of the department's services.
* Support partnership base through referrals and attendance of meetings and special events.
* Develop, promote, and execute Chicagos Were Glad Youre Here!® program recognition and retention services through individual account needs assessment.
* Promote Choose Chicagos preferred housing vendor to all clients.
* Travel to promote the city for future Chicago shows for qualifying/applicable accounts.
* Travel to appropriate and necessary client appointments as needed.
* Comply with established policies and guidelines applying to the Choose Chicago operations and employee conduct.

* Perform a variety of administrative tasks.
* Perform other duties as assigned by the Vice President, Client Services and Directors of Client Services.
#### **MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelors degree preferred or equivalent practical experience.
* CMP designation preferred (strong preference given to CMP holders).
* Two (2\) to four (4\) years of related project management experience showing progressive growth and learning and/or training equal to the skill level needed to perform this position.
* Occasional travel required.
* Prior experience in the hospitality, convention bureau or sales industry required.
* Understanding of marketing and promotional efforts/concepts.
* Prior management experience helpful.
* Position requires significant amount of independent judgment.

###### **KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES**

* Understanding of Chicagos attractions, hotels and special event venues.
* Ability to effectively use MS Office products including but not limited to Word, Excel, Outlook, Power Point, etc.
* Possess excellent written and verbal communication skills; exceptional spelling, punctuation and grammar skills.
* Ability to represent Choose Chicago in a professional manner while interfacing with internal and external clients.
* Possess excellent logic, organizational and time management skills.
* Ability to manage and work simultaneously on multiple projects and with multiple clients.




##### **PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS AND ENVIRONMENTAL CONDITIONS**

* Ability to perform work utilizing a computer for extended periods of time.
* Ability to sit for extended periods of time in performing the work.
* Ability to grasp objects utilizing the fingers (fine motor manipulation).

* Ability to travel by air or ground transportation (includes personal and public transportation) as required in performing the work.
* Ability to travel throughout the city, including prolonged standing and walking as it is very often necessary when conducting a site inspection.
* Ability to work nights and weekends as needed. Working evenings includes, but is not limited to attending business exchanges, venue openings/receptions/client dinners, etc.

jobs.title: In-Home Sales Representative - Chicago- Stiltz Homelifts
jobs.description:
Are you a highly motivated, determined professional who takes ownership of their performance and thrives in a goal\-driven environment? If you’re energized by making a real difference in people’s lives and have a customer\-first mindset in all decisions, this role offers both purpose and performance.


As the In\-Home Sales Representative for Stiltz Homelifts in our Chicago location, you will be responsible for conducting in\-home consultations with potential customers, assessing their needs, and recommending the most suitable lift solutions and locations to meet their requirements. This role requires excellent communication skills, a customer\-centric approach, and a passion for improving the lives of homeowners through innovative home lift solutions.

**What You’ll Do**

* Conduct in\-home consultations with potential customers to assess their accessibility needs and discuss the benefits of Stiltz Homelifts products.
* Present product demonstrations and educate customers on the features, benefits and installation process of our lift solutions.
* Provide personalized recommendations for location of product and quotations.
* Maintain accurate records of sales activities, including customer interactions, quotations, and sales orders in the CRM system.
* Provide exceptional customer service and support throughout the sales process and beyond.
* Address customer questions, concerns, and objections in a professional and knowledgeable manner.
* Collaborate with internal teams, including sales support and installation technicians and Stiltz headquarters, to ensure seamless customer experience.
* Provide accurate measurements of customer approved installation site.
* Follow up with customers to answer any additional questions, finalize details and schedule installations.
* Stay informed about industry trends, competitor activities and market developments to identify new sales opportunities.
* Follow up with leads and maintain regular communication to nurture potential sales.
* Close sales and manage the necessary documentation, including contracts and payment processing.
**What We’re Looking For**

* Proven track record of success in in\-home sales or a related field, preferably in the home improvement or accessibility industry.
* Strong communication, interpersonal and presentation skills.
* Ability to build rapport, establish trust, understand and address customers’ needs effectively.
* General Construction knowledge.
* Experience using CRM software and other sales tools.
* Understanding of local and state coding and permitting laws for construction and elevators.
* Willingness to travel to customer locations, Stiltz, Inc.’s corporate office for continued training, and on\-site training with seasoned sales representatives.
* Valid driver's license and clean driving record.
* Ability to work flexible hours, including evenings and weekends, to accommodate customer schedules.
**Why You’ll Love Working Here:**

* Comprehensive Benefits Package: Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance.
* Time Off: 20 Days Paid Time Off AND 8 Paid Company Holidays
* Retirement Plan: 401(k) with a company match that is immediately vested.
* Collaborative Environment: Work with a team that values cooperation, efficiency, and success.
**Job Details:**

**Location** \- Chicago, Il.

**Type** \- Full\-time

**Salaried Position** \- $60,000 Annually, Plus Commission and Bonus

**Why Work for Stiltz Homelifts**


At Stiltz Homelifts, we’re not just selling homelifts— we’re empowering individuals to age in place, providing life\-changing solutions that allow people to remain independent in their homes. Our products change lives by restoring access to the full home and providing peace of mind to families across the country.


Stiltz offers meaningful career opportunities for driven, result\-oriented professionals who want to make an impact while building a long\-term career. With an established national partner network and expanding direct\-to\-consumer locations across the U.S., growth is a constant.

jobs.description:
CoreBuilt Contracting is a growing commercial general contractor based in Chicago, IL. We specialize in delivering fast\-paced, high\-quality commercial construction projects with a focus on field execution, coordination, and accountability.
  
  

Position Overview
  
  

The Construction Project Manager leads the day\-to\-day execution of commercial construction projects, working closely with Superintendents, subcontractors, vendors, clients, and internal teams to keep work progressing safely, on schedule, and within budget.
  
  

This mid\-level role is responsible for coordinating project activities from preconstruction through closeout, including managing project documentation, tracking schedules and procurement, monitoring costs, resolving issues, and maintaining clear communication between the office and field. The Assistant Project Manager serves as a key point of contact for project stakeholders and helps ensure that subcontractors and vendors meet contractual, quality, and timeline expectations.
  
  

The ideal candidate has a strong understanding of commercial construction workflows, excellent organizational and communication skills, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment. They take ownership of project details, anticipate potential challenges, and work proactively to keep all aspects of the project aligned.
  
  

What You’ll Be Doing
  
  

Project Management \& Coordination
  
  

* Lead day\-to\-day coordination of commercial construction projects in partnership with Project Managers, Superintendents, subcontractors, vendors, and clients.
* Monitor project milestones, deliverables, field progress, and critical\-path activities to help keep work on schedule and aligned with project objectives.
* Coordinate subcontractor activities, vendor communication, material deliveries, site access, and logistics requirements.
* Identify and help resolve scheduling conflicts, scope gaps, site constraints, and other issues that could affect project performance.
* Serve as a central communication link between office and field teams, ensuring timely distribution of project updates, decisions, and action items.


Documentation \& Project Controls
  
  

* Maintain complete, accurate project records, including contracts, drawings, specifications, submittals, RFIs, change orders, meeting minutes, correspondence, and closeout documents.
* Manage the RFI and submittal process by tracking due dates, coordinating reviews, documenting responses, and following up with responsible parties.
* Prepare, review, and distribute change order documentation, project correspondence, and status reports.
* Track project budgets, subcontractor commitments, change exposure, job\-cost updates, and projected costs in coordination with the Project Manager.
* Review subcontractor pay applications, vendor invoices, and supporting documentation for accuracy, contract compliance, and appropriate approvals.
* Support project closeout by coordinating punch\-list tracking, warranties, as\-built documentation, final inspections, and turnover requirements.


Scheduling, Procurement \& Field Support
  
  

* Maintain project schedules and short\-term look\-ahead plans with input from field leadership and trade partners.
* Lead or coordinate project meetings, site walks, progress meetings, inspections, and pre\-installation discussions; issue agendas, meeting minutes, and follow\-up items.
* Monitor procurement status, long\-lead materials, purchase orders, equipment needs, and delivery schedules to prevent disruptions to field operations.
* Confirm site readiness, storage requirements, access, and installation sequencing before scheduled material or equipment deliveries.
* Follow up with subcontractors and vendors to ensure timely responses, compliance with project requirements, and adherence to schedule commitments.


Preconstruction \& Startup
  
  

* Support preconstruction planning through bid solicitation, subcontractor outreach, bid leveling, scope review, proposal tracking, and trade partner selection.
* Organize and review bid documents, drawings, specifications, addenda, subcontractor pricing, and scope comparisons in support of estimating efforts.
* Coordinate permitting applications, project startup documentation, insurance and compliance requirements, and preconstruction meeting logistics.
* Assist with development of project execution plans, procurement schedules, preliminary logistics plans, and subcontractor onboarding materials.


Operational \& Executive Support
  
  

* Maintain organized project and company records while supporting standardized processes across active jobs.
* Coordinate invoice processing, vendor documentation, compliance records, and general administrative requirements related to project operations.
* Manage calendars, meetings, travel arrangements, reports, agendas, and action\-item tracking for project and executive leadership as needed.
* Support special projects, internal research, process improvements, and company initiatives that strengthen project delivery and operational efficiency.


Qualifications
  
  

* 3–5\+ years of experience in commercial construction, project management, project engineering, estimating, or a related field.
* Working knowledge of commercial construction processes, including preconstruction, procurement, scheduling, subcontractor coordination, project controls, and closeout.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple active projects, competing deadlines, and detailed deliverables in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to coordinate effectively with clients, design teams, subcontractors, vendors, field personnel, and internal leadership.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word, Outlook, and project reporting tools.
* Experience using construction management software such as Procore, Bluebeam, Autodesk Build, Primavera P6, Microsoft Project, or

**Job Description**

**Join Cedars\-Sinai and become part of a team that is at the forefront of medical advancements!**

The MAST program at Cedars\-Sinai Medical Center is dedicated to the development of novel drugs and devices to diagnose and treat patients. This innovative program is working to develop new diagnostics and therapeutics to treat patients with illnesses related to imbalances or alterations in the Microbiome. To learn more, please visit: https://www.cedars\-sinai.org/research/areas/science\-tech.html.


**About the Role**


The Clinical Research Coordinator II works independently providing study coordination including screening of potential patients for protocol eligibility, presenting non\-medical trial concepts and details, and participating in the informed consent process. Responsible for accurate and timely source documents, data collection, documentation, entry, and reporting including timely response to sponsor queries. Responsible for compiling and reporting on each study including information related to protocol activity, accrual data, workload, and other research information. Presents information at regular research staff meetings. May plan and coordinate strategies for increasing patient enrollment, improving efficiency, training of personnel, or identifying new research opportunities. Ensures compliance with all federal and local agencies including the Food and Drug Administration (FDA) and local Institutional Review Board (IRB).

* Schedules and participates in monitoring and auditing activities.
* Notifies direct supervisor about concerns regarding data quality and study conduct.

The Merchant Coordinator provides essential support to the buying team by handling administrative tasks, ensuring efficient communication across departments, and assisting with product data management and inventory.


**A day in the life, what you’ll be doing:**


* Manage schedules, prepare reports, and organize meetings for the buying team
* Assist in coordinating team activities and product sample handling
* Input product data into inventory systems, ensuring accuracy in descriptions, pricing, and stock levels
* Help manage the flow of product data between the buying team and other departments
* Assist with routine communications to suppliers, such as confirming order details, scheduling shipments, and tracking deliveries
* Help monitor stock levels and assist in inventory audits
* Ensure product data is up to date in internal systems
* Perform basic market research and compile information on competitor offerings and product trends, providing initial insights to the team
* Work closely with other departments such as marketing logistics, and finance to ensure smooth operations within the buying process
* Act as a liaison between the buying team and other stakeholders
* Provide support in managing product orders and replenishment, ensuring that inventory levels are adequate for sales forecasts

  


**What it takes to Join:**

* Entry\-level position, typically suited for individuals with minimal experience in retail or merchandising. 0 \- 2 years’ experience preferred
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills
* Strong attention to detail
* Ability to communicate effectively
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and familiarity with inventory management systems preferred

Headquartered in Southern California, Skechers—the Comfort Technology Company®—has spent over 30 years helping men, women, and kids everywhere look and feel good. Comfort innovation is at the core of everything we do, driving the development of stylish, high\-quality products at a great value. From our diverse footwear collections to our expanding range of apparel and accessories, Skechers is a complete lifestyle brand.  

  

ABOUT THE ROLE:  

The key account manager handles Skechers most important clients. The Key Account Manager must build and maintain strong client relationships, serve as the lead point of contact for all key client matters, anticipate client needs, and work across the company to meet client deadlines and help the client succeed. The Key Account Manager will also bring in new business through market research and build and develop relationships with existing clients. Travel is required throughout the territory, and the role is responsible for the following states: North Carolina and South Carolina.
WHAT YOU'LL DO:

* Provide the highest level of service and technical expertise each season, from sell\-in to sell\-thru.
* Achieve sales goals by quarter and by category as defined by their manager.
* Develop and maintain a strong relationship with all levels of external account leadership, internal business partners, and relevant departments.
* Coordinate and prepare seasonal product presentations.
* Drive analysis of account base – business planning, inventory management, sell\-through analytics.
* Proactive order book management.
* Continuous sales analysis to manage product life cycles, inventory models, capitalize on successes, and address issues as needed.

* Knowledge and discipline to adhere to distribution guidelines.
* Work as a liaison with the National Sales Manager, customer service, sales analyst, and in\-store marketing team.
* Deliver all required reports, for example, weekly sell\-through analysis, on time.
* Market research through store and account visits 2\-3 times a month.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

* 6\+ Years' experience in Footwear (kids preferred), national account sales, or relevant experience.
* Ability to present product and communicate brand strategy to accounts accurately and effectively.
* Working knowledge of the retail footwear industry.
* Ability to effectively manage your time and work against business deadlines.
* Analytically strong, understanding of retail math, fluent in Excel and PowerPoint, and overall business orientation.
* Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, make recommendations, and provide solutions.
